tools.name: Artery
tools.description: Artery enables V2X simulations based on ETSI ITS-G5 protocols like GeoNetworking and BTP. Single vehicles can be equipped with multiple ITS-G5 services through Artery's middleware, which also provides common Facilities for these services. Some basic services, such as Cooperative Awareness (CAMs) and Decentralized Notification (DENMs), are already included.

summary.en: Artery enables V2X simulations based on ETSI ITS-G5 protocols like GeoNetworking and BTP.
summary.zh: 基于 ETSI ITS-G5 协议的车联网通信仿真。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

text.en: V2X simulation using ETSI ITS-G5 services.
text.zh: 使用 ETSI ITS-G5 服务进行 V2X 仿真。

text.en: Provides GeoNetworking, BTP, CAM, and DENM; radio models may use Veins or INET.
text.zh: 提供 GeoNetworking、BTP、CAM 和 DENM；无线模型可采用 Veins 或 INET。

text.en: CaService emits CamSent and CamReceived OMNeT++ signals carrying CAM objects. Attach result listeners to analyze message activity in the configured ITS service.
text.zh: CaService 发出携带 CAM 对象的 CamSent、CamReceived 信号，可为已配置的 ITS 服务接入结果监听器，分析消息收发。

text.en: Middleware supports multiple ITS services per vehicle with shared Facilities.
text.zh: 中间件支持每车多个 ITS 服务及共享设施层。

text.en: Official site provides feature, architecture, and installation guides; Veins is optional when INET supplies radio models.
text.zh: 官网提供功能、架构及安装指南；由 INET 提供无线模型时 Veins 为可选依赖。

tools.name: CausalSim
tools.description: CausalSim is a causal framework for unbiased trace-driven simulation. Current trace-driven simulators assume that the interventions being simulated (e.g., a new algorithm) would not affect the validity of the traces. However, real-world traces are often biased by the choices algorithms make during trace collection, and hence replaying traces under an intervention may lead to incorrect results. CausalSim addresses this challenge by learning a causal model of the system dynamics and latent factors capturing the underlying system conditions during trace collection. It learns these models using an initial randomized control trial (RCT) under a fixed set of algorithms, and then applies them to remove biases from trace data when simulating new algorithms.

summary.en: CausalSim is a causal framework for unbiased trace-driven simulation.
summary.zh: 利用因果模型减少历史轨迹回放中的干预偏差。

text.en: Learns causal models to remove policy-induced bias from trace-driven simulation; evaluated with adaptive video streaming.
text.zh: 学习因果模型以校正策略造成的轨迹偏差，应用于自适应视频流仿真。

text.en: System dynamics and latent conditions are inferred from randomized-control-trial traces, rather than a general hardware resource model.
text.zh: 从随机对照试验轨迹学习系统动态与潜在条件，主要对象不是通用硬件资源模型。

text.en: The documented evaluation compares simulation prediction error and ABR-policy conclusions; reported accuracy depends on its datasets and experiments.
text.zh: 文档评估仿真预测误差和 ABR 策略结论，所报告精度依赖对应数据与实验条件。

text.en: Evaluates interventions by alternative policies using learned dynamics; this does not establish a generic VM/task scheduler API.
text.zh: 利用学习的动态评估替代策略干预，不能据此认定有通用虚拟机或任务调度 API。

text.en: The README explains the causal method and evaluation scope; API and runtime details require repository examples.
text.zh: README 说明因果方法及评估范围，API 和运行细节需查项目示例。

tools.name: CloudSim Express
tools.description: CloudSim Express introduces a human-readable scripting approach to define simulation scenarios, a standard way of writing extensions, and a simplified deployment approach. The script-based approach significantly reduces code-based implementations. In the cases of simple examples, it completely eliminates the need to implement Java code.

It's easy to use and extend, enabling modeling, simulation, and experimentation of Cloud computing infrastructures and application services. It allows developers to focus on specific system design issues to be investigated, without concerning the low-level details related to Cloud-based infrastructures and services.

tools.name: CloudSim Plus Automation
tools.description: CloudSim Plus Automation is a Java 17+ command line tool based on CloudSim Plus (and some CloudReports classes) which is able to read specifications of CloudSim Plus simulation scenarios from a YAML file, a very human-readable data format. Simulation scenarios can be written inside a YAML file and CloudSim Plus Automation reads these simulation scenarios, creates and runs them on CloudSim Plus.

text.zh: 仓库 ndnSIM 分支中的 NDN 计算函数仿真。

text.en: CFN tracks named computation graphs, node cores and utilization; these are simulation fields.
text.zh: CFN 跟踪命名计算图、节点核心数和利用率，这些字段属于仿真模型。

text.en: NS_LOG_DEBUG and console messages expose Interest handling and function dispatch.
text.zh: NS_LOG_DEBUG 与控制台消息记录 Interest 处理和函数派发。

text.en: Graph-based function requests and periodic utilization Interests drive dispatch decisions.
text.zh: 根据计算图产生函数请求，周期性利用率 Interest 参与派发决策。

text.en: C++ CFN application source; inspect this branch rather than the generic default-branch README.
text.zh: C++ CFN 应用源码；应检查此分支，而非默认分支中的通用 README。

tools.name: Cooja
tools.description: Cooja Simulator is a network simulator specifically designed for Wireless Sensor Networks.

summary.en: Cooja Simulator is a network simulator specifically designed for Wireless Sensor Networks.
summary.zh: 面向无线传感器网络的 Cooja 仿真工具。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: MSPSim emulates MSP430 processors and selected sensor-network platforms.
note.zh: MSPSim 仿真 MSP430 处理器及部分传感网络平台。

note.en: The Visualizer plugin renders mote positions with selectable skins for traffic, radio links and node attributes.
note.zh: Visualizer 插件显示节点位置，并可选择流量、无线链路和节点属性等显示层。

note.en: ScriptRunner provides an editor and scripting controls for automated simulation tests; scripts receive simulation events and report test outcomes.
note.zh: ScriptRunner 提供编辑器与脚本控件，用于自动化仿真测试；脚本接收仿真事件并报告测试结果。

note.en: LogListener displays and filters mote log events and can save the log to a file.
note.zh: LogListener 显示和筛选 mote 日志事件，并可保存到文件。

text.en: Network simulator with instruction-level emulation through MSPSim.
text.zh: 网络仿真器，通过 MSPSim 提供指令级仿真。

text.en: MSPSim emulates MSP430 processors and selected sensor-network platforms.
text.zh: MSPSim 仿真 MSP430 处理器及部分传感网络平台。

text.en: LogListener displays and filters mote log events and can save the log to a file.
text.zh: LogListener 显示和筛选 mote 日志事件，并可保存到文件。

text.en: Simulation.scheduleEvent places TimeEvent objects in the simulation event queue. Running simulations require scheduling from the simulation thread; speed-limit controls pace execution. This manages simulation events.
text.zh: Simulation.scheduleEvent 将 TimeEvent 放入仿真事件队列；运行期间需由仿真线程调度，可设置执行速度。这是仿真事件管理。

text.en: ScriptRunner provides an editor and scripting controls for automated simulation tests; scripts receive simulation events and report test outcomes.
text.zh: ScriptRunner 提供编辑器与脚本控件，用于自动化仿真测试；脚本接收仿真事件并报告测试结果。

tools.name: CORE
tools.description: The Common Open Research Emulator (CORE) is a tool for emulating networks on one or more machines. You can connect these emulated networks to live networks. CORE consists of a GUI for drawing topologies of lightweight virtual machines, and Python modules for scripting network emulation.

summary.en: The Common Open Research Emulator (CORE) is a tool for emulating networks on one or more machines.
summary.zh: 构造虚拟网络并运行真实应用，可连接实际网络。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: A graphical topology editor, Python scripting, installation packages, and an official documentation site are provided.
note.zh: 提供图形拓扑编辑器、Python 脚本、安装包及官方文档站点。

note.en: A graphical topology editor, Python scripting, installation packages, and an official documentation site are provided.
note.zh: 提供图形拓扑编辑器、Python 脚本、安装包及官方文档站点。

note.en: Network emulation across one or several machines, with connections to live networks.
note.zh: 在单机或多机上进行网络仿真运行，并可连接真实网络。

text.en: Network emulation across one or several machines, with connections to live networks.
text.zh: 在单机或多机上进行网络仿真运行，并可连接真实网络。

text.en: Topology nodes use lightweight virtual machines and configurable network connections.
text.zh: 拓扑节点采用轻量虚拟机和可配置网络连接。

text.en: The performance guide evaluates aggregate packet-processing rate and explains how CPU sharing, packet hops, and active processes affect throughput. Its historical example uses a single-CPU 3.0 GHz Xeon with 2 GB RAM; it is not a current capacity guarantee.
text.zh: 性能指南评估整机包处理速率，说明 CPU 共享、包经过的跳数和活动进程对吞吐量的影响。历史示例使用单 CPU 3.0 GHz Xeon、2 GB 内存，不代表当前容量保证。

text.en: The GUI and Python modules construct and control the emulated topology.
text.zh: GUI 与 Python 模块用于构造和控制网络拓扑。

text.en: A graphical topology editor, Python scripting, installation packages, and an official documentation site are provided.
text.zh: 提供图形拓扑编辑器、Python 脚本、安装包及官方文档站点。

tools.name: DFaaS
tools.description: A novel decentralized FaaS-based architecture designed to automatically and autonomously balance the traffic load across edge nodes belonging to federated Edge Computing ecosystems. Its implementation relies on an overlay peer-to-peer network and a distributed control algorithm that takes decisions on load redistribution.

summary.en: A novel decentralized FaaS-based architecture designed to automatically and autonomously balance the traffic load across edge nodes belonging to federated Edge Computing ecosystems.
summary.zh: 面向联合边缘节点的分布式无服务器函数执行与负载均衡。

note.en: Ubuntu/K3s setup uses Ansible playbooks and deployment scripts. The former Containernet emulator was removed during Kubernetes migration.
note.zh: Ubuntu/K3s 环境提供 Ansible 与部署脚本；迁移至 Kubernetes 时已移除原 Containernet 仿真运行组件。

note.en: Prometheus collects metrics; k6 drives requests and agent logs are documented.
note.zh: Prometheus 采集指标，k6 产生请求，文档提供代理日志查看方式。

note.en: Current DFaaS runs decentralized serverless functions on federated edge nodes, using Go agents and OpenFaaS CE.
note.zh: 当前 DFaaS 通过 Go 代理和 OpenFaaS CE，在联邦边缘节点运行去中心化无服务器函数。

notes.en: The reviewed version deploys Go agents and OpenFaaS CE on Kubernetes. Capabilities of older Containernet setups are not assumed.
notes.zh: 核查版本在 Kubernetes 上部署 Go agent 与 OpenFaaS CE，不假定具备旧 Containernet 配置的能力。

text.en: Current DFaaS runs decentralized serverless functions on federated edge nodes, using Go agents and OpenFaaS CE.
text.zh: 当前 DFaaS 通过 Go 代理和 OpenFaaS CE，在联邦边缘节点运行去中心化无服务器函数。

text.en: Kubernetes nodes/VMs host functions, HAProxy forwards HTTP traffic, and a P2P overlay connects agents.
text.zh: Kubernetes 节点或虚拟机承载函数，HAProxy 转发 HTTP 流量，P2P 覆盖网络连接代理。

text.en: Prometheus collects metrics; k6 drives requests and agent logs are documented.
text.zh: Prometheus 采集指标，k6 产生请求，文档提供代理日志查看方式。

text.en: Distributed control redistributes load between nodes; a separate simulator compares load-balancing strategies.
text.zh: 分布式控制在节点间重新分配负载，另附比较负载均衡策略的仿真器。

text.en: Ubuntu/K3s setup uses Ansible playbooks and deployment scripts. The former Containernet emulator was removed during Kubernetes migration.
text.zh: Ubuntu/K3s 环境提供 Ansible 与部署脚本；迁移至 Kubernetes 时已移除原 Containernet 仿真运行组件。

tools.name: EasiEI
tools.description: EasiEI simulates various computing, communication, and storage resources in edge computing, and provides basic task scheduling algorithms to support the simulation of edge computing scenarios.

summary.en: EasiEI simulates various computing, communication, and storage resources in edge computing, and provides basic task scheduling algorithms to support the simulation of edge computing scenarios.
summary.zh: 建模边缘计算、通信与存储资源，提供任务调度算法。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: Resource pools explicitly model edge computing devices, edge servers, and cloud servers. Configure the number and capacity of resource units for the chosen tier.
note.zh: 资源池明确建模边缘计算设备、边缘服务器和云服务器；需按层级配置资源单元数量与容量。

note.en: Resource pools explicitly model edge computing devices, edge servers, and cloud servers. Configure the number and capacity of resource units for the chosen tier.
note.zh: 资源池明确建模边缘计算设备、边缘服务器和云服务器；需按层级配置资源单元数量与容量。

note.en: Catalog mapping for composed fog scenarios: Equip intermediate routers, switches, or base stations with task processing and resource-allocation components. The Wiki describes these configurable devices; it does not supply a preset named Fog.
note.zh: 按可组合场景归入雾计算：为中间路由器、交换机或基站配置任务处理与资源分配组件。Wiki 明确描述这些可配置设备，并未提供名为 Fog 的预设。

note.en: IoT device modeling uses the SensorBase extension interface bound to an ns-3 node. Implement InitialMachine and compose task-generation/processing components for a concrete sensor; this interface is not a ready-made physical sensor model.
note.zh: 物联网设备建模使用绑定 ns-3 节点的 SensorBase 扩展接口；具体传感器需实现 InitialMachine 并组合任务生成、处理组件。该接口不是现成的物理传感器模型。

note.en: Sensor scenarios require a concrete SensorBase implementation.
note.zh: 传感器场景需实现具体的 SensorBase 子类。

note.en: The project recommends Ubuntu with Boost and waf. Its macOS instructions record unresolved include-name conflicts.
note.zh: 项目推荐 Ubuntu、Boost 与 waf；macOS 说明记录了尚待解决的头文件命名冲突。

note.en: Default scheduling uses arrival order with non-preemptive priority for simultaneous arrivals. Resource allocation policies can be customized.
note.zh: 默认按到达顺序调度，同一时刻到达使用非抢占优先级；资源分配策略可自定义。

note.en: Default scheduling uses arrival order with non-preemptive priority for simultaneous arrivals. Resource allocation policies can be customized.
note.zh: 默认按到达顺序调度，同一时刻到达使用非抢占优先级；资源分配策略可自定义。

note.en: Default scheduling uses arrival order with non-preemptive priority for simultaneous arrivals. Resource allocation policies can be customized.
note.zh: 默认按到达顺序调度，同一时刻到达使用非抢占优先级；资源分配策略可自定义。

note.en: The Server application binds ns-3 UDP sockets to IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
note.zh: Server 应用将 ns-3 UDP 套接字绑定到 IPv4、IPv6 地址。

note.en: The Server application binds ns-3 UDP sockets to IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
note.zh: Server 应用将 ns-3 UDP 套接字绑定到 IPv4、IPv6 地址。

note.en: The Server application binds ns-3 UDP sockets to IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
note.zh: Server 应用将 ns-3 UDP 套接字绑定到 IPv4、IPv6 地址。

note.en: Users connect their own trace sinks to the demonstrated resource trace sources to collect additional observations.
note.zh: 用户可将自定义轨迹回调连接到示例中的资源轨迹源，收集自定义观测。

note.en: The C++ manager example loads tasks from CSV, configures resources, and runs the simulation; adapt its hard-coded input path.
note.zh: C++ 管理器示例从 CSV 加载任务、配置资源并运行仿真，需修改硬编码输入路径。

note.en: Quick Start connects resource trace callbacks and writes time/value output files. Adapt its local CSV input path.
note.zh: 快速入门连接资源轨迹回调并写出时间与资源值；需修改本地 CSV 输入路径。

note.en: Task orchestration and resource-allocation policies are user-replaceable components.
note.zh: 任务编排与资源分配策略是用户可替换的组件。

text.en: Edge/Computing-First Networking simulation for changing compute, bandwidth, and storage resources.
text.zh: 面向变化计算、带宽和存储资源的边缘及算力优先网络仿真。

text.en: Resource units model CPU and memory; multiple units form pools for edge devices, edge servers, and cloud servers. Capacity is normalized relative to the largest modeled resource.
text.zh: 资源单元建模 CPU 与内存，多个单元组成边缘设备、边缘服务器或云服务器的资源池；容量按建模资源中的最大值归一化。

text.en: The manager example connects DoubleProbe to RemainingCpu and RemainingMemory and writes time/value pairs to formatted cpu2 and mem2 output files. Its workload CSV path is hard-coded and must be adapted locally.
text.zh: 管理器示例将 DoubleProbe 连接到 RemainingCpu 与 RemainingMemory，向 cpu2、mem2 文件写入时间与资源值；工作负载 CSV 路径为硬编码，需按本机修改。

text.en: Composable generators, receivers, orchestrators, and senders model heterogeneous devices. Default task scheduling uses arrival order and non-preemptive priority for simultaneous arrivals; allocation policies can be replaced.
text.zh: 可组合任务生成器、接收器、编排器和发送器以建模异构设备；默认按到达顺序调度，同时到达使用非抢占优先级，资源分配策略可替换。

text.en: C++ examples extend ns-3 nodes with resource and management components. Quick Start shows CSV workload replay, trace callbacks, and file output; adapt hard-coded paths. The Wiki lists hardware-simulator and container integration as future work.
text.zh: C++ 示例为 ns-3 节点扩展资源与管理组件；快速入门演示 CSV 工作负载重放、轨迹回调和文件输出，需修改硬编码路径。Wiki 将硬件仿真器与容器集成列为未来工作。

tools.name: ECHOES
tools.description: ECHOES stands for "Edge and Cloud Hybrid Optimization Environment Simulator", which is a free and open-source tool to simulate an Edge/Cloud-Hybrid network topology, in order to optimise and test methods for offloading Tasks from user's device to edge-server or cloud-server.

summary.en: ECHOES stands for "Edge and Cloud Hybrid Optimization Environment Simulator", which is a free and open-source tool to simulate an Edge/Cloud-Hybrid network topology, in order to optimise and test methods for offloading Tasks from user's device to edge-server or cloud-server.
summary.zh: 边云混合环境仿真，用于任务卸载策略评估。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: Simulates hybrid edge/cloud task offloading.
note.zh: 模拟边缘与云混合环境中的任务卸载。

note.en: PHP and Python are required; documented commands start the knapsack service and simulator.
note.zh: 需要 PHP 与 Python；文档提供背包服务和仿真器的启动命令。

text.en: Simulates hybrid edge/cloud task offloading.
text.zh: 模拟边缘与云混合环境中的任务卸载。

text.en: User devices, edge servers, and cloud servers form the stated simulation scope.
text.zh: 文档描述的仿真对象包含用户设备、边缘服务器和云服务器。

text.en: The simulator calculates task execution time and tracks assigned versus remaining tasks during repeated simulation steps.
text.zh: 仿真器计算任务执行时间，并在重复仿真步骤中跟踪已分配与剩余任务。

text.en: Offloading experiments use a Python knapsack wrapper; the README does not specify a general scheduler plugin API.
text.zh: 卸载实验使用 Python 背包问题封装，README 未说明通用调度插件 API。

text.en: PHP and Python are required; documented commands start the knapsack service and simulator.
text.zh: 需要 PHP 与 Python；文档提供背包服务和仿真器的启动命令。

tools.name: ECSNeT++
tools.description: ECSNeT++ is a simulation toolkit for simulating the execution of Distributed Stream Processing applications on Edge anc Cloud Computing environments. ECSNeT++ is implemented using the OMNeT++ and the INET framework.

summary.en: ECSNeT++ is a simulation toolkit for simulating the execution of Distributed Stream Processing applications on Edge anc Cloud Computing environments.
summary.zh: 基于 OMNeT++ 和 INET 的边云分布式流处理仿真。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: IDE workflow, NED/INI examples, XML inputs, and extensible source/operator distributions are documented.
note.zh: 提供 IDE 工作流、NED/INI 示例、XML 输入，以及可扩展的数据源和算子分布。

note.en: The documented OMNeT++ example writes simulation measurements to its results directory.
note.zh: 文档中的 OMNeT++ 示例向 results 目录输出仿真测量数据。

note.en: Round-robin CPU-core scheduling can be replaced through ICpuCoreScheduler; XML describes placement plans.
note.zh: 轮询 CPU 核调度可通过 ICpuCoreScheduler 替换，XML 描述放置计划。

text.en: OMNeT++/INET toolkit for distributed stream processing across edge and cloud.
text.zh: 基于 OMNeT++/INET，模拟边云分布式流处理。

text.en: Source/operator/sink graphs and placement plans; extensible Ethernet and IEEE 802.11 hosts, with LTE via a separate plugin.
text.zh: 表示源、算子、汇点图及放置计划；可扩展以太网与 IEEE 802.11 主机，LTE 需单独插件。

text.en: The documented OMNeT++ example writes simulation measurements to its results directory.
text.zh: 文档中的 OMNeT++ 示例向 results 目录输出仿真测量数据。

text.en: Round-robin CPU-core scheduling can be replaced through ICpuCoreScheduler; XML describes placement plans.
text.zh: 轮询 CPU 核调度可通过 ICpuCoreScheduler 替换，XML 描述放置计划。

text.en: IDE workflow, NED/INI examples, XML inputs, and extensible source/operator distributions are documented.
text.zh: 提供 IDE 工作流、NED/INI 示例、XML 输入，以及可扩展的数据源和算子分布。

tools.name: EdgeAISim
tools.description: A Python-based toolkit for simulating and modelling AI models in edge computing environments. EdgeAISim extends EdgeSimPy and incorporates AI models like Multi-Armed Bandit and Deep Q-Networks to optimise power usage and task migration. The toolkit outperforms baseline worst-fit algorithms, showcasing its potential in sustainable edge computing by significantly reducing power consumption and enhancing task management for various large-scale scenarios.

summary.en: A Python-based toolkit for simulating and modelling AI models in edge computing environments.
summary.zh: 扩展 EdgeSimPy，研究 AI 驱动的能耗优化与任务迁移。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: The project describes IoT applications as the target of its edge resource-management experiments.
note.zh: 项目将物联网应用列为边缘资源管理实验的应用对象。

note.en: Execution dependency documented by this project; version and selected workflow requirements still apply.
note.zh: 项目明确记录的执行依赖；仍需遵循所选版本与工作流程的要求。

note.en: Python experiment scripts are listed; documented dependencies include EdgeSimPy 1.1.0 and PyTorch 2.0.0.
note.zh: 列出 Python 实验脚本，文档依赖包含 EdgeSimPy 1.1.0 与 PyTorch 2.0.0。

text.en: Extends EdgeSimPy for AI-driven edge resource-management experiments.
text.zh: 扩展 EdgeSimPy，开展 AI 驱动的边缘资源管理实验。

text.en: CPU, RAM, disk, edge servers, base stations, user mobility, and bandwidth-sharing network flows.
text.zh: 建模 CPU、内存、磁盘、边缘服务器、基站、用户移动及共享带宽的网络流。

text.en: Power models use resource utilization; migration frequency and server power are used by the documented learning algorithms.
text.zh: 功率模型使用资源利用率，所述学习算法使用迁移频次与服务器功率。

text.en: Includes multi-armed bandit, DQN, GNN/DQN and actor-critic migration policies, plus max-min flow sharing.
text.zh: 包含多臂老虎机、DQN、GNN/DQN、Actor-Critic 迁移策略和最大最小公平流量分配。

text.en: Python experiment scripts are listed; documented dependencies include EdgeSimPy 1.1.0 and PyTorch 2.0.0.
text.zh: 列出 Python 实验脚本，文档依赖包含 EdgeSimPy 1.1.0 与 PyTorch 2.0.0。

text.zh: 此快照采用 Java 21+ 和 CloudSim 7.0.0-alpha，提供 MATLAB、Python 分析图及可运行教程。

tools.name: SimEdgeIntel (EdgeSim)

tools.description: EdgeSimPy models the lifecycle of containerized applications through several functional abstractions that replicate the behavior of container runtimes like Docker. In addition, EdgeSimPy features a flexible input format that allows users to define custom parameters for simulated entities out-of-the-box, extending the simulator’s built-in capabilities without modifying its core features.

tools.name: Emu5GNet
tools.description: This emulation environment has been created to allow researchers/industrials to develop and deploy applications in complex 5G network architecture (SA and NSA) for enabling both emulations of the network and data processing in realistic E2E scenarios. Emu5GNet allows the execution of 5G RAN and Core using Mininet-Wifi environment and containernet. The 5G RAN and Core can be packed inside docker containers. Emu5GNet also allows the integration of full ETSI NFV compliant infrastructure based on [vim-emu] (https://github.com/containernet/vim-emu) platform. This last integration of an enhancement of vim-emu enables the interconnection of Mininet-Wifi Access points and vim-emu datacenters and, allows the network functions migration across edge datacenters.

tools.name: EmuFog
tools.description: EmuFog helps to test fog computing applications more efficiently. Instead of actual deploying large network topologies with your application to test, EmuFog helps to generate networks that can be emulated easily with MaxiNet, a distributed version of the popular Mininet. This provides more realistic results than simulations and is cheaper and faster than real deployments. As an input EmuFog supports generated topologies from BRITE or measured real world topologies from Caida. In those networks EmuFog places fog nodes efficiently based on user defined constrains such as network latency thresholds or resource constraints. Applications for clients and fog nodes can be anything shipped in a Docker container.

tools.name: Fogbed
tools.description: Fogbed is a framework that extends the Mininet emulator to create fog testbeds in virtualized environments. Using a desktop approach, Fogbed enables the deployment of virtual fog nodes as Docker containers under different network conﬁgurations. The Fogbed API provides functionality to add, connect and remove containers dynamically from the network topology. These features allow for the emulation of real world cloud and fog infrastructures in which it is possible to start and stop compute instances at any point in time. Also, it is possible to change at runtime resource limitations for a container, such as CPU time and memory available.

tools.name: Fogify
tools.description: Fogify is an emulation Framework easing the modeling, deployment and experimentation of fog testbeds. Fogify provides a toolset to: model complex fog topologies comprised of heterogeneous resources, network capabilities and QoS criteria; deploy the modelled configuration and services using popular containerized infrastructure-as-code descriptions to a cloud or local environment; experiment, measure and evaluate the deployment by injecting faults and adapting the configuration at runtime to test different "what-if" scenarios that reveal the limitations of a service before introduced to the public.

summary.en: Fogify is an emulation Framework easing the modeling, deployment and experimentation of fog testbeds.
summary.zh: 建模、部署并实验验证包含异构资源的雾计算测试床。

tools.name: FogNetSim++
tools.description: FogNetSim++ extends OMNeT++, which is a well known framework for building network simulators, to model all these aspects. Moreover, it includes popular communication protocols for simulation, such as TCP, UDP, MQTT, and CoAP. Furthermore, FogNetSim++ models several other aspects, such as energy consumption, pricing, mobility, and handoff mechanisms.

summary.en: FogNetSim++ extends OMNeT++, which is a well known framework for building network simulators, to model all these aspects.
summary.zh: 基于 OMNeT++ 的雾计算网络与通信协议仿真。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.

text.en: Toolkit for distributed fog-computing simulation.
text.zh: 用于分布式雾计算仿真的工具包。

text.en: Installation integrates an MQTT application module into INET.
text.zh: 安装步骤将 MQTT 应用模块集成到 INET。

text.en: The packaged MQTT module defines OMNeT++ statistics for packet counts/bytes, packet lifetime, latency, and task time; ComputeBrokerApp3 additionally defines queue-time statistics. Use the corresponding modules in the archived OMNeT++/INET environment.
text.zh: 打包的 MQTT 模块定义包数与字节数、包存活时间、时延和任务时间的 OMNeT++ 统计；ComputeBrokerApp3 另含排队时间统计，需在所述历史 OMNeT++/INET 环境中使用相应模块。

text.en: ComputeBrokerApp3 queues arriving tasks while a resource is busy, calculates service time from required MIPS and configured MIPS, and schedules completion events. On completion it takes the next queued task and emits its queue time.
text.zh: ComputeBrokerApp3 在资源繁忙时将任务入队，根据任务需求与配置 MIPS 计算服务时间并安排完成事件；完成后取出下一任务并记录排队时间。

text.en: Requires the documented OMNeT++ 4.6 and INET 3.3.0 environment; packaged testing/example scenarios are provided.
text.zh: 文档采用 OMNeT++ 4.6 与 INET 3.3.0，提供测试和示例场景。

tools.name: FogTorchPI
tools.description: FogTorchΠ is an open source prototype, developed in Java, based on a model for Fog computing infrastructures and applications. 1), It takes into account non-functional parameters within the model (i.e., hardware, software, latency and bandwidth) to determine, compare and contrast different eligible deployments of a given application over a Fog infrastructure. 2), In the case of hardware capabilities, it considers CPU cores, RAM and storage available at a given node or required by a given software component. 3), Software capabilities are represented by a list of software names (operating system, programming languages, frameworks etc). 4), It considers latency, and both download and upload bandwidths as QoS attributes. Latency is measured in milliseconds (ms), while bandwidth is given in Megabits per second (Mbps). Note: Outputs of FogTorchPI can be the input of iFogSim.

summary.en: FogTorchΠ is an open source prototype, developed in Java, based on a model for Fog computing infrastructures and applications.
summary.zh: 使用硬件、软件与网络 QoS 约束研究雾应用部署。

tools.name: iTETRIS
tools.description: iTETRIS is aligned with the communication architecture defined by ETSI for Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS). The standard specifications concern a communication system designed for various types of traffic applications which can use several coexistent communication technologies. The architecture assumes three different actors communicating in an ITS scenario, each representing a given subsystem: vehicle, roadside and central subsystems.

summary.en: iTETRIS is aligned with the communication architecture defined by ETSI for Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS).
summary.zh: 面向智能交通系统通信架构的联合仿真平台。

notes.en: This architecture page describes the target ITS architecture, not proof that every listed layer or security function was implemented.
notes.zh: 此页面描述目标 ITS 架构，不代表所有层次或安全功能均已实现。

text.en: Vehicular ITS platform; the project documents road safety and traffic-efficiency scenarios.

text.en: Architecture distinguishes vehicle, roadside and central subsystems.
text.zh: 架构区分车辆、路侧与中心子系统。

text.en: The project reports evaluating cooperative ITS effects on urban traffic efficiency and traffic-information collection. Its public deliverables page offers technical reports through a request form; it does not expose a downloadable metric schema.
text.zh: 项目介绍了协作式 ITS 对城市交通效率及交通信息采集效果的评估；公开交付物页面通过申请表提供技术报告，没有直接提供可下载的指标结构。

text.zh: 架构描述接入技术选择、优先级与拥塞控制；具体实现覆盖仍需另行核实。

tools.name: NDN4IVC
tools.description: An open-source simulator/framework that facilitates testing of more realistic VANET applications via the NDN stack. This project utilizes two popular simulators for VANET simulation: the NS3 network simulator with the ndnSIM module and SUMO, a simulator of urban mobility. NDN4IVC allows real-time bidirectional communication between SUMO and NS3 to support more data about road traffic and vehicular mobility. The framework can model the impact of vehicular networks on road traffic and investigate complex interactions between the two domains.

tools.name: NFaaS
tools.description: Enabling to migrate functions closer to the user in ICN environment without a global view of the network.

summary.en: Enabling to migrate functions closer to the user in ICN environment without a global view of the network.
summary.zh: 研究 ICN 环境中将函数迁移到靠近用户的位置。

note.en: run.sh varies kernel counts and invokes ndn-function with simulation parameters.
note.zh: run.sh 改变内核数量并通过仿真参数调用 ndn-function。

note.en: run.sh enables component-specific NS_LOG and redirects output into per-run log files.
note.zh: run.sh 启用各组件 NS_LOG，将每次运行的输出重定向到日志文件。

text.en: An ndnSIM/NFD extension models named-function execution using a Kernel Store for unikernel images. The documented cloud-node mode adds network delay and treats CPU resources as unlimited.
text.zh: ndnSIM/NFD 扩展，通过保存 unikernel 镜像的 Kernel Store 建模具名函数执行；文档中的云节点模式增加网络时延，并将 CPU 资源视为无限。

text.en: Kernel Store keeps per-function cache entries. MAX_RUN_KERNELS caps active modeled functions, QUEUE_SIZE bounds pending requests, and SPECILIZE (the source-code spelling) enables cache-size adaptation. Cloud-node assumptions differ from ordinary nodes.
text.zh: Kernel Store 保存各函数的缓存条目。MAX_RUN_KERNELS 限制活动建模函数数，QUEUE_SIZE 限制等待请求数，SPECILIZE（源码中的拼写）启用缓存大小调整；云节点采用不同于普通节点的假设。

text.en: manageDelay updates per-function/per-face response-delay records and timeout information. Kernel Store debug output describes running kernels, overload, queue transitions, and forwarding tables.
text.zh: manageDelay 更新各函数与接口的响应时延记录及超时信息；Kernel Store 调试输出描述运行函数、过载、队列变化和转发表。

text.en: Kernel Store runs a modeled function when the concurrency limit permits, queues requests when occupied, and starts queued work after completion. ns-3 schedules completion from task-size time values; this code models execution time.
text.zh: Kernel Store 在并发额度允许时启动建模函数，繁忙时排队，完成后继续处理队列；ns-3 根据任务大小对应的时间值调度完成事件，代码建模的是执行时间。

text.en: The pinned source snapshot builds its bundled ns-3/ndnSIM with waf and provides the ndn-function example. run.sh sweeps parameters and captures logs; the pinned implementation dates to 2019.
text.zh: 固定版本源码使用 waf 构建附带的 ns-3/ndnSIM，提供 ndn-function 示例；run.sh 扫描参数并保存日志，此处固定的实现提交来自 2019 年。

tools.name: NoSSim
tools.description: Network-of-Systems Simulator (NoSSim) is a network/system co-simulation framework that combines a fast and accurate host-compiled full system simulator with a standard, reconfigurable OMNeT++ network simulation backplane. Detailed models of network interfaces and protocol stacks (lwIP) are integrated into host-compiled system and OS models to allow accurately capturing network and system interactions.

summary.en: Network-of-Systems Simulator (NoSSim) is a network/system co-simulation framework that combines a fast and accurate host-compiled full system simulator with a standard, reconfigurable OMNeT++ network simulation backplane.
summary.zh: 结合全系统模型与 OMNeT++ 网络模型的联合仿真框架。

note.en: SystemC 2.3.1, OMNeT++/OMNEST 5.0 and INET 3.4.0 are documented; example configurations and build/run steps are provided.
note.zh: 文档采用 SystemC 2.3.1、OMNeT++/OMNEST 5.0、INET 3.4.0，提供示例配置与构建运行步骤。

note.en: Network/system co-simulation couples host-compiled application execution with OMNeT++ networking.

text.en: Network/system co-simulation couples host-compiled application execution with OMNeT++ networking.
text.zh: 网络与系统协同仿真将主机编译的应用执行与 OMNeT++ 网络模型结合。

text.en: System/OS models include network interfaces and lwIP; JSON, NED, and INI configure application, system, and network layers.
text.zh: 系统和操作系统模型包含网络接口与 lwIP，通过 JSON、NED、INI 配置应用、系统及网络层。

text.zh: 时序使用函数级性能分析与回标，案例附带针对特定平台的性能数据。

text.zh: 文档采用 SystemC 2.3.1、OMNeT++/OMNEST 5.0、INET 3.4.0，提供示例配置与构建运行步骤。

tools.name: OMNeT++
tools.description: OMNeT++ is a public-source, component-based, modular and open-architecture simulation environment with strong GUI support and an embeddable simulation kernel. Its primary application area is the simulation of communication networks, but it has been successfully used in other areas like the simulation of IT systems, queueing networks, hardware architectures and business processes as well.

tools.name: Open-Simulator
tools.description: Open-simulator is a cluster simulator for Kubernetes. With the simulation capability of Open-Simulator, users can create a fake Kubernetes cluster and deploy workloads on it. Open-Simulator will simulate the kube-controller-manager to create pods for the workloads, and simulate the kube-scheduler to assign pods to the appropriate nodes.

summary.en: Open-simulator is a cluster simulator for Kubernetes.
summary.zh: 模拟 Kubernetes 集群和调度器行为，评估工作负载部署。

tools.name: Packet Tracer
tools.description: Packet Tracer is a cross-platform visual simulation tool designed by Cisco Systems that allows users to create network topologies and imitate modern computer networks. The software allows users to simulate the configuration of Cisco routers and switches using a simulated command line interface. Packet Tracer makes use of a drag and drop user interface, allowing users to add and remove simulated network devices as they see fit.

summary.en: Packet Tracer is a cross-platform visual simulation tool designed by Cisco Systems that allows users to create network topologies and imitate modern computer networks.
summary.zh: Cisco 网络教学工具，可视化构建拓扑并模拟设备配置。

Through simulations, it identifies information on structural problems, defects, pros/cons of strategies, resources usage to things of clusters built in edge computing.

tools.name: RECAP Simulator Framework
tools.description: The RECAP Simulation Framework is an open source simulation framework designed to support experimentation of infrastructure with different description models for workload, user distribution, network topology, and (physical and virtual) resource placement. It is able to simulate different use cases including Virtual Network Functions (VNFs), Elasticsearch, smart cities, and virtual Content Delivery Networks (vCDN). The output of the RECAP Simulation Framework depends on the use case, but in general, it is a set of metrics predefined by the user such as bandwidth, resource consumption (CPU, memory, storage), network delay, energy consumption, active number of VMs, cache hits and cache misses.

summary.en: The RECAP Simulation Framework is an open source simulation framework designed to support experimentation of infrastructure with different description models for workload, user distribution, network topology, and (physical and virtual) resource placement.
summary.zh: 研究网络拓扑、工作负载和资源放置的基础设施仿真框架。

tools.name: Shadow
tools.description: Shadow is a discrete-event network simulator that directly executes real application code, enabling you to simulate distributed systems with thousands of network-connected processes in realistic and scalable private network experiments using your laptop, desktop, or server running Linux.

summary.en: Shadow is a discrete-event network simulator that directly executes real application code, enabling you to simulate distributed systems with thousands of network-connected processes in realistic and scalable private network experiments using your laptop, desktop, or server running Linux.
summary.zh: 使用离散事件方式执行真实应用代码，研究分布式系统。

note.en: Discrete-event simulation executes unmodified Linux processes through system-call interposition.
note.zh: 通过系统调用拦截，在离散事件仿真中执行未修改的 Linux 进程。

text.en: Discrete-event simulation executes unmodified Linux processes through system-call interposition.
text.zh: 通过系统调用拦截，在离散事件仿真中执行未修改的 Linux 进程。

text.en: Models TCP and UDP communication over a network graph with latency and loss.
text.zh: 在包含时延和丢包的网络图上建模 TCP、UDP 通信。

text.en: The profiling guide explains top/htop and Linux perf for identifying host CPU and execution-time bottlenecks in Shadow and application processes. Host profiling is distinct from simulated network latency.
text.zh: 性能分析指南介绍通过 top/htop 与 Linux perf 定位 Shadow 及应用进程的宿主机 CPU 和执行时间瓶颈；这些宿主机指标需与模拟网络时延区分。

text.en: Configure simulation parallelism, CPU pinning, and thread-per-core or thread-per-host work scheduling. Experimental options can change results or execution speed; the guide documents their tradeoffs.
text.zh: 可配置仿真并行度、CPU 绑定，以及按核心或按主机组织的工作调度；实验性选项可能影响结果或执行速度，指南说明了各选项的取舍。

tools.name: SUMO - ITS
tools.description: "Simulation of Urban MObility", or "SUMO" for short, is an open source, microscopic, multi-modal traffic simulation. It allows to simulate how a given traffic demand which consists of single vehicles moves through a given road network. The simulation allows to address a large set of traffic management topics. It is purely microscopic: each vehicle is modelled explicitly, has an own route, and moves individually through the network. Simulations are deterministic by default but there are various options for introducing randomness.

summary.en: "Simulation of Urban MObility", or "SUMO" for short, is an open source, microscopic, multi-modal traffic simulation.
summary.zh: 微观、多模式道路交通仿真，逐个建模车辆与路线。

tools.name: SimFaaS
tools.description: This is a project done in PACS Lab aiming to develop a performance simulator for serverless computing platforms. Using this simulator, we can calculate Quality of Service (QoS) metrics like average response time, the average probability of cold start, average running servers (directly reflecting average cost), a histogram of different events, distribution of the number of servers throughout time, and many other characteristics.

summary.en: This is a project done in PACS Lab aiming to develop a performance simulator for serverless computing platforms.
summary.zh: 模拟无服务器平台，分析响应时间、冷启动与资源占用。

tools.name: SimFlex
tools.description: SimFlex is proceeding along two synergistic fronts: (1) Flexus is a powerful and flexible simulator framework that allows full-system simulation that relies heavily on well-defined component interface models to facilitate both model integration and compile-time simulator optimization. (2) SMARTS applies rigorous statistical sampling the­ory to reduce simulation turnaround by several orders of magnitude, while achieving high accuracy and confidence in estimates.

summary.en: SimGrid is a scientific instrument to study the behavior of large-scale distributed systems such as Grids, Clouds, HPC or P2P systems.
summary.zh: 用于网格、云、HPC 和点对点分布式系统的仿真工具。

note.en: Application/system simulation with an optional ns-3 packet-level network model.
note.zh: 以应用与系统仿真为主，可选 ns-3 分组级网络模型。

note.en: CPU/disk and default network models use analytical resource sharing. A separately configured ns-3 integration provides packet-level networking.
note.zh: CPU、磁盘和默认网络采用解析资源共享模型；另行配置 ns-3 集成后才使用分组级网络。

note.en: Enabled tracing exports Paje traces for external visualization tools; SMPI traces can produce communication Gantt views. This is postprocessing.
note.zh: 启用跟踪后可导出 Paje 轨迹供外部工具可视化；SMPI 轨迹可呈现通信甘特图，属于运行后分析。

note.en: Actor-to-host deployment can be specified in application code or an XML deployment file.
note.zh: 可通过应用代码或 XML 部署文件指定 actor 与主机的对应关系。

note.en: Logging supports severity/category filters and stderr, file, rolling-file and split-file appenders.
note.zh: 日志支持级别与类别过滤，可输出至 stderr、普通文件、循环覆盖文件或分卷文件。

text.en: Simulation of distributed systems including clouds, grids, HPC, and peer-to-peer systems.
text.zh: 对云、网格、高性能计算及对等网络等分布式系统进行仿真。

text.en: CPU/disk and default network models use analytical resource sharing. A separately configured ns-3 integration provides packet-level networking.
text.zh: CPU、磁盘和默认网络采用解析资源共享模型；另行配置 ns-3 集成后才使用分组级网络。

text.en: Predicts execution time and energy for modeled infrastructures; its MPI interface can profile real MPI applications. These predictions depend on the selected models.
text.zh: 预测建模基础设施的执行时间和能耗，MPI 接口可分析真实 MPI 应用；预测结果取决于所选模型。

text.en: Used to study distributed algorithms and scheduling heuristics.
text.zh: 用于研究分布式算法和调度启发式。

text.en: The GitHub repository is a mirror; primary development and documentation are linked from its README.
text.zh: GitHub 仓库为镜像；README 链接主要开发站点和文档。

tools.name: SimMobility
tools.description: SimMobility is an integrated mobility simulation platform that comprehensively simulates Future Mobility scenarios by integrating long, medium, and short-term travel behavior. Various mobility-sensitive behavioral models are integrated within the state-of-the-art scalable simulators to predict the impact of mobility demands on transportation networks, intelligent transportation services and vehicular emissions. The platform simulates the effects of a portfolio of technology, policy and investment options under alternative future scenarios. SimMobility encompasses the modeling of millions of agents, including pedestrians, drivers, phones, traffic lights, GPS, cars, buses, and trains, from second-by-second to year-by-year simulations and across countries.

summary.en: SimMobility is an integrated mobility simulation platform that comprehensively simulates Future Mobility scenarios by integrating long, medium, and short-term travel behavior.
summary.zh: 集成不同时间尺度的出行行为与交通系统仿真。

text.en: Integrated long-, mid-, and short-term agent-based mobility simulation.
text.zh: 整合长期、中期和短期的基于智能体的移动仿真。

text.en: Represents travelers, vehicles, public transport, and transport infrastructure.
text.zh: 描述出行者、车辆、公共交通和交通基础设施。

text.en: Supports investigation of transport demand, services, and emissions; these are transportation outputs rather than edge CPU metrics.
text.zh: 用于研究交通需求、服务和排放；这些属于交通输出，不能等同于边缘 CPU 指标。

text.en: Models transportation decisions at multiple time scales.
text.zh: 在多个时间尺度建模交通决策。

text.en: Source repository links installation instructions and project documentation.
text.zh: 源码仓库链接安装说明与项目文档。

tools.name: SimpleIoTSimulator
tools.description: SimpleIoTSimulator® is an easy to use, IoT Sensor/device simulator that quickly creates test environments made up of thousands of sensors and gateways, all on just one computer. SimpleIoTSimulator supports many of the common IoT protocols. They include: MQTT, MQTT-SN, MQTT-Broker, CoAP, HTTP/s client, HTTP/s server, Modbus over TCP, BACnet/IP server, LoRa Gateway, LoRa Device.

summary.en: SimpleIoTSimulator® is an easy to use, IoT Sensor/device simulator that quickly creates test environments made up of thousands of sensors and gateways, all on just one computer.
summary.zh: 模拟物联网传感器和网关，提供多种物联网协议。

note.en: Product documentation, application notes, and a demo; advertised device counts are not independently validated capacity.
note.zh: 提供产品文档、应用说明及演示；宣传设备数不是独立验证容量。

text.en: Commercial simulator creates IoT sensor and gateway test environments.
text.zh: 商业仿真器创建物联网传感器及网关测试环境。

text.en: Models protocol-speaking devices including LoRaWAN, CoAP, MQTT, MQTT-SN, HTTP/REST, Modbus, and BACnet variants.
text.zh: 建模使用 LoRaWAN、CoAP、MQTT、MQTT-SN、HTTP、REST、Modbus 和 BACnet 等协议的设备。

text.en: Learner utilities capture messages for replay; supported quantities depend on the protocol/device model.
text.zh: 学习工具捕获消息以供回放；支持量取决于协议和设备模型。

text.en: Scripts alter sensor payload behavior and configured devices publish or exchange protocol messages.
text.zh: 脚本改变传感器负载行为；配置设备发布或交换协议消息。

text.en: Product documentation, application notes, and a demo; advertised device counts are not independently validated capacity.
text.zh: 提供产品文档、应用说明及演示；宣传设备数不是独立验证容量。

tools.name: Simu5G
tools.description: Simu5G is the evolution of the popular SimuLTE 4G network simulator that incorporates 5G New Radio access.

summary.en: Simu5G is the evolution of the popular SimuLTE 4G network simulator that incorporates 5G New Radio access.
summary.zh: 面向 5G 新空口及相关网络场景的 OMNeT++ 扩展。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: C++ simulation project with linked documentation and installation information.
note.zh: C++ 仿真工程，链接文档和安装资料。

note.en: The standalone NR INI scenario configures cells, UE mobility, traffic and radio parameters.
note.zh: 独立 NR 场景的 INI 文件可配置小区、UE 移动、流量和无线参数。

note.en: The MultihopD2D application’s statistics module records broadcast delivery ratio, delay (including a 95th-percentile measure), transmissions and duplicates via OMNeT++ signals. This requires the corresponding D2D application.
note.zh: MultihopD2D 应用统计模块通过 OMNeT++ 信号记录广播交付率、时延（含第 95 百分位量）、发送次数与重复消息；需使用相应 D2D 应用。

text.en: 5G NR and LTE/LTE-Advanced user-plane simulation integrated with OMNeT++ and INET.
text.zh: 集成 OMNeT++ 和 INET 的 5G NR、LTE/LTE-Advanced 用户面仿真。

text.en: Alongside cellular user-plane networking, the MEC model allocates host CPU, RAM, and disk from application descriptors. VIM computes modeled processing delay from CPU speed and load. The guide also connects external MEC applications through real-time emulation and Linux network interfaces.
text.zh: 除蜂窝用户面网络外，MEC 模型依据应用描述文件分配主机 CPU、内存和磁盘；VIM 根据 CPU 速度与负载计算处理时延。手册还说明了通过实时仿真及 Linux 网络接口接入外部 MEC 应用的配置。

text.en: The MultihopD2D application’s statistics module records broadcast delivery ratio, delay (including a 95th-percentile measure), transmissions and duplicates via OMNeT++ signals. This requires the corresponding D2D application.
text.zh: MultihopD2D 应用统计模块通过 OMNeT++ 信号记录广播交付率、时延（含第 95 百分位量）、发送次数与重复消息；需使用相应 D2D 应用。

text.en: The MAC scheduler includes deficit round-robin allocation: It tracks active connections and deficit budgets, requests transmission grants, and commits the schedule. This schedules radio transmissions.
text.zh: MAC 调度包含赤字轮询分配：维护活动连接与额度，申请发送授权并提交调度结果；调度对象是无线传输。

text.en: C++ simulation project with linked documentation and installation information.
text.zh: C++ 仿真工程，链接文档和安装资料。

tools.name: SimuLTE
tools.description: SimuLTE is an innovative simulation tool enabling complex system level performance-evaluation of LTE and LTE Advanced networks (3GPP Release 8 and beyond) for the OMNeT++ framework.

summary.en: SimuLTE is an innovative simulation tool enabling complex system level performance-evaluation of LTE and LTE Advanced networks (3GPP Release 8 and beyond) for the OMNeT++ framework.
summary.zh: 基于 OMNeT++ 的 LTE 和 LTE-Advanced 系统级仿真。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: Includes Max C/I, proportional fair, and round-robin radio scheduling; pluggable modules allow new algorithms.
note.zh: 包含 Max C/I、比例公平及轮询无线调度；可插拔模块允许添加新算法。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine family itself; the reviewed version and its documented scope apply.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎系列，具体以本次核对版本及文档范围为准。

note.en: Includes Max C/I, proportional fair, and round-robin radio scheduling; pluggable modules allow new algorithms.
note.zh: 包含 Max C/I、比例公平及轮询无线调度；可插拔模块允许添加新算法。

text.en: Historical LTE/LTE-Advanced user-plane simulation for OMNeT++ and INET.
text.zh: 用于 OMNeT++、INET 的历史 LTE、LTE-Advanced 用户面仿真。

text.en: Models PHY/MAC/RLC, channel feedback, mobility, interference, handover, and D2D.
text.zh: 建模 PHY、MAC、RLC、信道反馈、移动、干扰、切换及 D2D。

text.en: Cross-layer modeling supports system performance analysis; exact recorded metrics depend on the configured modules.
text.zh: 跨层建模支持系统性能分析；确切记录指标取决于配置模块。

text.en: Includes Max C/I, proportional fair, and round-robin radio scheduling; pluggable modules allow new algorithms.
text.zh: 包含 Max C/I、比例公平及轮询无线调度；可插拔模块允许添加新算法。

text.en: C++ implementation with documented OMNeT++ 5.6.2/INET 4.2.2 requirements; project is unmaintained and directs new work to Simu5G.
text.zh: C++ 实现，文档要求 OMNeT++ 5.6.2、INET 4.2.2；项目已停止维护，并引导新项目使用 Simu5G。

tools.name: SLEIPNIR
tools.description: SLEIPNIR is a DAG scheduling simulator focused on mobile cloud/edge/iot infrastructures.

summary.en: SLEIPNIR is a DAG scheduling simulator focused on mobile cloud/edge/iot infrastructures.
summary.zh: 面向移动云、边缘和物联网基础设施的 DAG 任务调度仿真。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: The project scope explicitly includes mobile cloud, edge, and IoT infrastructures.
note.zh: 项目范围明确包括移动云、边缘及物联网基础设施。

note.en: Java/Maven project with JSON or command-line configuration and runnable DAG examples.
note.zh: Java/Maven 工程，提供 JSON 或命令行配置及可运行 DAG 示例。

note.en: Experiment results can be saved with the outfile option; iteration counts are configurable.
note.zh: 可通过 outfile 参数保存实验结果，并配置迭代次数。

text.en: Mobile, edge, and cloud DAG application scheduling simulation, with Apache Spark for parallel experiments.
text.zh: 移动、边缘与云端 DAG 应用调度仿真，使用 Apache Spark 并行运行实验。

text.en: Configures mobile devices, cloud nodes, workloads, file sizes, and mobility traces from SUMO.
text.zh: 配置移动设备、云节点、工作负载、文件大小及 SUMO 移动轨迹。

text.en: Experiment results can be saved with the outfile option; iteration counts are configurable.
text.zh: 可通过 outfile 参数保存实验结果，并配置迭代次数。

text.en: Includes HEFT-based offloading and configurable offloading cost parameters.
text.zh: 包含基于 HEFT 的卸载及可配置卸载成本参数。

text.en: Java/Maven project with JSON or command-line configuration and runnable DAG examples.
text.zh: Java/Maven 工程，提供 JSON 或命令行配置及可运行 DAG 示例。

tools.name: StarryNet
tools.description: A novel experimentation framework that enables researchers to conveniently build credible and flexible experimental network environments (ENE) mimicking satellite dynamics and network behaviors of large-scale integrated space and terrestrial networks (ISTNs) paper.

summary.en: A novel experimentation framework that enables researchers to conveniently build credible and flexible experimental network environments (ENE) mimicking satellite dynamics and network behaviors of large-scale integrated space and terrestrial networks (ISTNs) paper.
summary.zh: 模拟卫星动态与星地网络行为的实验环境。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: Python APIs, JSON configuration, and examples run with Docker on supported Linux systems.
note.zh: Python API、JSON 配置和示例通过 Docker 在支持的 Linux 系统运行。

note.en: Python APIs, JSON configuration, and examples run with Docker on supported Linux systems.
note.zh: Python API、JSON 配置和示例通过 Docker 在支持的 Linux 系统运行。

note.en: APIs collect CPU and memory utilization, routing tables, ping, and throughput experiment outputs.
note.zh: API 收集 CPU 与内存利用率、路由表、ping 及吞吐量实验输出。

note.en: Container-based satellite network emulation using real Linux networking and routing processes.
note.zh: 使用真实 Linux 网络及路由进程的容器化卫星网络仿真环境。

text.en: Container-based satellite network emulation using real Linux networking and routing processes.
text.zh: 使用真实 Linux 网络及路由进程的容器化卫星网络仿真环境。

text.en: Configures satellite constellations, ground stations, link bandwidth and loss, and orbital positions.
text.zh: 配置卫星星座、地面站、链路带宽、丢包及轨道位置。

text.en: APIs collect CPU and memory utilization, routing tables, ping, and throughput experiment outputs.
text.zh: API 收集 CPU 与内存利用率、路由表、ping 及吞吐量实验输出。

text.en: APIs create nodes and links, change next hops, inject failures, and recover nodes; OSPF is the default routing daemon.
text.zh: API 创建节点和链路、更改下一跳、注入故障并恢复节点；默认路由守护进程为 OSPF。

text.en: Python APIs, JSON configuration, and examples run with Docker on supported Linux systems.
text.zh: Python API、JSON 配置和示例通过 Docker 在支持的 Linux 系统运行。

tools.name: Step-ONE
tools.description: Simulated Testbed for Edge-Fog Processes based on the Opportunistic Network Environment simulator.

summary.en: Simulated Testbed for Edge-Fog Processes based on the Opportunistic Network Environment simulator.
summary.zh: 基于 The ONE 的边缘与雾计算进程仿真测试环境。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: Gradle runs configurable examples; a Docker Compose setup provides the Flowable web process modeler.
note.zh: Gradle 运行可配置示例；Docker Compose 提供 Flowable 网页流程建模器。

note.en: Extend the Report base class and event listeners to collect additional statistics; report output and intervals are configurable.
note.zh: 可扩展 Report 基类并接入事件监听以采集额外统计；报告输出与间隔可配置。

note.en: Gradle runs configurable examples; a Docker Compose setup provides the Flowable web process modeler.
note.zh: Gradle 运行可配置示例；Docker Compose 提供 Flowable 网页流程建模器。

note.en: FullBpmReport writes per-process start/end/cancel timestamps, total time and final status through the Report output system.
note.zh: FullBpmReport 通过 Report 输出系统记录每个流程的开始、结束、取消时间、总耗时与最终状态。

text.en: Process-oriented simulation based on The ONE, with BPMN process models.
text.zh: 基于 The ONE 的流程仿真，使用 BPMN 流程模型。

text.en: The compute tutorial configures host groups, movement paths, BPMN applications, and per-process-engine noOfCpus/cpuSpeed parameters. Its example assigns different CPU counts and speeds to two host groups.
text.zh: 计算示例配置主机组、移动路径和 BPMN 应用，并通过 noOfCpus、cpuSpeed 设置流程引擎的 CPU 数量与速度；两个主机组使用不同配置。

text.en: Process reports include timestamps for start, completion and cancellation, elapsed time and final state.
text.zh: 流程报告包含开始、完成与取消时间、耗时和最终状态。

text.en: BPMN models describe application processes; this is not evidence of a general compute-scheduler interface.
text.zh: BPMN 模型描述应用流程；这不能作为通用计算调度接口的依据。

text.en: Gradle runs configurable examples; a Docker Compose setup provides the Flowable web process modeler.
text.zh: Gradle 运行可配置示例；Docker Compose 提供 Flowable 网页流程建模器。

tools.name: SVL Simulator
tools.description: An end-to-end autonomous vehicle simulation platform.

summary.en: An end-to-end autonomous vehicle simulation platform.
summary.zh: 用于自动驾驶研究的端到端仿真平台。

note.en: The add_agent API creates ego vehicles, NPC vehicles, or pedestrians; ego agents load configured sensors. These are traffic and sensor objects in the archived simulator.
note.zh: add_agent API 可创建自车、NPC 车辆或行人，自车加载配置的传感器；这些是归档仿真器中的交通与传感对象。

notes.en: Historical project with a cloud-service dependency; verify service access before selecting it.
notes.zh: 这是依赖云服务的历史项目；选型前应验证服务可访问性。

text.en: Autonomous-driving simulation; the project announced suspension in January 2022.
text.zh: 自动驾驶仿真；项目宣布于 2022 年 1 月停止积极开发。

text.en: The add_agent API creates ego vehicles, NPC vehicles, or pedestrians; ego agents load configured sensors. These are traffic and sensor objects in the archived simulator.
text.zh: add_agent API 可创建自车、NPC 车辆或行人，自车加载配置的传感器；这些是归档仿真器中的交通与传感对象。

text.en: When report generation is enabled, AnalysisManager gathers agent events and sensor analysis measurements into JSON reports. Sensor fields/properties marked AnalysisMeasurement are included; the archived release retains its documented WISE dependency.
text.zh: 启用报告生成时，AnalysisManager 将车辆事件与传感器分析指标汇总为 JSON 报告，包含标记为 AnalysisMeasurement 的字段或属性；该归档版本仍有文档所述 WISE 依赖。

text.en: The controllable/control_policy/set API parses and applies action sequences to controllable scene objects. This controls scenario behavior, with actions constrained by the object implementation.
text.zh: controllable/control_policy/set API 解析并应用可控场景对象的动作序列，用于控制场景行为；可用动作取决于对象实现。

text.en: The 2021.3 release depends on WISE services for asset downloads, configuration, and launching; source availability alone does not confirm that these services remain usable.
text.zh: 2021.3 版本依赖 WISE 服务下载资源、配置及启动；源码可用并不能确认这些服务仍然可用。

tools.name: The ONE
tools.description: The ONE is a simulation environment that is capable of: 1) generating node movement using different movement models. 2) routing messages between nodes with various DTN routing algorithms and sender and receiver types. 3) visualizing both mobility and message passing in real time in its graphical user interface. ONE can import mobility data from real-world traces or other mobility generators. It can also produce a variety of reports from node movement to message passing and general statistics.

summary.en: The ONE is a simulation environment that is capable of: 1) generating node movement using different movement models.
summary.zh: 生成节点移动、模拟 DTN 消息路由并可视化通信过程。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine itself. Consult the listed version and scope before selecting an extension or backend.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎；选择扩展或后端时需查看版本与适用范围。

note.en: Real-time mobility/message GUI, batch runs, configuration files, and platform launch scripts.
note.zh: 提供实时移动与消息 GUI、批量运行、配置文件及平台启动脚本。

note.en: Real-time mobility/message GUI, batch runs, configuration files, and platform launch scripts.
note.zh: 提供实时移动与消息 GUI、批量运行、配置文件及平台启动脚本。

note.en: Reports movement, message transfers, and general statistics.
note.zh: 报告移动、消息传递及一般统计。

text.en: Delay-tolerant/opportunistic network simulation.
text.zh: 容迟及机会网络仿真。

text.en: Movement models and imported traces describe nodes; routers model message forwarding.
text.zh: 移动模型及导入轨迹描述节点；路由器建模消息转发。

text.en: Reports movement, message transfers, and general statistics.
text.zh: 报告移动、消息传递及一般统计。

text.en: Configuration selects DTN routers such as Spray and Wait.
text.zh: 配置选择 Spray and Wait 等 DTN 路由器。

text.en: Real-time mobility/message GUI, batch runs, configuration files, and platform launch scripts.
text.zh: 提供实时移动与消息 GUI、批量运行、配置文件及平台启动脚本。

tools.name: Veins - ITS
tools.description: Veins is an open source framework for running vehicular network simulations. It is based on two well-established simulators: OMNeT++, an event-based network simulator, and SUMO, a road traffic simulator. It extends these to offer a comprehensive suite of models for IVC simulation.

summary.en: Veins is an open source framework for running vehicular network simulations.
summary.zh: 结合 OMNeT++ 与 SUMO 的车联网联合仿真框架。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine itself. Consult the listed version and scope before selecting an extension or backend.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎；选择扩展或后端时需查看版本与适用范围。

text.en: Vehicular network simulation framework.
text.zh: 车联网仿真框架。

text.en: TraCIScenarioManager creates, updates, and removes vehicle and traffic-light modules in response to SUMO. Configurable module types and an update interval connect road mobility to network nodes.
text.zh: TraCIScenarioManager 根据 SUMO 创建、更新和移除车辆及信号灯模块，通过可配置模块类型和更新间隔连接道路移动与网络节点。

text.en: Mac1609_4 records scalar counts for sent/received packets, internal contention, dropped packets, and backoffs, plus accumulated busy time. These outputs characterize the selected 802.11p/MAC simulation.
text.zh: Mac1609_4 记录收发包、内部竞争、丢包和退避次数以及累计忙时，用于描述选定的 802.11p/MAC 仿真。

text.en: The TraCI manager synchronizes simulation steps with SUMO, manages vehicle-module lifecycle, and filters traffic lights. Scenario parameters control connection/start times and mobility updates.
text.zh: TraCI 管理器与 SUMO 同步仿真步长，管理车辆模块生命周期并筛选信号灯；场景参数控制连接、启动时间和移动更新。

text.en: The official README directs users to the Veins website for installation and simulation documentation.
text.zh: 官方 README 引导用户前往 Veins 网站查看安装和仿真文档。

tools.name: Veins LTE - ITS
tools.description: Veins LTE is a simulator for heterogeneous vehicular networks. It provides fine-grained simulation of vehicular networks based on IEEE 802.11p and TE.

summary.en: Veins LTE is a simulator for heterogeneous vehicular networks.
summary.zh: 研究异构车联网通信的 Veins 扩展。

text.en: Heterogeneous vehicular networking integrates Veins, SUMO, and SimuLTE.
text.zh: 异构车联网集成 Veins、SUMO 及 SimuLTE。

text.en: Models IEEE 802.11p, simplified IEEE 1609.4 MAC, LTE data-plane networking, and road traffic.
text.zh: 建模 IEEE 802.11p、简化 IEEE 1609.4 MAC、LTE 数据面网络及道路交通。

text.en: The bundled SimuLTE VoIPReceiver declares frame/playout delay and loss, jitter, MOS, and application throughput statistics. These require the corresponding VoIP application in the historical integrated release.
text.zh: 集成的 SimuLTE VoIPReceiver 声明帧及播放时延、丢失率、抖动、MOS 和应用吞吐量统计，需在该历史集成版本中使用对应 VoIP 应用。

text.en: Supports investigation of heterogeneous vehicular network algorithms on mapped road scenarios.
text.zh: 支持基于道路地图场景研究异构车联网算法。

text.en: OMNeT++ suite with installation guide; website identifies historical release 1.3 from 2016.
text.zh: OMNeT++ 套件，提供安装指南；网站标识 2016 年的历史 1.3 版本。

tools.name: VENTOS
tools.description: VENTOS is an integrated C++ simulator for studying vehicular traffic flows, collaborative driving, and interactions between vehicles and infrastructure through DSRC-enabled wireless communication capability.

summary.en: VENTOS is an integrated C++ simulator for studying vehicular traffic flows, collaborative driving, and interactions between vehicles and infrastructure through DSRC-enabled wireless communication capability.
summary.zh: 结合车辆交通流、协同驾驶与 DSRC 无线通信的 C++ 仿真器。

note.en: C++ simulator with MATLAB plotting scripts and manuals; site says some modules are public while the main repository is private.
note.zh: C++ 仿真器，提供 MATLAB 绘图脚本及手册；网站说明部分模块公开、主要仓库私有。

note.en: C++ simulator with MATLAB plotting scripts and manuals; site says some modules are public while the main repository is private.
note.zh: C++ 仿真器，提供 MATLAB 绘图脚本及手册；网站说明部分模块公开、主要仓库私有。

text.en: Vehicle traffic and collaborative-driving simulation with DSRC communication.
text.zh: 通过 DSRC 通信开展车辆交通及协同驾驶仿真。

text.en: Models manual/ACC/CACC driving, platoons, infrastructure, and an optional Econolite controller connection through SNMP.
text.zh: 建模人工、ACC、CACC 驾驶、车队、基础设施及经 SNMP 接入的可选 Econolite 控制器。

text.en: Studies packet-loss ratio, string stability, average delay, and speed fluctuations.
text.zh: 研究丢包率、串稳定性、平均时延及速度波动。

text.en: Includes platoon maneuvers, traffic-signal policies, dynamic routing, and incident detection.
text.zh: 包含车队动作、交通信号策略、动态路由及事件检测。

text.en: C++ simulator with MATLAB plotting scripts and manuals; site says some modules are public while the main repository is private.
text.zh: C++ 仿真器，提供 MATLAB 绘图脚本及手册；网站说明部分模块公开、主要仓库私有。

tools.name: Vessim
tools.description: A co-simulation testbed for carbon-aware applications, applicable in edge computing environments. Vessim builds on the Mosaik framework, offering a high-level Python API to integrate renewable energy system simulators with real hardware and software-in-the-loop capabilities.

summary.en: A co-simulation testbed for carbon-aware applications, applicable in edge computing environments.
summary.zh: 基于 Mosaik 和 Python 的碳感知应用联合仿真测试床。

note.en: Supports battery dispatch, load shifting, outages, and demand-response experiments.
note.zh: 支持电池调度、负荷转移、停电及需求响应实验。

note.en: Python package with runnable microgrid scenarios; software-in-the-loop requires its additional extension.
note.zh: Python 软件包，提供可运行微电网场景；软件在环需要额外扩展。

note.en: Microgrid co-simulation with an optional software-in-the-loop extension that connects real software and hardware.
note.zh: 微电网协同仿真；可选软件在环扩展可连接真实软件和硬件。

text.en: Microgrid co-simulation with an optional software-in-the-loop extension that connects real software and hardware.
text.zh: 微电网协同仿真；可选软件在环扩展可连接真实软件和硬件。

text.en: Models electrical loads, renewable generation, energy storage, and grid interaction.
text.zh: 建模用电负载、可再生能源发电、储能及电网交互。

text.en: Studies energy, carbon, and electricity-price effects; REST and Prometheus connections belong to the optional integration layer.
text.zh: 研究能源、碳排放与电价影响；REST 和 Prometheus 连接属于可选集成层。

text.en: Supports battery dispatch, load shifting, outages, and demand-response experiments.
text.zh: 支持电池调度、负荷转移、停电及需求响应实验。

text.en: Python package with runnable microgrid scenarios; software-in-the-loop requires its additional extension.
text.zh: Python 软件包，提供可运行微电网场景；软件在环需要额外扩展。

tools.name: VirtFogSim
tools.description: VirtFogSim is a MATLAB-supported software toolbox that allows the dynamic joint optimization and tracking of the energy and delay performance of Mobile-Fog-Cloud systems for the execution of applications described by general Directed Application Graphs (DAGs). Check the paper link for more details.

summary.en: VirtFogSim is a MATLAB-supported software toolbox that allows the dynamic joint optimization and tracking of the energy and delay performance of Mobile-Fog-Cloud systems for the execution of applications described by general Directed Application Graphs (DAGs).
summary.zh: 使用 MATLAB 研究移动、雾和云环境的任务分配、能耗与时延。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: MATLAB scripts and a GUI produce plots in multiple formats; the documented release is version 4 from January 2019.
note.zh: MATLAB 脚本与 GUI 可输出多种格式图表；文档版本为 2019 年 1 月的第 4 版。

note.en: MATLAB scripts and a GUI produce plots in multiple formats; the documented release is version 4 from January 2019.
note.zh: MATLAB 脚本与 GUI 可输出多种格式图表；文档版本为 2019 年 1 月的第 4 版。

text.en: Mobile-fog-cloud DAG application simulation and energy-delay optimization.
text.zh: 移动、雾与云端 DAG 应用仿真及能耗—时延优化。

text.zh: 同时建模计算、网络资源及任务依赖。

text.zh: 在应用执行时间约束下评估能耗与时延。

text.zh: 联合优化任务放置及计算、网络资源分配。

text.en: MATLAB scripts and a GUI produce plots in multiple formats; the documented release is version 4 from January 2019.
text.zh: MATLAB 脚本与 GUI 可输出多种格式图表；文档版本为 2019 年 1 月的第 4 版。

tools.name: VNS
tools.description: VNS is a simulation framework that completely integrates the mobility and network components in a transparent and efficient way, reducing the overhead of communication and synchronization between different simulators. VNS provides bi-directionally interaction between a microscopic mobility model and network simulators such as OMNeT++.

summary.en: VNS is a simulation framework that completely integrates the mobility and network components in a transparent and efficient way, reducing the overhead of communication and synchronization between different simulators.
summary.zh: 集成移动行为与网络通信的仿真框架。

note.en: TravelStatsModule accumulates elapsed simulation time and distance between vehicle positions at each step, then prints vehicle ID, travel time, and traveled distance when removed.
note.zh: TravelStatsModule 按步累加模拟时间及车辆位置间距离，在移除时输出车辆编号、行驶时间和行驶距离。

notes.en: Historical OMNeT++ 4-era project; original-site availability has not been restored.

text.en: Vehicular simulation integrates mobility and networking.
text.zh: 车辆仿真集成移动性与网络。

text.en: Bidirectional coupling connects a microscopic mobility model to network simulators such as OMNeT++.
text.zh: 双向耦合连接微观移动模型及 OMNeT++ 等网络仿真器。

text.en: TravelStatsModule accumulates elapsed simulation time and distance between vehicle positions at each step, then prints vehicle ID, travel time, and traveled distance when removed.
text.zh: TravelStatsModule 按步累加模拟时间及车辆位置间距离，在移除时输出车辆编号、行驶时间和行驶距离。

text.en: FixedTimeTrafficLightController configures lane lights, phase colors/durations, and a time offset; phase transitions are scheduled on the simulator event scheduler. This manages road traffic signals.
text.zh: FixedTimeTrafficLightController 配置车道信号灯、相位颜色与时长及时间偏移，通过模拟器事件调度器切换相位；管理对象是道路交通信号。

text.en: The official OMNeT++ catalog links surviving code repositories and reports that the original project website is unavailable.
text.zh: OMNeT++ 官方目录链接仍保留的源码仓库，并说明原项目网站已不可用。

tools.name: WoTemu
tools.description: An emulator for Python applications to help in the design of IoT deployments based on the edge computing model. It is focused on the Web of Things paradigm by offering extended support for applications programmed with WoTPy.

summary.en: An emulator for Python applications to help in the design of IoT deployments based on the edge computing model.
summary.zh: 面向 Python Web of Things 应用的边缘物联网实验环境。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: The README describes IoT deployment experiments based on edge computing.
note.zh: README 描述基于边缘计算模型的物联网部署实验。

note.en: Runs real Python WoTPy applications in a Docker Swarm emulation environment.
note.zh: 在 Docker Swarm 仿真环境中运行真实 Python WoTPy 应用。

note.en: Models network conditions with NetEm and iptables; supports HTTP, CoAP, WebSocket, and MQTT communication.
note.zh: 通过 NetEm 和 iptables 建模网络条件；支持 HTTP、CoAP、WebSocket 和 MQTT 通信。

note.en: Python topology definitions generate Compose deployments; command-line steps run, stop, and report experiments.
note.zh: Python 拓扑定义生成 Compose 部署；命令行步骤用于运行、停止和生成实验报告。

note.en: Python topology definitions generate Compose deployments; command-line steps run, stop, and report experiments.
note.zh: Python 拓扑定义生成 Compose 部署；命令行步骤用于运行、停止和生成实验报告。

note.zh: 周期性采集节点指标至 Redis，并生成 HTML 实验报告。

note.en: Runs real Python WoTPy applications in a Docker Swarm emulation environment.
note.zh: 在 Docker Swarm 仿真环境中运行真实 Python WoTPy 应用。

text.en: Runs real Python WoTPy applications in a Docker Swarm emulation environment.
text.zh: 在 Docker Swarm 仿真环境中运行真实 Python WoTPy 应用。

text.zh: 通过 NetEm 和 iptables 建模网络条件；支持 HTTP、CoAP、WebSocket 和 MQTT 通信。

text.en: Periodically collects node metrics into Redis and generates HTML experiment reports.
text.zh: 周期性采集节点指标至 Redis，并生成 HTML 实验报告。

text.zh: Docker Swarm 提供副本与恢复；拓扑脚本定义仿真部署。

text.zh: Python 拓扑定义生成 Compose 部署；命令行步骤用于运行、停止和生成实验报告。

tools.name: YAFS
tools.description: YAFS is a simulator tool based on Python of architectures such as: Fog Computing ecosystems for several analysis regarding with the placement of resources, cost deployment, network design, ... IoT environments are the most evident fact of this type of architecture. The highlights points of YAFS are: Dinamyc topology: entities and network links can be created or removed along the simulation. Dinamyc creation of messages sources: sensors can generate messages from different point access along the simulation. And for hence, the placement allocation algorithm and the orchestration algorithm, that are extended by the user, can run along the simulation. The topology of the network is based on Complex Network theory. Thus, the algorithms can obtain more valuable indicators from topological features. The results are stored in a raw format in a nosql database. The simpler the format, the easier it is to perform any type of statistics.

summary.en: YAFS is a simulator tool based on Python of architectures such as: Fog Computing ecosystems for several analysis regarding with the placement of resources, cost deployment, network design, ...
summary.zh: 使用 Python 研究雾计算拓扑、资源放置、调度与路由。

note.en: Catalog classification based on the project’s stated simulation or execution model.
note.zh: 按项目说明的仿真或执行模型进行目录分类。

note.en: Pinned source/build dependencies establish this execution stack; this does not import every dependency feature.
note.zh: 固定提交源码或构建依赖明确使用此执行栈，不据此继承依赖的全部功能。

note.en: The basic tutorial draws network topology with NetworkX/Matplotlib and exports GEXF for tools such as Gephi; this is example-based topology visualization.
note.zh: 基础教程使用 NetworkX/Matplotlib 绘制拓扑，并导出 GEXF 供 Gephi 等工具查看；属于示例提供的拓扑可视化。

note.en: deploy_monitor invokes a user callback on a supplied time distribution, allowing custom observations; collection and persistence must be implemented in that callback.
note.zh: deploy_monitor 按指定时间分布调用用户回调，可加入自定义观测；采集与持久化需在回调中实现。

note.zh: Python 仿真器，提供可运行示例；3.1 版本文档采用 Python 3.12 和 uv，部分示例列出较旧环境。

tools.name: AimDB
tools.description: An async, in-memory data bridge that syncs records across microcontrollers, edge gateways and cloud instances. Define once, stream and sync everywhere. Same API from MCU to cloud with Tokio and Embassy support for no_std/embedded environments.

summary.zh: 在微控制器、边缘网关和云之间同步数据的内存数据桥。

note.zh: Cargo 示例和 Docker Compose 气象网络演示 MQTT 集成。

note.zh: 入门示例使用上下文日志 API；提交的基准包含内存分配基线。

note.zh: 类型化 Rust 数据管道跨微控制器、网关、云及浏览器执行。

text.zh: 类型化 Rust 数据管道跨微控制器、网关、云及浏览器执行。

text.en: The quick-start uses the context logging API; committed benchmarks include allocation baselines.
text.zh: 入门示例使用上下文日志 API；提交的基准包含内存分配基线。

text.en: Typed contracts, explicit migrations, and configurable buffers govern data movement.
text.zh: 类型契约、显式迁移及可配置缓冲区管理数据流动。

text.en: Cargo examples and a Docker Compose weather mesh demonstrate MQTT integration.
text.zh: Cargo 示例和 Docker Compose 气象网络演示 MQTT 集成。

tools.name: Akraino Edge Stack
tools.description: Akraino is a set of open infrastructures and application blueprints for the Edge, spanning a broad variety of use cases, including 5G, AI, Edge IaaS/PaaS, IoT, for both provider and enterprise edge domains. These Blueprints have been created by the Akraino community and focus exclusively on the edge in all of its different forms. What unites all of these blueprints is that they have been tested by the community and are ready for adoption as-is, or used as a starting point for customizing a new edge blueprint.

summary.en: Akraino is a set of open infrastructures and application blueprints for the Edge, spanning a broad variety of use cases, including 5G, AI, Edge IaaS/PaaS, IoT, for both provider and enterprise edge domains.
summary.zh: 面向不同边缘场景的开放基础设施与应用蓝图集合。

text.en: Collection of edge infrastructure and application blueprints.
text.zh: 边缘基础设施及应用蓝图集合。

text.en: Use cases include 5G, AI, IoT, and edge IaaS/PaaS; concrete resources depend on the blueprint.
text.zh: 用例包括 5G、AI、IoT 及边缘 IaaS、PaaS；具体资源取决于蓝图。

text.en: Validation and capacity criteria are blueprint-specific, not a single shared simulator metric interface.
text.zh: 验证及容量标准依赖蓝图，并非统一仿真器指标接口。

text.en: Blueprints combine provisioning, lifecycle management, and modular infrastructure components.
text.zh: 蓝图组合供应、生命周期管理及模块化基础设施组件。

text.en: Published blueprints can be adopted or customized; capabilities must be checked for the chosen blueprint.
text.zh: 可使用或定制公开蓝图；需要核对所选蓝图的具体能力。

tools.name: Apache Edgent(incubating)
tools.description: Apache Edgent is a programming model and micro-kernel style runtime that can be embedded in gateways and small footprint edge devices enabling local, real-time, analytics on the continuous streams of data coming from equipment, vehicles, systems, appliances, devices and sensors of all kinds (for example, Raspberry Pis or smart phones). Working in conjunction with centralized analytic systems, Apache Edgent provides efficient and timely analytics across the whole IoT ecosystem: from the center to the edge.

summary.en: Apache Edgent is a programming model and micro-kernel style runtime that can be embedded in gateways and small footprint edge devices enabling local, real-time, analytics on the continuous streams of data coming from equipment, vehicles, systems, appliances, devices and sensors of all kinds (for example, Raspberry Pis or smart phones).
summary.zh: 可嵌入网关和小型设备的流数据分析编程模型与运行时。

note.en: The historical runtime describes analyzing data on distributed IoT and mobile devices.
note.zh: 历史运行时说明在分布式物联网及移动设备上分析数据。

note.en: Historical edge stream-processing runtime executes local analytics.
note.zh: 历史边缘流处理运行时执行本地分析。

notes.en: The official GitHub repository was archived at the review date. Verify dependency compatibility before using this historical version.
notes.zh: 核查时官方 GitHub 仓库已归档；使用历史版本前需检查依赖兼容性。

notes.en: Apache records retirement on November 20, 2019.
notes.zh: Apache 记录项目于 2019 年 11 月 20 日退役。

text.en: Historical edge stream-processing runtime executes local analytics.
text.zh: 历史边缘流处理运行时执行本地分析。

text.en: Consumes device and sensor events and can connect to backend analytics.
text.zh: 处理设备及传感器事件，并可连接后端分析。

text.en: Applications can analyze values or error logs and decide when to report abnormal conditions.
text.zh: 应用可分析数值或错误日志，并决定何时上报异常。

text.en: Local filtering reduces data sent to backend systems.
text.zh: 本地过滤减少发送到后端系统的数据。

text.en: Programming model, connectors, samples, and documentation; the current Apache project-status page records retirement.
text.zh: 提供编程模型、连接器、示例及文档；当前 Apache 项目状态页记录已退役。

note.en: Distributed serverless platform executes event-triggered functions.
note.zh: 分布式无服务器平台执行事件触发函数。
