text.zh: 控制器、执行器指标及激活事件报告排队等待、冷启动初始化、执行时长、状态和配置内存上限；部署并配置 user-events 服务后可导出 Prometheus/Datadog 指标。

text.en: Manages function infrastructure and scaling; triggers and feeds schedule actions in response to events or HTTP requests.
text.zh: 管理函数基础设施及扩缩容；触发器与事件源响应事件或 HTTP 请求调度动作。

text.en: REST API and wsk CLI; multiple language runtimes and custom Docker/ZIP actions are documented.
text.zh: 提供 REST API 和 wsk 命令行；文档说明多语言运行时及自定义 Docker、ZIP 动作。

tools.name: AREG SDK
tools.description: AREG SDK is an interface-centric real-time asynchronous communication engine to enable distributed- and mist-computing, where connected Things interact and provide services as if they act like thin distributed servers. The communication engine of AREG SDK is based on Object Remote Procedure Call (ORPC) protocol.

summary.en: AREG SDK is an interface-centric real-time asynchronous communication engine to enable distributed- and mist-computing, where connected Things interact and provide services as if they act like thin distributed servers.
summary.zh: 面向分布式与雾端计算的异步通信和服务交互引擎。

note.en: Mist device clusters and edge gateways use the same service interfaces inside trusted networks.
note.zh: Mist 设备集群与边缘网关在受信网络中使用同一套服务接口。

note.en: Mist device clusters and edge gateways use the same service interfaces inside trusted networks.
note.zh: Mist 设备集群与边缘网关在受信网络中使用同一套服务接口。

note.en: Mist device clusters and edge gateways use the same service interfaces inside trusted networks.
note.zh: Mist 设备集群与边缘网关在受信网络中使用同一套服务接口。

note.en: C++ middleware runs services across threads, processes, and networked devices.
note.zh: C++ 中间件跨线程、进程和联网设备运行服务。

text.en: C++ middleware runs services across threads, processes, and networked devices.
text.zh: C++ 中间件跨线程、进程和联网设备运行服务。

text.en: Manages threads, IPC, service discovery, message dispatch, and reconnection.
text.zh: 管理线程、进程间通信、服务发现、消息分发及重连。

text.en: Links latency and data-rate benchmarks; results require the linked benchmark conditions.
text.zh: 链接时延与数据速率基准；结果需结合所链接的实验条件理解。

text.en: Service configuration controls deployment; failed components and dependent connections can recover.
text.zh: 服务配置控制部署；支持组件及依赖连接故障恢复。

text.en: C++ SDK with documentation and example projects; RTOS hard real-time targets are listed as planned.
text.zh: C++ SDK 提供文档与示例工程；RTOS 硬实时目标被列为计划功能。

tools.name: Baetyl
tools.description: Baetyl is an open edge computing framework of Linux Foundation Edge that extends cloud computing, data and service seamlessly to edge devices. It can provide temporary offline, low-latency computing services include device connection, message routing, remote synchronization, function computing, video capture, AI inference, status reporting, configuration ota etc.

summary.en: Baetyl is an open edge computing framework of Linux Foundation Edge that extends cloud computing, data and service seamlessly to edge devices.
summary.zh: 将云端数据、服务和计算扩展到边缘设备的框架。

note.en: Cloud-managed edge framework deploys real container and function applications.
note.zh: 云端管理的边缘框架部署真实容器和函数应用。

text.en: Cloud-managed edge framework deploys real container and function applications.
text.zh: 云端管理的边缘框架部署真实容器和函数应用。

text.en: Version 2 uses Kubernetes or K3s on Linux amd64, arm64, or armv7; minimum recommendations are installation requirements, not scale limits.
text.zh: 第 2 版使用 Kubernetes 或 K3s，支持 Linux amd64、arm64、armv7；最低推荐配置属于安装要求，并非规模上限。

text.en: Reports node and application status to the cloud management suite.
text.zh: 向云管理套件报告节点及应用状态。

text.en: Manages node matching, application deployment, configuration, secrets, and OTA synchronization.
text.zh: 管理节点匹配、应用部署、配置、密钥及 OTA 同步。

text.en: Go framework with a separate cloud suite; Native mode and edge clusters are described as future work in this snapshot.
text.zh: Go 框架及独立云管理套件；此快照将 Native 模式和边缘集群列为未来工作。

tools.name: Bochs
tools.description: Bochs is a highly portable open source IA-32 (x86) PC emulator written in C++, that runs on most popular platforms. It includes emulation of the Intel x86 CPU, common I/O devices, and a custom BIOS. Bochs can be compiled to emulate many different x86 CPUs, from early 386 to the most recent x86-64 Intel and AMD processors which may even not reached the market yet.

summary.en: Bochs is a highly portable open source IA-32 (x86) PC emulator written in C++, that runs on most popular platforms.
summary.zh: 用 C++ 实现的 IA-32 PC 仿真器，包含处理器和常见设备模型。

note.en: Portable C++ project with user/developer guides and graphical guest display.
note.zh: 可移植 C++ 项目，提供用户、开发指南及图形化客户机显示。

note.en: Emulates an x86 PC and executes guest operating systems and software.
note.zh: 仿真 x86 计算机并执行客户操作系统及软件。

text.en: Emulates an x86 PC and executes guest operating systems and software.
text.zh: 仿真 x86 计算机并执行客户操作系统及软件。

text.en: Includes CPU, memory, I/O devices, and BIOS, with configurable processor generations.
text.zh: 包含 CPU、内存、I/O 设备及 BIOS，可配置处理器代际。

text.en: The compiled-in debugger exposes simulated ticks with ptime, CPU/device state, instruction traces, and memory-access traces. Custom instrumentation requires building a separate instrumentation library; the default library contains stubs.
text.zh: 编译启用内部调试器后，可通过 ptime 查看模拟时钟 tick，以及 CPU/设备状态、指令和内存访问轨迹。自定义插桩需编译独立插桩库，默认库仅包含桩函数。

text.en: Provides complete PC emulation; deployment capacity depends on the emulated configuration and host.
text.zh: 提供完整计算机仿真；部署能力依赖仿真配置及宿主机。

text.en: Portable C++ project with user/developer guides and graphical guest display.
text.zh: 可移植 C++ 项目，提供用户、开发指南及图形化客户机显示。

tools.name: BOINC
tools.description: BOINC lets you help cutting-edge science research using your computer. The BOINC app, running on your computer, downloads scientific computing jobs and runs them invisibly in the background.

summary.en: BOINC lets you help cutting-edge science research using your computer.
summary.zh: 通过参与者计算机执行科学计算任务的志愿计算平台。

note.en: Volunteer-computing platform runs distributed high-throughput workloads.
note.zh: 志愿计算平台运行分布式高吞吐工作负载。

text.en: Volunteer-computing platform runs distributed high-throughput workloads.
text.zh: 志愿计算平台运行分布式高吞吐工作负载。

text.en: Uses volunteered home computers and other contributed resources.
text.zh: 使用志愿家庭计算机及其他贡献资源。

text.en: The client runs parallel CPU benchmarks and records floating-point and integer performance estimates for the host. These host calibration values inform workload handling and are separate from application result quality.
text.zh: 客户端并行执行 CPU 基准，记录宿主机浮点与整数性能估计；这些宿主机校准值用于工作负载处理，需与应用结果质量区分。

text.en: Coordinates volunteer computing; detailed policies are documented outside the short root README.
text.zh: 协调志愿计算；具体策略位于简短根 README 之外的文档。

text.en: Source repository and project wiki provide user/developer entry points.
text.zh: 源码仓库及项目 Wiki 提供用户、开发入口。

tools.name: Chameleon
tools.description: Chameleon is a large-scale, deeply reconfigurable experimental platform built to support Computer Sciences systems research. Community projects range from systems research developing new operating systems, virtualization methods, performance variability studies, and power management research to projects in software defined networking, artificial intelligence, and resource management.

summary.en: Chameleon is a large-scale, deeply reconfigurable experimental platform built to support Computer Sciences systems research.
summary.zh: 面向实验研究的云计算与边缘计算测试设施。

text.en: Experimental infrastructure for edge-to-cloud research.
text.zh: 用于边缘到云研究的实验基础设施。

text.en: Hardware discovery and CHI@Edge entry points expose testbed resources.
text.zh: 硬件发现及 CHI@Edge 入口提供试验平台资源。

text.en: The current power guide documents IPMI/DCMI system readings and application energy measurement with etrace2/Intel RAPL; Prometheus/Grafana support longer collection. Availability varies by node type, with limited FPGA/ARM support.
text.zh: 当前功耗指南介绍 IPMI/DCMI 整机读数、etrace2/Intel RAPL 应用能量测量，以及用于持续采集的 Prometheus/Grafana；可用性取决于节点类型，FPGA/ARM 支持有限。

text.en: Resource access depends on the selected testbed site and allocation.
text.zh: 资源访问依赖所选试验站点及分配。

text.en: Web portal with documentation, Jupyter, and Trovi experiment-sharing entry points.
text.zh: 网页门户提供文档、Jupyter 及 Trovi 实验共享入口。

tools.name: Distributed Storm
tools.description: Distributed Storm is an extension of Apache Storm that supports the execution of distributed, adaptive, and QoS-aware scheduling algorithms. It introduces some key components on each worker node that enhance the system with adaptation capabilities, relying on a MAPE (Monitor, Analyze, Plan, and Execute) feedback loop periodically executed. Specifically, the newly introduced components are: the AdaptiveSchedulers, the QoSMonitors, and the WorkerMonitors. Logics of a Bolt can be regarded as an edge server processes the data.

summary.en: Distributed Storm is an extension of Apache Storm that supports the execution of distributed, adaptive, and QoS-aware scheduling algorithms.
summary.zh: 扩展 Apache Storm，支持分布式、自适应和 QoS 感知的调度策略。

note.en: Apache Storm extension executes adaptive distributed stream-processing placement.
note.zh: Apache Storm 扩展执行自适应分布式流处理放置。

text.en: Apache Storm extension executes adaptive distributed stream-processing placement.
text.zh: Apache Storm 扩展执行自适应分布式流处理放置。

text.en: Worker and supervisor components observe network and node conditions.
text.zh: 工作进程及 Supervisor 组件观察网络和节点条件。

text.en: QoSMonitor estimates inter-node latency and node utilization; WorkerMonitor computes component data rates.
text.zh: QoSMonitor 估计节点间时延和节点利用率；WorkerMonitor 计算组件数据速率。

text.en: AdaptiveScheduler runs distributed placement using monitoring feedback, including round robin and a Pietzuch-derived policy.
text.zh: AdaptiveScheduler 根据监测反馈进行分布式放置，包含轮询及基于 Pietzuch 的策略。

text.en: Research extension with documentation and source; the site labels the implementation unstable.
text.zh: 研究扩展，提供文档及源码；网站将实现标为不稳定。

tools.name: ENORM
tools.description: The ENORM framework primarily addresses the deployment and load balancing challenges on individual edge nodes. ENORM operates in a three-tier environment, but a master controller does not control the edge nodes. Instead, it is assumed that they are visible to cloud servers that may want to make use of the edge. The framework allows for partitioning a cloud server and offloading it to edge nodes for improving the overall QoS of the application.

summary.en: The ENORM framework primarily addresses the deployment and load balancing challenges on individual edge nodes.
summary.zh: 面向边缘环境的资源管理框架。

note.en: Research prototype runs edge services for a cloud-connected mobile application.
note.zh: 研究原型为连接云端的移动应用运行边缘服务。

text.en: Research prototype runs edge services for a cloud-connected mobile application.
text.zh: 研究原型为连接云端的移动应用运行边缘服务。

text.en: Targets single-board edge computers such as Odroid in a multitenant hierarchy.
text.zh: 面向多租户分层环境中的 Odroid 等边缘单板计算机。

text.en: The edge monitor derives average application compute latency from startTime/endTime pairs in container serverLog files and updates application state periodically.
text.zh: 边缘监控器从容器 serverLog 的 startTime／endTime 配对计算平均应用计算时延，并周期性更新应用状态。

text.en: Dynamically allocates resources to hosted edge services.
text.zh: 为托管边缘服务动态分配资源。

text.en: The iPokeMon example includes cloud server, client, edge manager, and cloud manager setup; the README warns that the prototype is developing.
text.zh: iPokeMon 示例包含云服务器、客户端、边缘及云管理器配置；README 提示原型仍在开发。

tools.name: EdgeGallery
tools.description: EdgeGallery is a 5G edge computing open source project supported by device vendors, operators, vertical industry partners, etc. Its goal is to create a public platform for edge computing that meets the characteristics of 5G MEC "connectivity and computation", standardize open network capabilities (especially for 5G networks), and generalize the lifecycle-management process of MEC application development (testing, migration, and operation).

summary.en: EdgeGallery is a 5G edge computing open source project supported by device vendors, operators, vertical industry partners, etc.
summary.zh: 面向 MEC 应用开发与边缘服务生态的平台，提供中文文档。

note.en: Chinese version manuals and Go/Java components; the developer platform includes a separate frontend interface.
note.zh: 提供中文版本手册及 Go、Java 组件；开发者平台包含独立前端界面。

text.en: MEC platform family for edge applications and cloud interconnection.
text.zh: 用于边缘应用及云互联的 MEC 平台系列。

text.en: Separate MEP, orchestration, application-store, developer, and installer repositories define component scope.
text.zh: 独立 MEP、编排、应用商店、开发者及安装仓库定义组件范围。

text.en: Version 1.5.0 documents VM state and metric displays in MECM resource management, OpenStack/filesystem resource statistics, and periodic edge-node checks. The release note establishes these monitoring functions without defining every metric field.
text.zh: 1.5.0 发布说明列出 MECM 资源管理中的虚拟机状态与度量指标展示、OpenStack/文件系统资源统计及周期性边缘节点检查；该说明确认这些监测功能，未逐项定义指标字段。

text.en: MECM APP orchestration parses and orchestrates application packages.
text.zh: MECM APP 编排模块解析及编排应用包。

text.en: Chinese version manuals and Go/Java components; the developer platform includes a separate frontend interface.
text.zh: 提供中文版本手册及 Go、Java 组件；开发者平台包含独立前端界面。

tools.name: EdgeMesh
tools.description: EdgeMesh is a part of KubeEdge, and provides a simple network solution for the inter-communications between services at edge scenarios.

summary.en: EdgeMesh is a part of KubeEdge, and provides a simple network solution for the inter-communications between services at edge scenarios.
summary.zh: 面向边缘应用的网络通信与服务连接组件。

note.en: KubeEdge data plane provides discovery and proxies traffic between real edge applications.
note.zh: KubeEdge 数据面为真实边缘应用提供服务发现和流量代理。

text.en: KubeEdge data plane provides discovery and proxies traffic between real edge applications.
text.zh: KubeEdge 数据面为真实边缘应用提供服务发现和流量代理。

text.en: LibP2P tunnels, DNS, iptables, and relays connect subnets; protocols include HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, and WebSocket.
text.zh: 通过 LibP2P 隧道、DNS、iptables 和中继连接子网；协议包括 HTTP、HTTPS、TCP、UDP 和 WebSocket。

text.en: EnableProfiling starts an HTTP server with Go pprof CPU-profile, trace, symbol, and index endpoints at the configured address/port. This profiles the agent process and requires explicit configuration.
text.zh: EnableProfiling 在配置地址与端口启动 HTTP 服务，提供 Go pprof CPU 分析、trace、symbol 和索引接口；用于分析代理进程，需显式配置。

text.en: Includes random and round-robin balancing and session persistence; selectable policies do not establish a custom-scheduler API.
text.zh: 包含随机、轮询负载均衡及会话保持；可选择策略不等同于可自定义调度器接口。

text.en: Go agent with installation documentation and protocol test cases; edge CNI is marked beta.
text.zh: Go 代理，提供安装文档及协议测试用例；边缘 CNI 标记为 beta。

tools.name: EdgeX Foundry
tools.description: EdgeX Foundry is a highly flexible and scalable open source software framework that facilitates interoperability between devices and applications at the IoT Edge.

summary.en: EdgeX Foundry is a highly flexible and scalable open source software framework that facilitates interoperability between devices and applications at the IoT Edge.
summary.zh: 面向物联网边缘设备和服务互操作的框架。

note.en: Modular middleware connects real IoT devices and edge applications.
note.zh: 模块化中间件连接真实物联网设备及边缘应用。

text.en: Modular middleware connects real IoT devices and edge applications.
text.zh: 模块化中间件连接真实物联网设备及边缘应用。

text.en: Bridges sensors, actuators, and OT/IT systems through replaceable components.
text.zh: 通过可替换组件连接传感器、执行器及 OT、IT 系统。

text.en: Application services report received/invalid messages, pipeline processing, export errors, and HTTP/MQTT export sizes. Reporting is disabled by default; enable the selected Writable.Telemetry.Metrics entries and configure the interval.
text.zh: 应用服务指标包含接收及无效消息、流水线处理、导出错误和 HTTP/MQTT 导出大小。默认关闭上报，需启用相应 Writable.Telemetry.Metrics 项并配置周期。

text.en: Plug-in microservices allow adding analytics and device/application connectors.
text.zh: 插件式微服务允许添加分析及设备、应用连接器。

text.en: Official site provides software downloads, versioned releases, and platform documentation.
text.zh: 官网提供软件下载、版本发布及平台文档。

tools.name: Folding@home
tools.description: Folding@home (FAH or F@h) is a distributed computing project for simulating protein dynamics, including the process of protein folding and the movements of proteins implicated in a variety of diseases. It brings together citizen scientists who volunteer to run simulations of protein dynamics on their personal computers and scientific researchers. Insights from these data are helping scientists to better understand biology and providing new opportunities for developing therapeutics.

summary.en: Folding@home (FAH or F@h) is a distributed computing project for simulating protein dynamics, including the process of protein folding and the movements of proteins implicated in a variety of diseases.
summary.zh: 通过分布式志愿计算支持分子模拟等科学研究。

note.en: Volunteer computers execute biomedical simulation work units.
note.zh: 志愿者计算机执行生物医学仿真工作单元。

text.en: Volunteer computers execute biomedical simulation work units.
text.zh: 志愿者计算机执行生物医学仿真工作单元。

text.en: Uses donated host computing resources, with GPU participation described.
text.zh: 使用捐赠的主机计算资源，并说明 GPU 参与方式。

text.en: Project provides donor/team statistics and points; site-wide compute figures are aggregate historical reports.
text.zh: 项目提供捐赠者、团队统计及积分；网站计算量数字为汇总历史报告。

text.en: Client downloads work, executes it in the background, and returns results.
text.zh: 客户端下载任务，在后台执行并返回结果。

text.en: Installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux with client guides and statistics pages.
text.zh: 提供 Windows、macOS、Linux 安装程序、客户端指南及统计页面。

tools.name: FogAtlas
tools.description: FogAtlas (evolution of the former Foggy platform) is a software framework aiming to manage a geographically distributed and decentralized Cloud Computing infrastructure that provides computational, storage and network services close to the data sources and the users, embracing the Fog Computing paradigm. FogAtlas is able to manage the so called Cloud-to-Thing Continuum offering service-aware workload placement and zero-touch deployment. It is an evolution of the well known paradigms of IaaS and PaaS adding the concept of “locality” to the traditional Cloud Computing model and easing the operations of a Fog Computing infrastructure.

summary.en: FogAtlas (evolution of the former Foggy platform) is a software framework aiming to manage a geographically distributed and decentralized Cloud Computing infrastructure that provides computational, storage and network services close to the data sources and the users, embracing the Fog Computing paradigm.
summary.zh: 管理分布式雾计算基础设施与应用的框架。

accessNote.en: The project URL redirects to a Google sign-in page; public technical details were not accessible.
accessNote.zh: 项目网址跳转到 Google 登录页，公开技术细节不可访问。

tools.name: FogFlow
tools.description: FogFlow is an IoT edge computing framework to automatically orchestrate dynamic data processing flows over cloud and edges driven by context, including system context on the available system resources from all layers, data context on the registered metadata of all available data entities, and also usage context on the expected QoS defined by users.

summary.en: FogFlow is an IoT edge computing framework to automatically orchestrate dynamic data processing flows over cloud and edges driven by context, including system context on the available system resources from all layers, data context on the registered metadata of all available data entities, and also usage context on the expected QoS defined by users.
summary.zh: 支持边缘与云之间分布式数据处理的编程与运行框架。

note.en: Runs context-driven IoT processing flows across cloud and edge.
note.zh: 跨云和边缘运行上下文驱动的物联网处理流程。

text.en: Runs context-driven IoT processing flows across cloud and edge.
text.zh: 跨云和边缘运行上下文驱动的物联网处理流程。

text.en: Uses available resources, registered data metadata, and user QoS context.
text.zh: 使用可用资源、已注册数据元信息及用户 QoS 上下文。

text.en: README latency and device-count examples describe motivating requirements, not measured capacity guarantees.
text.zh: README 中的时延和设备数示例描述需求动机，不是实测容量保证。

text.en: Dynamically launches processing and places tasks using producer and consumer locality.
text.zh: 动态启动处理，并根据生产者与消费者位置放置任务。

text.en: Docker distribution with installation, API, and end-to-end test documentation.
text.zh: 通过 Docker 分发，提供安装、API 及端到端测试文档。

tools.name: ForestHub edge-agents
tools.description: The ~30 MB open-source edge AI agent runtime from ForestHub. Runs offline on Linux edge devices (Raspberry Pi, Jetson, industrial gateways), with GPIO/UART/MQTT as first-class nodes and local SLMs alongside cloud LLMs. Engine ships as a distroless container; visual builder included.

summary.en: The ~30 MB open-source edge AI agent runtime from ForestHub.
summary.zh: 在 Linux 边缘设备上运行可组合 AI 工作流和本地模型。

note.en: Go runtime with JSON workflows, a CLI, and a visual workflow builder.
note.zh: Go 运行时，提供 JSON 工作流、命令行及可视化工作流编辑器。

note.en: Go runtime with JSON workflows, a CLI, and a visual workflow builder.
note.zh: Go 运行时，提供 JSON 工作流、命令行及可视化工作流编辑器。

note.en: Engine logs go to stdout; liveness is observed externally through container exit.
note.zh: 引擎日志输出至 stdout；通过容器退出状态在外部观察存活性。

note.en: Runs offline AI workflows and device I/O on Linux edge hardware.
note.zh: 在 Linux 边缘硬件运行离线 AI 工作流与设备 I/O。

text.en: Runs offline AI workflows and device I/O on Linux edge hardware.
text.zh: 在 Linux 边缘硬件运行离线 AI 工作流与设备 I/O。

text.en: Supports GPIO, UART, MQTT, local model providers, and arm64/amd64 containers.
text.zh: 支持 GPIO、UART、MQTT、本地模型供应端及 arm64/amd64 容器。

text.en: Engine logs go to stdout; liveness is observed externally through container exit.
text.zh: 引擎日志输出至 stdout；通过容器退出状态在外部观察存活性。

text.en: A boot configuration fixes one workflow and its bindings; local RAG and OPC-UA/Modbus are roadmap items.
text.zh: 启动配置指定单个工作流及绑定；本地 RAG、OPC-UA 和 Modbus 属于规划功能。

tools.name: OCI
tools.description: a framework that enables network operators with the ability to open up their edge facilities to Application Service Providers, by offering edge computing. As an example, consider a third-party Application Service Provider selling an IoT device (say, a home thermostat or security camera). Whenever that device shows up at the edge of the network, the Open Carrier Interface framework starts the Application Service Provider implemented edge software at the network operator’s Central Offices, which supports the IoT device with edge processing. Thus, even an early-stage Application Service Provider, who has few financial or physical resources, can offer the same level of edge support as giant companies, and therefore can compete with them on an even footing. read more.

note.en: Embedding APIs and extensions expose host capabilities; Kubernetes orchestration is an integration option.
note.zh: 嵌入 API 及扩展暴露宿主能力；Kubernetes 编排为集成选项。

note.en: CLI/Docker quick starts and Go, Rust, and C embedding SDK guides; GenAI features require the appropriate extension/framework.
note.zh: 提供命令行、Docker 入门及 Go、Rust、C 嵌入 SDK 指南；生成式 AI 功能需要相应扩展、框架。

note.en: Executes WebAssembly bytecode, with optional application frameworks such as LlamaEdge.
note.zh: 执行 WebAssembly 字节码，可搭配 LlamaEdge 等可选应用框架。

text.en: Executes WebAssembly bytecode, with optional application frameworks such as LlamaEdge.
text.zh: 执行 WebAssembly 字节码，可搭配 LlamaEdge 等可选应用框架。

text.en: Sandbox controls memory and host access to files, sockets, environment, and processes.
text.zh: 沙箱控制内存及对宿主文件、套接字、环境和进程的访问。

text.en: Runtime Statistics exposes instruction count, execution time, instructions per second and configurable gas-cost tables/limits.
text.zh: 运行时 Statistics 提供指令数、执行时间、每秒指令数以及可配置 gas 开销表／上限。

text.en: Embedding APIs and extensions expose host capabilities; Kubernetes orchestration is an integration option.
text.zh: 嵌入 API 及扩展暴露宿主能力；Kubernetes 编排为集成选项。

text.en: CLI/Docker quick starts and Go, Rust, and C embedding SDK guides; GenAI features require the appropriate extension/framework.
text.zh: 提供命令行、Docker 入门及 Go、Rust、C 嵌入 SDK 指南；生成式 AI 功能需要相应扩展、框架。

tools.name: Wasmer
tools.description: Wasmer is a fast and secure WebAssembly runtime that enables super lightweight containers to run anywhere: from Desktop to the Cloud, Edge and IoT devices.

summary.en: Wasmer is a fast and secure WebAssembly runtime that enables super lightweight containers to run anywhere: from Desktop to the Cloud, Edge and IoT devices.
summary.zh: 用于在桌面、云与边缘运行 WebAssembly 应用的运行时。

note.en: Embed metering middleware in the compiler to limit guest execution cost. The example uses Cranelift, allows resetting remaining points, and traps when the configured budget is exhausted.
note.zh: 可在编译器中加入计量中间件限制客户程序执行成本；示例使用 Cranelift，可重设剩余额度，并在预算耗尽时触发异常。

note.en: Package-running CLI, language SDKs, and Windows/macOS/Linux installation choices.
note.zh: 提供软件包运行命令行、语言 SDK 及 Windows、macOS、Linux 安装方式。

note.en: Executes WebAssembly applications through a standalone or embedded runtime.
note.zh: 通过独立或嵌入式运行时执行 WebAssembly 应用。

text.en: Executes WebAssembly applications through a standalone or embedded runtime.
text.zh: 通过独立或嵌入式运行时执行 WebAssembly 应用。

text.en: Supports WASI/WASIX and explicit file, network, and environment permissions.
text.zh: 支持 WASI、WASIX 及显式文件、网络和环境权限。

text.en: Metering middleware tracks an operator-cost budget and exposes remaining points. The application supplies a cost function and limit; exhausting points stops execution. These points are a configured accounting unit, not measured CPU time.
text.zh: Metering 中间件按操作符成本累计预算并提供剩余额度；应用设置成本函数和上限，额度耗尽时停止执行。这是配置的计量单位，不是实测 CPU 时间。

text.en: Embed metering middleware in the compiler to limit guest execution cost. The example uses Cranelift, allows resetting remaining points, and traps when the configured budget is exhausted.
text.zh: 可在编译器中加入计量中间件限制客户程序执行成本；示例使用 Cranelift，可重设剩余额度，并在预算耗尽时触发异常。

text.en: Package-running CLI, language SDKs, and Windows/macOS/Linux installation choices.
text.zh: 提供软件包运行命令行、语言 SDK 及 Windows、macOS、Linux 安装方式。

tools.name: Wasmtime
tools.description: Wasmtime is a Bytecode Alliance project that is a standalone wasm-only optimizing runtime for WebAssembly and WASI. It runs WebAssembly code outside of the Web, and can be used both as a command-line utility or as a library embedded in a larger application.

summary.en: Wasmtime is a Bytecode Alliance project that is a standalone wasm-only optimizing runtime for WebAssembly and WASI.
summary.zh: 可作为命令行工具或嵌入式库使用的 WebAssembly 与 WASI 运行时。

note.en: Cranelift generates native code at runtime or ahead of time; instances run within the configured runtime.
note.zh: Cranelift 在运行时或提前生成原生代码；实例在配置的运行时中运行。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine family itself; the reviewed version and its documented scope apply.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎系列，具体以本次核对版本及文档范围为准。

note.en: Rust implementation with CLI, runnable WASI example, installers, and online guides.
note.zh: Rust 实现，提供命令行、可运行 WASI 示例、安装程序及在线指南。

note.en: Executes standalone or embedded WebAssembly components.
note.zh: 执行独立或嵌入式 WebAssembly 组件。

text.en: Executes standalone or embedded WebAssembly components.
text.zh: 执行独立或嵌入式 WebAssembly 组件。

text.en: Cranelift generates native code at runtime or ahead of time; instances run within the configured runtime.
text.zh: Cranelift 在运行时或提前生成原生代码；实例在配置的运行时中运行。

text.en: The optional C guest-profiler API samples a WebAssembly guest; the embedding application must trigger samples, for example from epoch-deadline callbacks.
text.zh: 可选 C 客户程序分析 API 对 WebAssembly 客户程序采样；宿主应用需主动触发采样，例如使用 epoch 截止回调。

text.en: Configuration and embedding control execution; compilation and instance creation are distinct steps.
text.zh: 配置及嵌入控制执行；编译和实例创建为不同步骤。

text.en: Rust implementation with CLI, runnable WASI example, installers, and online guides.
text.zh: Rust 实现，提供命令行、可运行 WASI 示例、安装程序及在线指南。

tools.name: WSO2-IoT Server
tools.description: An extension of the popular open-source enterprise service-oriented integration platform WSO2 server that consists of certain IoT-related mechanisms, such as connecting a broad range of common IoT devices with the cloud using standard protocols such as MQTT and XMPP. Further, WSO2–IoT server includes the embedded Siddhi 3.0 component that allows the system to deploy real-time streaming processes in embedded devices. In other words, WSO2–IoT server provides the FEC computing capability to outer-edge devices.

summary.en: An extension of the popular open-source enterprise service-oriented integration platform WSO2 server that consists of certain IoT-related mechanisms, such as connecting a broad range of common IoT devices with the cloud using standard protocols such as MQTT and XMPP.
summary.zh: 连接物联网设备与云，并支持边缘实时流处理的平台扩展。

text.en: IoT platform for connected-device and mobile applications.
text.zh: 面向联网设备及移动应用的物联网平台。

text.en: Exposes device interaction through APIs.
text.zh: 通过 API 提供设备交互。

text.en: APIs support monitoring device information.
text.zh: API 支持监测设备信息。

text.en: Supports device control and connected-product development.
text.zh: 支持设备控制及联网产品开发。

text.en: Official page states the roadmap is now maintained by Entgra; check the chosen WSO2/Entgra version.
text.zh: 官方页面说明路线图现由 Entgra 维护；应核对选定 WSO2、Entgra 版本。

tools.name: Xybrid
tools.description: An open-source, local-first runtime for running LLMs, ASR, and TTS natively in apps and games.

summary.en: An open-source, local-first runtime for running LLMs, ASR, and TTS natively in apps and games.
summary.zh: 在应用和游戏中本地运行语言模型、语音识别与语音合成的运行时。

note.en: Rust core with Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, Unity, and Rust integration examples and setup links.
note.zh: Rust 核心，提供 Flutter、Swift、Kotlin、Unity 和 Rust 集成示例及安装链接。

note.en: The streaming example reports time to first token, tokens per second, mean/p95 inter-chunk latency and chunk count; platform dashboard telemetry is optional and requires an API key.
note.zh: 流式示例输出首 token 时间、每秒 token 数、平均／p95 分块间时延及块数；平台仪表盘遥测为可选功能，需要 API 密钥。

note.en: Runs local language, speech-recognition, and speech-synthesis models in applications and games.
note.zh: 在应用及游戏中运行本地语言、语音识别和语音合成模型。

text.en: Runs local language, speech-recognition, and speech-synthesis models in applications and games.
text.zh: 在应用及游戏中运行本地语言、语音识别和语音合成模型。

text.en: Models execute on-device; platform SDKs load catalog models through a common envelope interface.
text.zh: 模型在设备端执行；平台 SDK 通过统一 envelope 接口加载目录模型。

text.en: The streaming example reports time to first token, tokens per second, mean/p95 inter-chunk latency and chunk count; platform dashboard telemetry is optional and requires an API key.
text.zh: 流式示例输出首 token 时间、每秒 token 数、平均／p95 分块间时延及块数；平台仪表盘遥测为可选功能，需要 API 密钥。

text.en: APIs load models and run inference; no general cluster scheduler is established by the overview.
text.zh: API 加载模型并运行推理；概述未确认通用集群调度器。

text.en: Rust core with Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, Unity, and Rust integration examples and setup links.
text.zh: Rust 核心，提供 Flutter、Swift、Kotlin、Unity 和 Rust 集成示例及安装链接。

tools.name: Awesome-pcaptools
tools.description: A collection of tools developed by other researchers in the Computer Science area to process network traces.

summary.en: A collection of tools developed by other researchers in the Computer Science area to process network traces.
summary.zh: 用于处理网络数据包轨迹的工具与资源清单。

text.en: Packet-capture analysis tool links; the repository explicitly contains no tool source code
text.zh: 分组捕获分析工具链接；仓库明确不包含工具源码

text.en: Reference collection; no shared resource model.
text.zh: 参考资料集合，不存在统一资源模型。

text.en: Metrics belong to linked projects, not this collection.
text.zh: 指标属于各链接项目，不属于清单本身。

text.en: Not an executable resource manager.
text.zh: 不是可执行的资源管理器。

text.en: Browse the curated categories and follow each project’s documentation.
text.zh: 可浏览分类并进入各项目文档。

tools.name: EdgeNet
tools.description: edgeNet is a distributed edge cloud, in the family of PlanetLab, GENI, Canada’s SAVI infrastructure, Japan’s JGN-X, Germany’s G-Lab, and PlanetLab Europe. It is a modern distributed edge cloud, incorporating advances in Cloud technologies over the past few years.

summary.en: edgeNet is a distributed edge cloud, in the family of PlanetLab, GENI, Canada’s SAVI infrastructure, Japan’s JGN-X, Germany’s G-Lab, and PlanetLab Europe.
summary.zh: 基于云技术构建的分布式边缘云实验平台。

note.en: Kubernetes extension deploys applications across geographically distributed edge nodes.
note.zh: Kubernetes 扩展跨地理分布的边缘节点部署应用。

text.en: Kubernetes extension deploys applications across geographically distributed edge nodes.
text.zh: Kubernetes 扩展跨地理分布的边缘节点部署应用。

text.en: Supports provider-contributed nodes, tenant quotas, and resource slices.
text.zh: 支持供应者贡献节点、租户配额及资源切片。

text.en: The repository supplies a Prometheus ServiceMonitor for the controller manager HTTPS /metrics endpoint, using a service-account bearer token. Collection requires the corresponding monitoring stack and deployment configuration.
text.zh: 仓库提供 Prometheus ServiceMonitor，使用服务账户令牌采集控制器管理器的 HTTPS /metrics；实际采集需相应监控组件和部署配置。

text.en: Multitenancy and location-based selection govern resource sharing and regional placement.
text.zh: 多租户及位置选择管理资源共享和区域放置。

text.en: Go software with Kubernetes/cert-manager installation guides; EdgeNet software and the EdgeNet testbed are distinct.
text.zh: Go 软件，提供 Kubernetes、cert-manager 安装指南；EdgeNet 软件与 EdgeNet 试验平台不同。

tools.name: Komondor
tools.description: Komondor is a wireless network simulator that includes novel mechanisms for next-generation WLANs, such as dynamic channel bonding or enhanced spatial reuse. One of the main purposes of Komondor is to simulate the behavior of IEEE 802.11ax-2019 networks, an amendment designed to boost spectral efficiency in dense deployments.

summary.en: Komondor is a wireless network simulator that includes novel mechanisms for next-generation WLANs, such as dynamic channel bonding or enhanced spatial reuse.
summary.zh: 研究下一代 WLAN、信道绑定与空间复用的无线网络仿真器。

note.en: CompC++/COST-based simulator with input-generation tools, scripts, configuration, and regression scenarios.
note.zh: 基于 CompC++、COST 的仿真器，提供输入生成工具、脚本、配置及回归场景。

note.en: CompC++/COST-based simulator with input-generation tools, scripts, configuration, and regression scenarios.
note.zh: 基于 CompC++、COST 的仿真器，提供输入生成工具、脚本、配置及回归场景。

note.en: Outputs statistics, throughput and RSSI regression comparisons, and optional system/node/agent logs.
note.zh: 输出统计、吞吐量及 RSSI 回归比较，并提供可选系统、节点和智能体日志。

note.en: Supports bandit agents and external Python models through Unix sockets for channel-access research.
note.zh: 支持老虎机智能体及经 Unix socket 接入的外部 Python 模型，用于信道接入研究。

text.en: Event-driven WLAN simulation, including documented IEEE 802.11bn-oriented mechanisms.
text.zh: 事件驱动 WLAN 仿真，包含文档所述面向 IEEE 802.11bn 的机制。

text.en: Models channel bonding, EDCA, spatial reuse, beamforming, and multi-AP coordination.
text.zh: 建模信道绑定、EDCA、空间复用、波束成形及多 AP 协作。

text.en: Outputs statistics, throughput and RSSI regression comparisons, and optional system/node/agent logs.
text.zh: 输出统计、吞吐量及 RSSI 回归比较，并提供可选系统、节点和智能体日志。

text.en: Supports bandit agents and external Python models through Unix sockets for channel-access research.
text.zh: 支持老虎机智能体及经 Unix socket 接入的外部 Python 模型，用于信道接入研究。

text.en: CompC++/COST-based simulator with input-generation tools, scripts, configuration, and regression scenarios.
text.zh: 基于 CompC++、COST 的仿真器，提供输入生成工具、脚本、配置及回归场景。

tools.name: Mosquitto
tools.description: Eclipse Mosquitto is an open source (EPL/EDL licensed) message broker that implements the MQTT protocol versions 5.0, 3.1.1 and 3.1. Mosquitto is lightweight and is suitable for use on all devices from low power single board computers to full servers. The MQTT protocol provides a lightweight method of carrying out messaging using a publish/subscribe model. This makes it suitable for Internet of Things messaging such as with low power sensors or mobile devices such as phones, embedded computers or microcontrollers. The Mosquitto project also provides a C library for implementing MQTT clients, and the very popular mosquitto_pub and mosquitto_sub command line MQTT clients.

summary.en: Eclipse Mosquitto is an open source (EPL/EDL licensed) message broker that implements the MQTT protocol versions 5.0, 3.1.1 and 3.1.
summary.zh: 面向物联网消息通信的轻量 MQTT 消息代理。

text.en: MQTT broker and client library for publish/subscribe applications.
text.zh: 用于发布订阅应用的 MQTT 代理及客户端库。

text.en: Implements MQTT 5.0, 3.1.1, and 3.1; TLS and WebSocket connections are documented.
text.zh: 实现 MQTT 5.0、3.1.1、3.1；文档说明 TLS 及 WebSocket 连接。

text.en: Subscribe to $SYS broker topics for connection/client counts, message/byte counters, stored messages, subscriptions, and selected memory readings. sys_interval controls periodic publication; a zero interval disables periodic updates.
text.zh: 订阅 $SYS 主题可读取连接与客户端数量、消息及字节计数、存储消息、订阅数量和部分内存读数；sys_interval 控制周期发布，设为 0 会关闭周期更新。

text.en: Broker routes topic-based messages between publishers and subscribers.
text.zh: 代理在发布者、订阅者间路由基于主题的消息。

text.en: C client library and command-line clients; the advertised Management Center UI belongs to a separate commercial offering.
text.zh: 提供 C 客户端库及命令行客户端；宣传的 Management Center 界面属于独立商业产品。

tools.name: Naming Data Network Platform
tools.description: NDN is an entirely new architecture, but one whose design principles are derived from the successes of today’s Internet, reflecting our understanding of the strengths and limitations of the current Internet architecture, and one that can be rolled out through incremental deployment over the current operational Internet.

summary.en: NDN is an entirely new architecture, but one whose design principles are derived from the successes of today’s Internet, reflecting our understanding of the strengths and limitations of the current Internet architecture, and one that can be rolled out through incremental deployment over the current operational Internet.
summary.zh: 面向命名数据网络架构的研究与实现平台。

text.en: NDN software platform catalog covers forwarders, libraries, tools, and simulators.
text.zh: NDN 软件平台目录涵盖转发器、库、工具及仿真器。

text.en: Packages include NFD, ndn-cxx, NLSR, Mini-NDN, ndnSIM, and device-specific implementations.
text.zh: 软件包包括 NFD、ndn-cxx、NLSR、Mini-NDN、ndnSIM 及设备特定实现。

text.en: Metrics differ by package; the platform page is not a unified measurement API.
text.zh: 指标随软件包不同；平台页面并非统一测量 API。

text.en: Forwarding, routing, and synchronization are supplied by distinct packages.
text.zh: 转发、路由及同步由不同软件包提供。

text.en: Maintained and deprecated packages are distinguished; select a package before checking language and runtime compatibility.
text.zh: 区分维护及弃用软件包；需先选择软件包，再核对语言及运行兼容性。

tools.name: Node-RED
tools.description: Node-RED is a programming tool for wiring together hardware devices, APIs and online services in new and interesting ways. It provides a browser-based editor that makes it easy to wire together flows using the wide range of nodes in the palette that can be deployed to its runtime in a single-click.

summary.en: Node-RED is a programming tool for wiring together hardware devices, APIs and online services in new and interesting ways.
summary.zh: 使用浏览器中的流程编辑器连接设备、API 与在线服务。

note.en: Low-code visual flow environment with local, Docker, device, and cloud setup guides.
note.zh: 低代码可视化流程环境，提供本地、Docker、设备及云安装指南。

note.en: Low-code visual flow environment with local, Docker, device, and cloud setup guides.
note.zh: 低代码可视化流程环境，提供本地、Docker、设备及云安装指南。

note.en: Executes event-driven data-processing and automation flows.
note.zh: 执行事件驱动的数据处理及自动化流程。

text.en: Executes event-driven data-processing and automation flows.
text.zh: 执行事件驱动的数据处理及自动化流程。

text.en: Node.js runtime can run on low-cost edge hardware or cloud infrastructure.
text.zh: Node.js 运行时可在低成本边缘硬件或云基础设施运行。

text.en: Flows collect, transform, and visualize real-time data; metric semantics depend on selected nodes.
text.zh: 流程采集、转换及可视化实时数据；指标含义取决于所选节点。

text.en: Composable nodes organize application data flow and automation.
text.zh: 可组合节点组织应用数据流及自动化。

text.en: Low-code visual flow environment with local, Docker, device, and cloud setup guides.
text.zh: 低代码可视化流程环境，提供本地、Docker、设备及云安装指南。

tools.name: Open vSwitch
tools.description: is a production quality, multilayer virtual switch licensed under the open source Apache 2.0 license. It is designed to enable massive network automation through programmatic extension, while still supporting standard management interfaces and protocols (e.g. NetFlow, sFlow, IPFIX, RSPAN, CLI, LACP, 802.1ag). In addition, it is designed to support distribution across multiple physical servers similar to VMware's vNetwork distributed vswitch or Cisco's Nexus 1000V.

summary.en: is a production quality, multilayer virtual switch licensed under the open source Apache 2.0 license.
summary.zh: 支持网络自动化和跨主机连接的多层虚拟交换机。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine family itself; the reviewed version and its documented scope apply.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎系列，具体以本次核对版本及文档范围为准。

text.en: Software virtual switch forwards traffic in virtualized systems.
text.zh: 软件虚拟交换机在虚拟化系统转发流量。

text.en: Supports kernel and userspace datapaths and multiple hypervisor integrations; specific datapaths have their own requirements.
text.zh: 支持内核及用户态数据路径和多种虚拟机管理器集成；具体路径有各自要求。

text.en: NetFlow, sFlow, and IPFIX provide traffic monitoring/export.
text.zh: NetFlow、sFlow、IPFIX 提供流量监测及导出。

text.en: Programmatic management and standard interfaces configure switching and network automation.
text.zh: 可编程管理及标准接口配置交换与网络自动化。

text.en: C-based implementation with CLI/man pages and Linux/BSD support.
text.zh: 以 C 为主的实现，提供命令行、手册页及 Linux、BSD 支持。

tools.name: POX
tools.description: POX is a networking software platform written in Python. POX started life as an OpenFlow controller, but can now also function as an OpenFlow switch, and can be useful for writing networking software in general. An useful link of how to simulate a SDN can check the link: http://www.brianlinkletter.com/using-the-pox-sdn-controller/

summary.en: POX is a networking software platform written in Python.
summary.zh: 用 Python 开发网络控制器、交换机和网络应用的软件平台。

note.en: Python 3 command line on Linux, macOS, and Windows; some features are platform-specific.
note.zh: Python 3 命令行支持 Linux、macOS、Windows；部分功能与平台相关。

note.en: Python platform runs OpenFlow control and switch components.
note.zh: Python 平台运行 OpenFlow 控制及交换组件。

text.en: Python platform runs OpenFlow control and switch components.
text.zh: Python 平台运行 OpenFlow 控制及交换组件。

text.en: Supports OpenFlow 1.0 and Open vSwitch/Nicira extensions.
text.zh: 支持 OpenFlow 1.0 及 Open vSwitch、Nicira 扩展。

text.en: Verbose mode prints initialization exception stack traces.
text.zh: 详细模式打印初始化异常堆栈。

text.en: User components are Python modules loaded through their launch function.
text.zh: 用户组件为通过 launch 函数加载的 Python 模块。

text.en: Python 3 command line on Linux, macOS, and Windows; some features are platform-specific.
text.zh: Python 3 命令行支持 Linux、macOS、Windows；部分功能与平台相关。

tools.name: RICE
tools.description: A unified approach to remote function invocation in ICN(Naming Data Network Platform) that exploits the attractive ICN properties of name-based routing, receiver-driven low and congestion control, low balance, and object-oriented security while presenting a natural programming model to the application developer.

summary.en: A unified approach to remote function invocation in ICN(Naming Data Network Platform) that exploits the attractive ICN properties of name-based routing, receiver-driven low and congestion control, low balance, and object-oriented security while presenting a natural programming model to the application developer.
summary.zh: 利用 ICN 命名与路由机制实现远程函数调用。

note.en: C++ builds use waf for simulation and Make for the prototype, with shell experiment scripts.
note.zh: C++ 构建在仿真端使用 waf、原型端使用 Make，并提供 Shell 实验脚本。

note.en: Simulation example enables NS_LOG and provides scripts for reproducing paper results.
note.zh: 仿真示例启用 NS_LOG，并提供复现论文结果的脚本。

note.en: Provides both ndnSIM simulation and an ndn-cxx prototype for remote invocation in ICN.
note.zh: 同时提供用于 ICN 远程调用的 ndnSIM 仿真与 ndn-cxx 原型。

text.en: Provides both ndnSIM simulation and an ndn-cxx prototype for remote invocation in ICN.
text.zh: 同时提供用于 ICN 远程调用的 ndnSIM 仿真与 ndn-cxx 原型。

text.en: Uses NDN forwarders and producer/consumer handshake and thunk messages.
text.zh: 使用 NDN 转发器及生产者、消费者握手和 thunk 消息。

text.en: Simulation example enables NS_LOG and provides scripts for reproducing paper results.
text.zh: 仿真示例启用 NS_LOG，并提供复现论文结果的脚本。

text.en: Implements remote invocation; the prototype handshake needs NFD modifications to span different machines.
text.zh: 实现远程调用；原型握手跨机器运行需要修改 NFD。

text.en: C++ builds use waf for simulation and Make for the prototype, with shell experiment scripts.
text.zh: C++ 构建在仿真端使用 waf、原型端使用 Make，并提供 Shell 实验脚本。

tools.name: VerneMQ
tools.description: VerneMQ is a high-performance, distributed MQTT message broker. It scales horizontally and vertically on commodity hardware to support a high number of concurrent publishers and consumers while maintaining low latency and fault tolerance. VerneMQ is the reliable message hub for your IoT platform or smart products.

summary.en: VerneMQ is a high-performance, distributed MQTT message broker.
summary.zh: 面向物联网应用的分布式 MQTT 消息代理。

text.en: Distributed MQTT broker for IoT and mobile messaging.
text.zh: 面向物联网及移动消息的分布式 MQTT 代理。

text.en: Erlang/OTP implementation uses multicore hosts and clustered nodes.
text.zh: Erlang、OTP 实现使用多核主机及集群节点。

text.en: vmq-admin metrics show reports counters and gauges for MQTT traffic, queues, and retained-message memory. Native monitoring integrations include Graphite, $SYS, and Prometheus; configure the chosen exporter or listener.
text.zh: vmq-admin metrics show 提供 MQTT 流量、队列和保留消息内存的计数器及仪表值；原生监控接入包括 Graphite、$SYS 和 Prometheus，需配置选定导出器或监听器。

text.en: Supports broker clustering and extensible authentication/authorization plugins.
text.zh: 支持代理集群及可扩展认证、授权插件。

text.en: CLI tools, integration APIs, plugins, and deployment guides; Erlang programming is not required for ordinary operation.
text.zh: 提供命令行工具、集成 API、插件及部署指南；常规运维不要求 Erlang 编程。

tools.name: Wonder Shaper
tools.description: Wonder Shaper is a script that allows the user to limit the bandwidth of one or more network adapters. It does so by using iproute's tc command, but greatly simplifies its operation.

summary.en: Wonder Shaper is a script that allows the user to limit the bandwidth of one or more network adapters.
summary.zh: 通过 Linux tc 简化网卡带宽限制设置的脚本。

note.en: Shell command-line script with a configuration file and installation instructions.
note.zh: Shell 命令行脚本，提供配置文件及安装说明。

text.en: Configures traffic shaping on real Linux network adapters.
text.zh: 在真实 Linux 网络适配器配置流量整形。

text.en: Uses iproute tc and HTB queues to limit upload and download rates.
text.zh: 使用 iproute 的 tc 及 HTB 队列限制上下行速率。

text.en: Configured bandwidth is a limit, not a throughput measurement.
text.zh: 配置带宽是限制值，并非吞吐量测量值。

text.en: Applies or clears per-interface shaping; persistent configuration can use systemd.
text.zh: 应用或清除接口级整形；可通过 systemd 持久化配置。

text.en: Shell command-line script with a configuration file and installation instructions.
text.zh: Shell 命令行脚本，提供配置文件及安装说明。

tools.name: aBeacon Data
tools.description: A large-scale repository composed of BLE sensing, location trace, and manual report data, including 31,131 couriers at 2,466 merchant locations in one month.

summary.en: A large-scale repository composed of BLE sensing, location trace, and manual report data, including 31,131 couriers at 2,466 merchant locations in one month.
summary.zh: 包含配送人员 BLE 感知、位置轨迹和人工报告的数据集。

text.en: Research dataset from an operational courier-arrival beacon system.
text.zh: 来自运营中快递员到达信标系统的研究数据集。

text.en: Contains BLE sensing, courier location traces, and manual reports from one month.
text.zh: 包含一个月的 BLE 感知、快递员位置轨迹及人工报告。

text.en: Records sensing and location observations; the stated 31,131 couriers and 2,466 merchants describe dataset coverage.
text.zh: 记录感知及位置观测；31,131 名快递员与 2,466 家商户描述数据覆盖范围。

text.en: Can support mobility and order-scheduling analysis; no live scheduling engine is supplied by the data description.
text.zh: 可支持移动及订单调度分析；数据说明未提供实时调度引擎。

text.en: Author-hosted data description, download link, and original study references.
text.zh: 作者网站提供数据说明、下载链接及原始研究引用。

tools.name: AI Benchmark
tools.description: The performance and comparison of all chipsets from Qualcomm, HiSilicon, Samsung, MediaTek and Unisoc that are providing hardware acceleration for AI inference.

summary.en: The performance and comparison of all chipsets from Qualcomm, HiSilicon, Samsung, MediaTek and Unisoc that are providing hardware acceleration for AI inference.
summary.zh: 用于比较移动芯片 AI 推理能力的基准工具。

note.en: Runs mobile AI tasks to evaluate smartphone inference performance.
note.zh: 运行移动 AI 任务以评估手机推理性能。

text.en: Runs mobile AI tasks to evaluate smartphone inference performance.
text.zh: 运行移动 AI 任务以评估手机推理性能。

text.en: Task examples include recognition, classification, and enhancement on listed devices.
text.zh: 任务示例包含所列设备上的识别、分类及增强。

text.en: Publishes benchmark scores and device rankings tied to tested hardware.
text.zh: 发布与测试硬件对应的基准分数及设备排名。

text.en: Benchmark workloads compare devices; the score is not a generic resource-allocation policy.
text.zh: 基准工作负载比较设备；分数并非通用资源分配策略。

text.en: Benchmark application and result pages provide task descriptions and rankings.
text.zh: 基准应用及结果页面提供任务说明和排名。

tools.name: CloudSuite
tools.description: CloudSuite is a benchmark suite for cloud services. The third release consists of eight applications that have been selected based on their popularity in today’s datacenters. The benchmarks are based on real-world software stacks and represent real-world setups.

summary.en: CloudSuite is a benchmark suite for cloud services.
summary.zh: 面向云服务和数据中心应用的基准测试套件。

note.en: Docker images support benchmark deployment; release notes include ARM workload support.
note.zh: 通过 Docker 镜像部署基准；版本说明包含 ARM 工作负载支持。

note.en: Documented Docker and shell commands reproduce deployment, warm-up and bounded benchmark runs; network and memory requirements depend on the chosen workload size.
note.zh: 文档中的 Docker 与 Shell 命令用于复现部署、预热和限时基准运行；网络与内存需求取决于所选工作负载规模。

note.en: CloudSuite 4.0 runs eight real cloud-service benchmark stacks.
note.zh: CloudSuite 4.0 运行八类真实云服务基准软件栈。

text.en: CloudSuite 4.0 runs eight real cloud-service benchmark stacks.
text.zh: CloudSuite 4.0 运行八类真实云服务基准软件栈。

text.en: Docker images support benchmark deployment; release notes include ARM workload support.
text.zh: 通过 Docker 镜像部署基准；版本说明包含 ARM 工作负载支持。

text.en: The Memcached workload measures requests per second with a 99th-percentile latency target below 1 ms. This QoS target belongs to this workload, not every CloudSuite benchmark.
text.zh: Memcached 工作负载测量每秒请求数，并以第 99 百分位时延低于 1 ms 为 QoS 目标；该条件仅属于此工作负载。

text.en: Configure server/client threads, dataset scaling, connections and request rate; separate throughput and target-load modes include warm-up. The guide explains how to distribute clients across servers.
text.zh: 配置服务端／客户端线程、数据集缩放、连接数与请求率；分别提供吞吐量与目标负载模式，包含预热，并说明跨服务器分配客户端。

text.en: Documented Docker and shell commands reproduce deployment, warm-up and bounded benchmark runs; network and memory requirements depend on the chosen workload size.
text.zh: 文档中的 Docker 与 Shell 命令用于复现部署、预热和限时基准运行；网络与内存需求取决于所选工作负载规模。

tools.name: ClusterData
tools.description: Alibaba ClusterData is a collection of production cluster traces for cloud scheduling, resource management, and data center systems research.

summary.en: Alibaba ClusterData is a collection of production cluster traces for cloud scheduling, resource management, and data center systems research.
summary.zh: 阿里巴巴生产集群轨迹，用于云调度与资源管理研究。

note.en: The cluster-trace-gpu-v2026 release describes Alibaba Serverless Infrastructure traces; this is a dataset scope.
note.zh: cluster-trace-gpu-v2026 版本描述阿里无服务器基础设施轨迹；此标签表示数据集范围。

note.en: Release folders provide data, schema, and selected processing/visualization scripts; access steps vary by release.
note.zh: 发布文件夹提供数据、格式及部分处理、可视化脚本；获取步骤随版本不同。

note.en: Release folders provide data, schema, and selected processing/visualization scripts; access steps vary by release.
note.zh: 发布文件夹提供数据、格式及部分处理、可视化脚本；获取步骤随版本不同。

text.en: Production cluster traces for workload and systems research.
text.zh: 用于工作负载及系统研究的生产集群轨迹。

text.en: Versions cover colocated jobs, GPUs, microservices, and microarchitecture; each release has its own schema and observation window.
text.zh: 各版本覆盖混部任务、GPU、微服务及微架构；每次发布具有独立格式和观测窗口。

text.en: Includes version-dependent utilization, response times, call rates, and other recorded statistics.
text.zh: 包含随版本变化的利用率、响应时间、调用速率等记录统计。

text.en: Traces can inform scheduling research; they do not themselves allocate live resources.
text.zh: 轨迹可支持调度研究，但本身不分配实时资源。

text.en: Release folders provide data, schema, and selected processing/visualization scripts; access steps vary by release.
text.zh: 发布文件夹提供数据、格式及部分处理、可视化脚本；获取步骤随版本不同。

tools.name: DeFog
tools.description: DeFog, a first Fog benchmarking suite to: (i) alleviate the burden of Fog benchmarking by using a standard methodology, and (ii) facilitate the understanding of the target platform by collecting a catalogue of relevant metrics for a set of benchmarks.

summary.en: DeFog, a first Fog benchmarking suite to: (i) alleviate the burden of Fog benchmarking by using a standard methodology, and (ii) facilitate the understanding of the target platform by collecting a catalogue of relevant metrics for a set of benchmarks.
summary.zh: 用于比较与分析雾计算平台的基准测试套件。

note.en: The benchmark describes container-based cloud-edge interactions in a fog system.
note.zh: 该基准描述雾系统中基于容器的云边交互。

note.en: Shell entry point, Java 8-era JMeter setup, Docker, and SSH/AWS environment configuration.
note.zh: 提供 Shell 入口、Java 8 时代 JMeter 配置、Docker 及 SSH、AWS 环境配置。

note.en: Container-based benchmark suite runs cloud-edge application experiments.
note.zh: 容器化基准套件运行云边应用实验。

text.en: Container-based benchmark suite runs cloud-edge application experiments.
text.zh: 容器化基准套件运行云边应用实验。

text.en: Connects user and edge devices with Docker applications and cloud resources.
text.zh: 通过 Docker 应用及云资源连接用户与边缘设备。

text.en: Integrates JMeter and Taurus for workload testing; metric details require their benchmark configuration.
text.zh: 集成 JMeter、Taurus 进行负载测试；具体指标取决于基准配置。

text.en: Shell configuration and launch commands organize benchmark applications and deployments.
text.zh: Shell 配置及启动命令组织基准应用和部署。

text.en: Shell entry point, Java 8-era JMeter setup, Docker, and SSH/AWS environment configuration.
text.zh: 提供 Shell 入口、Java 8 时代 JMeter 配置、Docker 及 SSH、AWS 环境配置。

tools.name: Edge AIBench
tools.description: Edge AIBench is a benchmark suite for end-to-end edge computing including four typical application scenarios: ICU Patient Monitor, Surveillance Camera, Smart Home, and Autonomous Vehicle, which consider the complexity of all edge computing AI scenarios. In addition, Edge AIBench provides an end-to-end application benchmarking framework, including train, validate and inference stages.

summary.en: Edge AIBench is a benchmark suite for end-to-end edge computing including four typical application scenarios: ICU Patient Monitor, Surveillance Camera, Smart Home, and Autonomous Vehicle, which consider the complexity of all edge computing AI scenarios.
summary.zh: 涵盖医疗监测、摄像头、智能家居和自动驾驶等场景的边缘 AI 基准。

text.en: End-to-end benchmarks cover client, edge, and cloud AI workflows.
text.zh: 端到端基准覆盖客户端、边缘及云 AI 流程。

text.en: Scenarios include ICU monitoring, surveillance, smart homes, and autonomous vehicles.
text.zh: 场景包括 ICU 监测、视频监控、智能家居及自动驾驶。

text.en: Evaluates workflows spanning data collection, training, validation, and inference.
text.zh: 评估涵盖数据采集、训练、验证及推理的工作流程。

text.en: Three-layer benchmark framework organizes data and processing across client, edge, and cloud.
text.zh: 三层基准框架跨客户端、边缘及云组织数据和处理。

text.en: Official site provides specifications, downloads, and per-scenario descriptions.
text.zh: 官网提供规范、下载及分场景说明。

tools.name: EUA Datasets
tools.description: This repository maintains a set of EUA datasets which we collected from real-world data sources. The datasets are publicly released to facilitate research in Edge Computing. All the data is in Australia region which contains edge server locations and user location.

summary.en: This repository maintains a set of EUA datasets which we collected from real-world data sources.
summary.zh: 基于澳大利亚真实数据构建的边缘计算研究数据集。

notes.en: Corrected the inventory URL typo from eua-datase to eua-dataset.
notes.zh: 将目录 URL 的 eua-datase 拼写修正为 eua-dataset。

text.en: Datasets of Australian edge-server and end-user locations.
text.zh: 澳大利亚边缘服务器及终端用户位置数据集。

text.en: Separate folders describe server locations and user locations derived from listed real-world sources.
text.zh: 独立文件夹描述服务器和用户位置，来自所列现实数据来源。

text.en: Location and coverage records support spatial analysis; they are not measured compute or network capacity.
text.zh: 位置及覆盖记录支持空间分析，并非测量的计算或网络容量。

text.en: Supports offline edge-user allocation research; no runtime allocator is bundled by the overview.
text.zh: 支持离线边缘用户分配研究；概述未说明随附运行时分配器。

text.en: Public dataset folders and provenance references; the repository name ends in eua-dataset.
text.zh: 提供公开数据文件夹及来源引用；仓库名称以 eua-dataset 结尾。

tools.name: GT-ITM
aliases: GT-ITM: Georgia Tech Internetwork Topology Models
tools.description: This is a collection of routines to generate and analyze graphs using a wide variety of models for internetwork topology. The graphs are generated in Don Knuth's SGB format; a routine is provided to convert to an alternative format that may be easier to parse.

summary.en: This is a collection of routines to generate and analyze graphs using a wide variety of models for internetwork topology.
summary.zh: 生成并分析互联网拓扑图的模型与程序集合。

text.en: Produces internetwork topology models for analysis and simulation.
text.zh: 生成用于分析及仿真的互联网络拓扑模型。

text.en: Represents network geography and hierarchical compositions.
text.zh: 表示网络地理结构及分层组合。

text.en: Model-fidelity discussion cautions against treating generated topology results as automatically representative of real networks.
text.zh: 模型保真度讨论提醒，不能自动认为生成拓扑的结果代表真实网络。

text.en: Supports routing/resource-reservation research through topology inputs, not live allocation.
text.zh: 通过拓扑输入支持路由及资源预留研究，并非实时分配。

text.en: Academic project site provides software and modeling documentation.
text.zh: 学术项目网站提供软件及建模文档。

tools.name: Huawei Network AI Scheduling Dataset
aliases: Huawei - Dataset for Network AI Scheduling Technology Research (in Chinese)
tools.description: Modeling computational service scenarios for Network AI, providing users with strategy algorithms for task scheduling research.

summary.en: Modeling computational service scenarios for Network AI, providing users with strategy algorithms for task scheduling research.
summary.zh: 面向网络 AI 计算服务与任务调度研究的数据资料。

note.en: score.py combines task completion rate, job completion rate and average job completion time; it averages scores over the ten test cases. Exact normalization and coefficients are defined in get_score().
note.zh: score.py 结合任务完成率、作业完成率及平均作业完成时间评分，对十个测试案例取平均；具体归一化与系数由 get_score() 定义。

text.en: Network AI scheduling dataset and a plan-scoring environment spanning UEs, base stations, hosts and cloud.
text.zh: 跨 UE、基站、主机与云的 Network AI 调度数据集及方案评分环境。

text.en: CSV tables specify CPU/memory capacities, communication rates, compute factors, UE online/offline times, task dependencies and resource requests.
text.zh: CSV 表描述 CPU／内存容量、通信速率、计算系数、UE 上下线时间、任务依赖和资源请求。

text.en: score.py combines task completion rate, job completion rate and average job completion time; it averages scores over the ten test cases. Exact normalization and coefficients are defined in get_score().
text.zh: score.py 结合任务完成率、作业完成率及平均作业完成时间评分，对十个测试案例取平均；具体归一化与系数由 get_score() 定义。

text.en: Submitted plans create/delete executors and match tasks to executors under resource and dependency constraints; the provided code evaluates plans rather than learning a policy.
text.zh: 提交方案在资源及依赖约束下创建／删除执行器并匹配任务；随附代码评估方案，而非训练策略。

text.en: Archive includes Python scoring modules, CSV datasets and a submission example; log.py writes rotating competition.log files. Archive contents were inspected without executing them.
text.zh: 压缩包包含 Python 评分模块、CSV 数据及提交样例；log.py 写入轮转 competition.log。已检查压缩包内容，未执行其中代码。

summary.zh: 在不同部署场景中测量模型推理性能的基准套件。

note.zh: 不同参考基准使用这些框架，需选择对应模型的实现；提交结果可使用其他框架。

note.zh: 提供参考应用及自动运行文档；核查 README 标识 6.1 版本。

note.en: Runs reference inference benchmarks for edge and data-center deployment scenarios.
note.zh: 运行面向边缘及数据中心部署场景的参考推理基准。

text.zh: 运行面向边缘及数据中心部署场景的参考推理基准。

text.zh: 模型、数据集及框架要求按基准和版本定义。

text.zh: 标准化工作负载用于比较系统；此套件并非通用生产资源调度器。
