text.zh: 提供参考应用及自动运行文档；核查 README 标识 6.1 版本。

tools.name: networkX
tools.description: NetworkX is a Python language package for exploration and analysis of networks and network algorithms. The core package provides data structures for representing many types of networks, or graphs, including simple graphs, directed graphs, and graphs with parallel edges and self-loops. The nodes in NetworkX graphs can be any (hashable) Python object and edges can contain arbitrary data; this flexibility makes NetworkX ideal for representing networks found in many different scientific fields.

summary.en: NetworkX is a Python language package for exploration and analysis of networks and network algorithms.
summary.zh: 用 Python 表示、分析网络图和研究图算法的工具包。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine itself. Consult the listed version and scope before selecting an extension or backend.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎；选择扩展或后端时需查看版本与适用范围。

note.en: pip package, Python examples, tutorials, and optional dependencies.
note.zh: 提供 pip 包、Python 示例、教程及可选依赖。

text.en: Python library creates and analyzes network graphs.
text.zh: Python 库用于创建及分析网络图。

text.en: Represents nodes, edges, and weights; graphs are abstractions rather than packet-level network execution.
text.zh: 表示节点、边和权重；图为抽象表示，而非分组级网络执行。

text.en: Graph-analysis APIs compute structural results such as weighted shortest paths.
text.zh: 图分析 API 计算加权最短路径等结构结果。

text.en: Graph algorithms support offline optimization; they do not directly schedule live edge resources.
text.zh: 图算法支持离线优化，不直接调度实时边缘资源。

text.en: pip package, Python examples, tutorials, and optional dependencies.
text.zh: 提供 pip 包、Python 示例、教程及可选依赖。

tools.name: Network Modeling Datasets
tools.description: This repository provides datasets generated using a custom OMNeT++ simulator, covering diverse network topologies, routing configurations and traffic patterns. Each sample includes precise end-to-end performance metrics, such as per-source–destination packet-level delay, jitter and loss, with detailed instructions available in each dataset’s root directory. These datasets are intended to facilitate the design, training and evaluation of ML-based network models and to support fair benchmarking against prior state-of-the-art approaches on a common dataset.

summary.en: This repository provides datasets generated using a custom OMNeT++ simulator, covering diverse network topologies, routing configurations and traffic patterns.
summary.zh: 由 OMNeT++ 生成的网络拓扑、路由、流量与端到端性能数据。

text.en: Datasets for training and benchmarking network-performance models.
text.zh: 用于训练及评估网络性能模型的数据集。

text.en: Samples vary topology, routing, and traffic and are generated with an OMNeT++-based simulator.
text.zh: 样本改变拓扑、路由及流量，由基于 OMNeT++ 的仿真器生成。

text.en: Contains per-source/destination packet delay, jitter, and loss statistics.
text.zh: 包含源、目的节点对的分组时延、抖动及丢失统计。

text.en: Supports offline model evaluation; the separate BNNetSimulator produces additional samples.
text.zh: 支持离线模型评估；独立 BNNetSimulator 可生成额外样本。

text.en: Dataset-specific root instructions describe formats; a separate repository distributes the simulator image.
text.zh: 各数据集根目录说明格式；独立仓库分发仿真器镜像。

tools.name: Neural Network Accelerator Comparison
tools.description: A comparison of AI hardware accelerators among different platform.

summary.en: A comparison of AI hardware accelerators among different platform.
summary.zh: 不同平台上的 AI 硬件加速器比较资料。

accessNote.en: The original comparison page returned HTTP 404; this remains a reference entry.
accessNote.zh: 原对比页面返回 HTTP 404；保留为参考入口。

tools.name: Rocketfuel
tools.description: Traceroutes were sourced from 800 vantage points hosted by nearly 300 traceroute web servers. They started by mapping 10 ISPs, in Europe, Australia and the United States. In that process, they constructed a database of over 50 thousand IP addresses representing 45 thousand routers in 537 POPs connected by 80 thousand links.

summary.en: Traceroutes were sourced from 800 vantage points hosted by nearly 300 traceroute web servers.
summary.zh: 基于 traceroute 测量构建的互联网服务商拓扑数据。

note.en: Browsable maps, data downloads, publications, and software links; original standalone Ally is unmaintained.
note.zh: 提供可浏览地图、数据下载、论文及软件链接；原独立 Ally 已停止维护。

text.en: Historical ISP-topology mapping data and associated tools.
text.zh: 历史 ISP 拓扑测绘数据及配套工具。

text.en: Uses traceroutes, naming conventions, alias resolution, router/PoP maps, and inferred link attributes.
text.zh: 使用 traceroute、命名规则、别名解析、路由器及 PoP 地图和推断链路属性。

text.en: Releases include inferred weights/link latencies and raw traces; these describe the historical measurement campaign.
text.zh: 发布内容包含推断权重、链路时延及原始轨迹；对应历史测量活动。

text.en: Topology data supports offline network analysis; Ally and Undns maintenance moved into Scriptroute.
text.zh: 拓扑数据支持离线网络分析；Ally、Undns 维护转入 Scriptroute。

text.en: Browsable maps, data downloads, publications, and software links; original standalone Ally is unmaintained.
text.zh: 提供可浏览地图、数据下载、论文及软件链接；原独立 Ally 已停止维护。

tools.name: CAIDA Anonymized Internet Traces 2015
aliases: The CAIDA Anonymized Internet Traces 2015 Dataset
tools.description: CAIDA's passive traces dataset contains traces collected from high-speed monitors on a commercial backbone link. The data collection started in April 2008 and ended in January 2019. These data are useful for research on the characteristics of Internet traffic, including application breakdown, security events, geographic and topological distribution, flow volume and duration.

summary.en: CAIDA's passive traces dataset contains traces collected from high-speed monitors on a commercial backbone link.
summary.zh: 用于网络流量研究的匿名化互联网骨干链路轨迹数据。

text.en: Anonymized passive Internet traces; this inventory entry specifically concerns the 2015 dataset.
text.zh: 匿名化被动互联网轨迹；此目录条目专指 2015 年数据集。

text.en: Packet-trace access and contents are governed by the CAIDA dataset catalog.
text.zh: 分组轨迹访问及内容以 CAIDA 数据目录为准。

text.en: Measurements are historical packet observations, not current network capacity.
text.zh: 测量为历史分组观测，并非当前网络容量。

text.en: Dataset supports offline traffic research rather than live resource management.
text.zh: 数据集支持离线流量研究，而非实时资源管理。

text.en: Official catalog provides request and usage information; current catalog dates must not be substituted for the 2015 observation period.
text.zh: 官方目录提供申请及使用说明；不能以当前目录日期替换 2015 年观测期。

tools.name: TinyMLPerf
aliases: tinyMLPerf Deep Learning Benchmarks for Embedded Devices
tools.description: The goal of TinyMLPerf is to provide a representative set of deep neural nets and benchmarking code to compare performance between embedded devices. Embedded devices include microcontrollers, DSPs, and tiny NN accelerators. These devices typically run at between 10MHz and 250MHz, and can perform inference using less then 50mW of power.

summary.en: The goal of TinyMLPerf is to provide a representative set of deep neural nets and benchmarking code to compare performance between embedded devices.
summary.zh: 面向微控制器、DSP 和小型神经网络加速器的推理基准。

note.en: Reference benchmarks use TFLM, while submissions may use an appropriate alternative software stack.
note.zh: 参考基准采用 TFLM，提交可使用合适的其他软件栈。

note.en: Benchmark code and versioned result repositories; old tentative deadlines in the README are not current scheduling information.
note.zh: 提供基准代码及按版本区分的结果仓库；README 中旧的暂定截止时间并非当前日程。

note.en: Executes embedded-device neural-network benchmarks.
note.zh: 执行嵌入式设备神经网络基准。

text.en: Executes embedded-device neural-network benchmarks.
text.zh: 执行嵌入式设备神经网络基准。

text.en: Targets microcontrollers, DSPs, and small neural accelerators; introductory clock/power ranges describe typical devices, not enforced limits.
text.zh: 面向微控制器、DSP 及小型神经加速器；简介的频率、功耗范围描述典型设备，并非强制限制。

text.en: Compares embedded inference performance; official results are separated by benchmark version.
text.zh: 比较嵌入式推理性能；官方结果按基准版本区分。

text.en: Reference benchmarks use TFLM, while submissions may use an appropriate alternative software stack.
text.zh: 参考基准采用 TFLM，提交可使用合适的其他软件栈。

text.en: Benchmark code and versioned result repositories; old tentative deadlines in the README are not current scheduling information.
text.zh: 提供基准代码及按版本区分的结果仓库；README 中旧的暂定截止时间并非当前日程。

tools.name: vivo Cell-Free Scheduling Dataset
aliases: vivo —— Dataset for Wireless Resource Scheduling in Cell-Free Scenarios (in Chinese)
tools.description: Aims to research AI-based scheduling strategies for Cell-Free systems. Dataset: https://commonbox.vivo.xyz/s/rUeNxBRZfKL Codes: https://commonbox.vivo.xyz/s/dHMSmyouTeC

summary.en: Aims to research AI-based scheduling strategies for Cell-Free systems.
summary.zh: 用于研究无蜂窝系统 AI 无线资源调度策略的数据与代码。

accessNote.en: The vivo sharing page returned no readable dataset description or schema. Access to the data files is needed to describe its fields and evaluation outputs.
accessNote.zh: vivo 分享页没有返回可读取的数据集描述或结构；需获取数据文件后才能描述其字段与评估输出。

tools.name: ASSOLO
tools.description: ASSOLO is a new active probing tool for estimating available bandwidth based on the concept of "self-induced congestion". ASSOLO features a new probing traffic profile called REACH (Reflected ExponentiAl Chirp), which tests a wide range of rates being more accurate in the center of the probing interval. Moreover, the tool runs inside a real-time operating system and uses some de-noising techniques to improve the measurement process.

summary.en: ASSOLO is a new active probing tool for estimating available bandwidth based on the concept of "self-induced congestion".
summary.zh: 通过主动探测估计网络可用带宽的工具。

text.en: Active probing tool estimates available end-to-end bandwidth.
text.zh: 主动探测工具估计端到端可用带宽。

text.en: Uses REACH probe-rate patterns and de-noising in a real-time operating environment.
text.zh: 在实时操作环境使用 REACH 探测速率模式及去噪。

text.en: Estimates available bandwidth; comparison claims belong to the cited experiment.
text.zh: 估计可用带宽；比较主张对应所引用实验。

text.en: Controls probing rates; it does not allocate application compute resources.
text.zh: 控制探测速率，不分配应用计算资源。

text.en: Official source release 0.9a and README are linked from the project page.
text.zh: 项目页面链接官方 0.9a 源码及 README。

tools.name: netem
tools.description: netem provides Network Emulation functionality for testing protocols by emulating the properties of wide area networks. The current version emulates variable delay, loss, duplication and re-ordering.

summary.en: netem provides Network Emulation functionality for testing protocols by emulating the properties of wide area networks.
summary.zh: 模拟网络时延、丢包、重复和乱序等条件以测试协议。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine family itself; the reviewed version and its documented scope apply.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎系列，具体以本次核对版本及文档范围为准。

note.en: Shell command examples and reproducible random seeds; kernel timer granularity limits timing accuracy.
note.zh: 提供 Shell 命令示例及可复现随机种子；定时精度受内核计时粒度限制。

note.en: Linux packet impairment emulator for testing real network traffic.
note.zh: 用于测试真实网络流量的 Linux 分组损伤仿真器。

text.en: Linux packet impairment emulator for testing real network traffic.
text.zh: 用于测试真实网络流量的 Linux 分组损伤仿真器。

text.en: Queue length, rate, packet overhead and slot limits model constrained links.
text.zh: 通过队列长度、速率、分组开销和时隙限制模拟受限链路。

text.en: Delay, jitter and loss are configured impairments, not automatically measured application performance.
text.zh: 时延、抖动与丢包是配置的损伤参数，并不自动等同于应用性能测量。

text.en: tc qdisc configures delay distributions, correlated loss, duplication, reordering and rate limits.
text.zh: 通过 tc qdisc 配置时延分布、相关丢包、重复、乱序和限速。

text.en: Shell command examples and reproducible random seeds; kernel timer granularity limits timing accuracy.
text.zh: 提供 Shell 命令示例及可复现随机种子；定时精度受内核计时粒度限制。

tools.name: nmon
tools.description: This systems administrator, tuner, benchmark tool gives you a huge amount of important performance information in one go. Many helpful tools for data analysis can be also found on section Data Analysis.

summary.en: This systems administrator, tuner, benchmark tool gives you a huge amount of important performance information in one go.
summary.zh: 采集与分析系统运行和资源性能信息的监测工具。

note.en: Curses terminal views plus optional nmonchart or spreadsheet analysis; njmon is a distinct JSON-producing companion.
note.zh: 提供 Curses 终端视图及可选 nmonchart、电子表格分析；njmon 是独立的 JSON 输出配套工具。

note.en: Displays live metrics and saves CSV time-series data for longer captures.
note.zh: 显示实时指标，并保存 CSV 时间序列用于长期采集。

text.en: Monitors real host performance.
text.zh: 监测真实主机性能。

text.en: Observes CPU, memory, network, disks, file systems, NFS, and processes; coverage depends on OS/platform.
text.zh: 观察 CPU、内存、网络、磁盘、文件系统、NFS 及进程；覆盖取决于系统和平台。

text.en: Displays live metrics and saves CSV time-series data for longer captures.
text.zh: 显示实时指标，并保存 CSV 时间序列用于长期采集。

text.en: Collects selected performance categories rather than scheduling application tasks.
text.zh: 采集所选性能类别，而非调度应用任务。

text.en: Curses terminal views plus optional nmonchart or spreadsheet analysis; njmon is a distinct JSON-producing companion.
text.zh: 提供 Curses 终端视图及可选 nmonchart、电子表格分析；njmon 是独立的 JSON 输出配套工具。

tools.name: GeoLite2
tools.description: Mapping source IPv4 addresses to geo-graphical locations.

summary.en: Mapping source IPv4 addresses to geo-graphical locations.
summary.zh: 将 IP 地址映射到地理位置的数据资源。

text.en: IP geolocation and ASN data delivered as databases or web services.
text.zh: 通过数据库或网页服务提供 IP 地理位置及 ASN 数据。

text.en: Records geographic areas and accuracy radii, not precise household locations.
text.zh: 记录地理区域及精度半径，而非精确住址。

text.en: Accuracy radius expresses location uncertainty; some fields are absent for some addresses.
text.zh: 精度半径表示定位不确定性；部分地址缺少部分字段。

text.en: Database downloads, updates, and lookup APIs manage data access; this resource does not allocate computing tasks.
text.zh: 数据库下载、更新及查询 API 管理数据访问；此资源不分配计算任务。

text.en: Developer documentation covers keys, formats, client integrations, and automated updates.
text.zh: 开发文档涵盖密钥、格式、客户端集成及自动更新。

tools.name: Sigar
tools.description: The Sigar API provides a portable interface for gathering system information such as: System memory, swap, cpu, load average, uptime, logins Per-process memory, cpu, credential info, state, arguments, environment, open files File system detection and metrics Network interface detection, configuration info and metrics TCP and UDP connection tables Network route table This information is available in most operating systems, but each OS has their own way(s) providing it. SIGAR provides developers with API to access this information regardless of the underlying platform. one The core API is implemented in pure C with bindings currently implemented for Java, Perl, Ruby, Python, Erlang, PHP and C#.

summary.en: The Sigar API provides a portable interface for gathering system information such as: System memory, swap, cpu, load average, uptime, logins Per-process memory, cpu, credential info, state, arguments, environment, open files File system detection and metrics Network interface detection, configuration info and metrics TCP and UDP connection tables Network route table This information is available in most operating systems, but each OS has their own way(s) providing it.
summary.zh: 通过可移植 API 采集系统和进程的资源状态。

note.en: Getter APIs expose CPU times, memory use, process I/O and network counters; applications can compute derived metrics.
note.zh: Getter API 提供 CPU 时间、内存使用、进程 I/O 和网络计数；应用可计算派生指标。

text.en: Native API for observing the running operating system and processes.
text.zh: 用于观测正在运行的操作系统与进程的原生 API。

text.en: CPU, memory, swap, processes, disks and network interfaces have dedicated data structures.
text.zh: 为 CPU、内存、交换空间、进程、磁盘与网络接口提供专用数据结构。

text.en: Getter APIs expose CPU times, memory use, process I/O and network counters; applications can compute derived metrics.
text.zh: Getter API 提供 CPU 时间、内存使用、进程 I/O 和网络计数；应用可计算派生指标。

text.en: Reads resource limits and process state; this header does not establish a cluster scheduling policy interface.
text.zh: 可读取资源限制与进程状态；此头文件未确认集群调度策略接口。

text.en: C API exposes typed structures and get/destroy functions for embedding in monitoring code.
text.zh: C API 提供类型化结构及 get/destroy 函数，可嵌入监控代码。

tools.name: Edge Courier
tools.description: An application for solving the whole-file-sync problem which needs high bandwidth in the cloud.

summary.en: An application for solving the whole-file-sync problem which needs high bandwidth in the cloud.
summary.zh: 面向云端整文件同步带宽开销的应用方案。

text.en: Edge-hosted personal service reduces mobile cloud-file synchronization traffic.
text.zh: 边缘托管的个人服务减少移动云文件同步流量。

text.en: Separates a mobile client and an edge personal-service instance.
text.zh: 分离移动客户端与边缘个人服务实例。

text.en: Targets transferred traffic when files receive small changes; the overview provides no metric API.
text.zh: 针对文件小幅修改时的传输流量；概述未提供指标 API。

text.en: Detects file changes at the edge to reduce end-device traffic.
text.zh: 在边缘检测文件变化以减少终端流量。

text.en: Source is divided into client and edge folders with component-specific READMEs.
text.zh: 源码分为 client 和 edge 文件夹，并提供组件 README。

tools.name: Eman's Edge Computing System For AI Applications
tools.description: Highly accurate AI applications, particularly for Computer Vision requires extensive memory and computational power. Eman's Edge Computing System orchestrates resource limited devices that requires using resource heavy AI algorithms so that a system can still achieve ideal system performances. This is done through Edge's monitoring modules that determines how to adjust the system so the system can operate efficiently based on its environments conditions.

summary.en: Highly accurate AI applications, particularly for Computer Vision requires extensive memory and computational power.
summary.zh: 监测边缘设备资源并编排计算密集型 AI 应用。

accessNote.en: The original GitHub repository returned HTTP 404. Its implementation is not accessible through the listed endpoint.
accessNote.zh: 原 GitHub 仓库返回 HTTP 404，所列入口无法访问其实现。

tools.name: Adlik
tools.description: Adlik [ædlik] is an end-to-end optimizing framework for deep learning models. The goal of Adlik is to accelerate deep learning inference process both on cloud and embedded environment.

summary.en: Adlik [ædlik] is an end-to-end optimizing framework for deep learning models.
summary.zh: 优化深度学习模型，以支持云与嵌入式设备上的推理部署。

note.en: Docker images, tutorials, and runnable examples; on-device use links the generated library.
note.zh: 提供 Docker 镜像、教程及可运行示例；设备端使用需链接生成的库。

note.en: Docker images, tutorials, and runnable examples; on-device use links the generated library.
note.zh: 提供 Docker 镜像、教程及可运行示例；设备端使用需链接生成的库。

note.en: Compiles models and runs inference in cloud, edge containers, or device libraries.
note.zh: 编译模型，在云端、边缘容器或设备库中执行推理。

text.en: Compiles models and runs inference in cloud, edge containers, or device libraries.
text.zh: 编译模型，在云端、边缘容器或设备库中执行推理。

text.en: Targets CPU/GPU environments and multiple serving backends, including TensorRT, OpenVINO, and TensorFlow Lite.
text.zh: 面向 CPU、GPU 及 TensorRT、OpenVINO、TensorFlow Lite 等服务后端。

text.en: Provides model-specific inference benchmarks; comparisons depend on the listed hardware and serving engine.
text.zh: 提供按模型划分的推理基准；比较依赖所列硬件及服务引擎。

text.en: Pruning, quantization, structural compression, and model loading support deployment optimization.
text.zh: 通过剪枝、量化、结构压缩及模型加载支持部署优化。

text.en: Docker images, tutorials, and runnable examples; on-device use links the generated library.
text.zh: 提供 Docker 镜像、教程及可运行示例；设备端使用需链接生成的库。

tools.name: AI Model Efficiency Toolkit (AIMET)
tools.description: AIMET is a library that provides advanced model quantization and compression techniques for trained neural network models. It provides features that have been proven to improve run-time performance of deep learning neural network models with lower compute and memory requirements and minimal impact to task accuracy.

summary.en: AIMET is a library that provides advanced model quantization and compression techniques for trained neural network models.
summary.zh: 用于训练后模型量化与压缩的工具库。

note.en: Quantization prepares models for edge deployment; this does not make the optimizer a device runtime.
note.zh: 量化用于准备边缘部署模型；优化工具本身不等于设备运行时。

text.en: Quantizes trained PyTorch and ONNX models for deployment.
text.zh: 量化已训练的 PyTorch、ONNX 模型以供部署。

text.en: Works on model weights, activations, encodings, and reduced-precision representations.
text.zh: 处理模型权重、激活、编码及低精度表示。

text.en: Accuracy retention, compute load, and memory footprint motivate optimization; headline speedups are hardware-dependent.
text.zh: 以保持精度、降低计算量和内存占用为优化目标；宣传加速比依赖硬件。

text.en: Provides calibration, AdaRound, SeqMSE, batch-normalization folding, and post-training or fine-tuning techniques.
text.zh: 提供校准、AdaRound、SeqMSE、批归一化折叠及训练后或微调技术。

text.en: Python APIs and PyPI packages integrate with model pipelines; source builds use documented Docker environments.
text.zh: Python API 和 PyPI 包集成模型流水线；源码构建使用文档指定的 Docker 环境。

tools.name: Apache TVM
tools.description: Apache TVM is an open source machine learning compiler framework for CPUs, GPUs, and machine learning accelerators. It aims to enable machine learning engineers to optimize and run computations efficiently on any hardware backend.

summary.en: Apache TVM is an open source machine learning compiler framework for CPUs, GPUs, and machine learning accelerators.
summary.zh: 将机器学习模型编译部署到 CPU、GPU 和专用加速器。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine itself. Consult the listed version and scope before selecting an extension or backend.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎；选择扩展或后端时需查看版本与适用范围。

note.en: Python-first development with build instructions, tutorials, and compiler examples.
note.zh: 以 Python 为主要开发接口，提供构建说明、教程及编译器示例。

text.en: Machine-learning compiler creates deployable model modules.
text.zh: 机器学习编译器生成可部署模型模块。

text.en: TensorIR represents tensor programs and Relax represents computation graphs.
text.zh: TensorIR 表示张量程序，Relax 表示计算图。

text.en: VirtualMachine.time_evaluator benchmarks a named runtime function with configurable repetition and warmup handling, returning timing samples/BenchmarkResult. Use the target runtime/device when interpreting latency.
text.zh: VirtualMachine.time_evaluator 对指定运行时函数执行计时，可配置重复次数并处理预热，返回计时样本或 BenchmarkResult；解释时延时需对应实际目标运行时和设备。

text.en: Python-customizable transformations optimize graphs, tensor programs, and libraries across levels.
text.zh: Python 可定制变换跨层优化图、张量程序及库。

text.en: Python-first development with build instructions, tutorials, and compiler examples.
text.zh: 以 Python 为主要开发接口，提供构建说明、教程及编译器示例。

tools.name: AutoDiCE
tools.description: A tool featuring automated splitting of a CNN model into a set of submodels and automated code generation for distributed and collaborative execution of these submodels on multiple, possibly heterogeneous, edge devices. AutoDiCE is the first fully automated tool for distributed CNN inference over multiple resource-constrained devices at the Edge.

summary.en: A tool featuring automated splitting of a CNN model into a set of submodels and automated code generation for distributed and collaborative execution of these submodels on multiple, possibly heterogeneous, edge devices.
summary.zh: 自动拆分 CNN 并生成代码，在多个异构边缘设备上协同推理。

note.en: CMake, installation scripts, and a step-by-step tutorial; MPI versions must agree across devices.
note.zh: 提供 CMake、安装脚本及分步教程；设备间 MPI 版本需要一致。

note.en: A LOG_LAYERS build option enables layer logging.
note.zh: LOG_LAYERS 构建选项启用层日志。

note.en: Generates and executes distributed CNN inference across edge devices.
note.zh: 跨边缘设备生成并执行分布式 CNN 推理。

text.en: Generates and executes distributed CNN inference across edge devices.
text.zh: 跨边缘设备生成并执行分布式 CNN 推理。

text.en: ONNX partitions map to heterogeneous resources; OpenMP and MPI expose intra- and interdevice parallelism, with platform-dependent CUDA/Vulkan support.
text.zh: ONNX 分区映射到异构资源；OpenMP 和 MPI 提供设备内外并行，CUDA、Vulkan 支持取决于平台。

text.en: A LOG_LAYERS build option enables layer logging.
text.zh: LOG_LAYERS 构建选项启用层日志。

text.en: Mapping specifications control model partitioning and placement on target devices.
text.zh: 映射说明控制模型划分及目标设备上的分区放置。

text.en: CMake, installation scripts, and a step-by-step tutorial; MPI versions must agree across devices.
text.zh: 提供 CMake、安装脚本及分步教程；设备间 MPI 版本需要一致。

tools.name: BerryNet
tools.description: This project turns edge devices such as Raspberry Pi into an intelligent gateway with deep learning running on it. No internet connection is required, everything is done locally on the edge device itself. Further, multiple edge devices can create a distributed AIoT network.

summary.en: This project turns edge devices such as Raspberry Pi into an intelligent gateway with deep learning running on it.
summary.zh: 把树莓派等设备转换为可本地运行深度学习的智能网关。

note.en: Node.js/Python implementation with a Freeboard web dashboard and installation guide.
note.zh: Node.js、Python 实现，提供 Freeboard 网页仪表盘及安装指南。

note.en: Displays inference results and exposes component stderr logs through supervisorctl.
note.zh: 显示推理结果，并通过 supervisorctl 查看组件标准错误日志。

note.en: Runs offline image classification and detection on Raspberry Pi and other edge devices.
note.zh: 在树莓派等边缘设备离线运行图像分类与检测。

text.en: Runs offline image classification and detection on Raspberry Pi and other edge devices.
text.zh: 在树莓派等边缘设备离线运行图像分类与检测。

text.en: Connects cameras, AI engines, and processors through MQTT.
text.zh: 通过 MQTT 连接摄像头、AI 引擎及处理组件。

text.en: Displays inference results and exposes component stderr logs through supervisorctl.
text.zh: 显示推理结果，并通过 supervisorctl 查看组件标准错误日志。

text.en: Independent components can be configured, stopped, and restarted with Supervisor.
text.zh: 独立组件可配置，并通过 Supervisor 停止或重启。

text.en: Node.js/Python implementation with a Freeboard web dashboard and installation guide.
text.zh: Node.js、Python 实现，提供 Freeboard 网页仪表盘及安装指南。

tools.name: Bi-Real Net
tools.description: Compared with the standard 1-bit CNNs, Bi-Real net utilizes a simple short-cut to significantly enhance the representational capability. Further, an advanced training algorithm is specifically designed for training 1-bit CNNs (including Bi-Real net), including a tighter approximation of the derivative of the sign function with respect the activation, the magnitude-aware gradient with respect to the weight, as well as a novel initialization.

summary.en: Compared with the standard 1-bit CNNs, Bi-Real net utilizes a simple short-cut to significantly enhance the representational capability.
summary.zh: 研究一位二值神经网络的结构与训练方法。

note.en: Python/PyTorch and Caffe implementations with explicit historical dependencies and training recipes.
note.zh: 提供 Python、PyTorch 与 Caffe 实现，列明历史依赖及训练配方。

text.en: Research implementation trains binary convolutional neural networks.
text.zh: 研究实现用于训练二值卷积神经网络。

text.en: Binarizes weights and activations while retaining real-valued shortcut information.
text.zh: 二值化权重与激活，同时保留实值捷径信息。

text.en: Reports ImageNet classification accuracy under documented training and evaluation settings.
text.zh: 在文档所列训练、评估设置下报告 ImageNet 分类准确率。

text.en: Uses a one-layer-per-block structure and specialized training; the PyTorch recipe differs from the original Caffe procedure.
text.zh: 采用每块一层结构及专门训练；PyTorch 配方与原始 Caffe 过程不同。

text.en: Python/PyTorch and Caffe implementations with explicit historical dependencies and training recipes.
text.zh: 提供 Python、PyTorch 与 Caffe 实现，列明历史依赖及训练配方。

tools.name: BMXNet
tools.description: Apache MXNet is a deep learning framework designed for both efficiency and flexibility. It allows you to mix symbolic and imperative programming to maximize efficiency and productivity. At its core, MXNet contains a dynamic dependency scheduler that automatically parallelizes both symbolic and imperative operations on the fly. A graph optimization layer on top of that makes symbolic execution fast and memory efficient. MXNet is portable and lightweight, scalable to many GPUs and machines.

summary.en: Apache MXNet is a deep learning framework designed for both efficiency and flexibility.
summary.zh: MXNet 生态中的神经网络工具；原清单简介主要介绍 MXNet 框架。

notes.en: The official GitHub repository was archived at the review date. Verify dependency compatibility before using this historical version.
notes.zh: 核查时官方 GitHub 仓库已归档；使用历史版本前需检查依赖兼容性。

text.en: MXNet fork implements quantized and binary neural networks.
text.zh: MXNet 分支实现量化与二值神经网络。

text.en: Custom layers configure activation and weight bit widths; only the converted binary representation packs weights to one bit.
text.zh: 自定义层配置激活与权重位宽；仅转换后的二值表示将权重打包为一位。

text.en: The README explicitly warns that 2–31-bit experimental quantization still stores floats and does not save memory or improve speed.
text.zh: README 明确提示，实验性 2–31 位量化仍以浮点数存储，不节省内存或提高速度。

text.en: Drop-in quantized layers and a converter produce binary model files.
text.zh: 量化层替换及转换器生成二值模型文件。

text.en: CMake build, Python bindings, and a Docker recipe; the supplied Docker recipe does not provide CUDA.
text.zh: 提供 CMake 构建、Python 绑定及 Docker 配方；所给 Docker 配方不提供 CUDA。

tools.name: BranchyNet
tools.description: Fast inference via early exiting from deep neural networks. The architecture allows prediction results for a large portion of test samples to exit the network early via these branches when samples can already be inferred with high confidence.

summary.en: Fast inference via early exiting from deep neural networks.
summary.zh: 通过分支提前退出机制降低深度神经网络推理开销。

note.en: Python 2.7 and Chainer 1.17.0, result scripts, notebooks, and Docker setup; GPU Docker support requires customization.
note.zh: 采用 Python 2.7、Chainer 1.17.0，提供结果脚本、笔记本及 Docker 配置；GPU Docker 支持需要调整。

text.en: Neural networks use early-exit branches for inference.
text.zh: 神经网络通过提前退出分支进行推理。

text.en: Experiments use LeNet, AlexNet, and ResNet on MNIST or CIFAR-10; a GPU is required by the setup.
text.zh: 实验使用 LeNet、AlexNet、ResNet 及 MNIST 或 CIFAR-10；安装说明要求 GPU。

text.en: Evaluates classification accuracy and inference time.
text.zh: 评估分类准确率及推理时间。

text.en: Confidence-based exits avoid executing later layers for suitable samples.
text.zh: 基于置信度的退出机制使适合的样本跳过后续层。

text.en: Python 2.7 and Chainer 1.17.0, result scripts, notebooks, and Docker setup; GPU Docker support requires customization.
text.zh: 采用 Python 2.7、Chainer 1.17.0，提供结果脚本、笔记本及 Docker 配置；GPU Docker 支持需要调整。

tools.name: Caffe2
tools.description: Caffe2 is a lightweight, modular, and scalable deep learning framework. Building on the original Caffe, Caffe2 is designed with expression, speed, and modularity in mind.

summary.en: Caffe2 is a lightweight, modular, and scalable deep learning framework.
summary.zh: 轻量、模块化的深度学习框架。

note.en: Historical deep-learning framework for distributed training and mobile deployment.
note.zh: 用于分布式训练及移动部署的历史深度学习框架。

text.en: Historical deep-learning framework for distributed training and mobile deployment.
text.zh: 用于分布式训练及移动部署的历史深度学习框架。

text.en: Operator-based libraries target CPUs, CUDA, and documented mobile hardware.
text.zh: 基于算子的库面向 CPU、CUDA 及文档所述移动硬件。

text.en: Model migration requires checking accuracy and loss against the original model.
text.zh: 模型迁移需要对照原始模型检查准确率与损失。

text.en: Custom operators and modular computation support model execution and extension.
text.zh: 自定义算子及模块化计算支持模型执行和扩展。

text.en: C++/Python APIs and mobile tutorials remain documented, but the site explicitly announces API deprecation.
text.zh: 仍有 C++、Python API 及移动教程文档，但网站明确宣布 API 弃用。

tools.name: CMSIS-NN
tools.description: Collection of efficient neural network kernels developed to maximize the performance and minimize the memory footprint on Cortex-M processor cores.

summary.en: Collection of efficient neural network kernels developed to maximize the performance and minimize the memory footprint on Cortex-M processor cores.
summary.zh: 面向 Arm Cortex-M 的神经网络计算内核集合。

text.en: Neural-network kernel library for Arm Cortex-M inference.
text.zh: 用于 Arm Cortex-M 推理的神经网络算子库。

text.en: Integer kernels follow TFLM int8/int16 specifications; float APIs are experimental and primarily target MVE.
text.zh: 整数算子遵循 TFLM int8、int16 规范；浮点 API 为实验性，主要面向 MVE。

text.en: Bit-exactness is defined against TFLM reference kernels; performance depends on instruction support and tensor layout.
text.zh: 位精确性以 TFLM 参考算子为准；性能依赖指令支持及张量布局。

text.en: Architecture-specific kernels and optional packed weights optimize execution and memory use.
text.zh: 架构专用算子及可选权重打包优化执行和内存使用。

text.en: C library with versioned releases and operator support documentation; Arm A-class is not the intended float deployment target.
text.zh: C 库，提供版本发布及算子支持文档；Arm A 系列并非预期浮点部署目标。

tools.name: Communication-Aware DNN Pruning (CaP)
tools.description: A novel distributed inference framework for distributing DNN computations across a physical network. Departing from conventional pruning methods, CaP takes the physical network topology into consideration and produces DNNs that are communication-aware, designed for both accurate and fast execution over such a distributed deployment.

summary.en: A novel distributed inference framework for distributing DNN computations across a physical network.
summary.zh: 结合网络拓扑进行神经网络剪枝与分布式推理。

note.en: Python/PyTorch with pinned historical dependencies and a runnable CIFAR-10 shell script.
note.zh: Python、PyTorch 实现，列明历史依赖并提供可运行 CIFAR-10 Shell 脚本。

text.en: Communication-aware pruning prepares DNNs for distributed inference.
text.zh: 通信感知剪枝为分布式推理准备 DNN。

text.en: Accounts for the physical network topology when pruning models.
text.zh: 剪枝时考虑物理网络拓扑。

text.en: Evaluates CIFAR-10/100 accuracy and total execution time; reported gains are experiment-specific.
text.zh: 评估 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 准确率和总执行时间；所报收益仅对应具体实验。

text.en: Pruning balances network communication and model computation; a sample uses 0.75 sparsity.
text.zh: 剪枝平衡网络通信与模型计算；示例采用 0.75 稀疏率。

text.en: Python/PyTorch with pinned historical dependencies and a runnable CIFAR-10 shell script.
text.zh: Python、PyTorch 实现，列明历史依赖并提供可运行 CIFAR-10 Shell 脚本。

tools.name: Compute Library
tools.description: The Compute Library is a collection of low-level machine learning functions optimized for Arm® Cortex®-A and Arm® Mali™ GPUs architectures.

summary.en: The Compute Library is a collection of low-level machine learning functions optimized for Arm® Cortex®-A and Arm® Mali™ GPUs architectures.
summary.zh: 针对 Arm Cortex-A 和 Mali GPU 优化的底层机器学习函数库。

note.en: Build with profile=1 to collect CPU/GPU timing traces; profiling level and platform/backend determine coverage. Perfetto visualizes the collected function/kernel traces.
note.zh: 编译时启用 profile=1 可收集 CPU／GPU 时间跟踪；覆盖范围取决于分析级别、平台和后端，通过 Perfetto 可视化函数／内核跟踪。

note.en: Build with profile=1 to collect CPU/GPU timing traces; profiling level and platform/backend determine coverage. Perfetto visualizes the collected function/kernel traces.
note.zh: 编译时启用 profile=1 可收集 CPU／GPU 时间跟踪；覆盖范围取决于分析级别、平台和后端，通过 Perfetto 可视化函数／内核跟踪。

text.en: Low-level machine-learning kernels for Arm processors and GPUs.
text.zh: 面向 Arm 处理器及 GPU 的底层机器学习算子。

text.en: Supports Arm CPU instruction extensions, Mali GPUs, and several floating-point and integer data types.
text.zh: 支持 Arm CPU 指令扩展、Mali GPU 及多种浮点与整数类型。

text.en: Build with profile=1 to collect CPU/GPU timing traces; profiling level and platform/backend determine coverage. Perfetto visualizes the collected function/kernel traces.
text.zh: 编译时启用 profile=1 可收集 CPU／GPU 时间跟踪；覆盖范围取决于分析级别、平台和后端，通过 Perfetto 可视化函数／内核跟踪。

text.en: Kernel fusion, convolution variants, OpenCL tuning, and GEMM heuristics optimize workloads.
text.zh: 通过算子融合、多种卷积实现、OpenCL 调优及 GEMM 启发式优化工作负载。

text.en: C++ library with reference API, build guide, and binaries; listed experimental platforms and build systems retain that status.
text.zh: C++ 库，提供参考 API、构建指南及二进制；所列实验性平台和构建方式仍按实验性标注。

tools.name: Condensa
tools.description: CONDENSA allows developers to design strategies for compressing DL models, resulting significant reduction in both the memory footprint and execution time. It uses a Bayesian optimization-based method to find compression hyperparameters automatically by exploiting an L-C optimizer to recover the accuracy loss during compression. They reported a 2.22 times runtime improvement over an uncompressed VGG-19 on the CIFAR-10 dataset with up to 65 times memory reduction. src from: 10.1145/3469029

summary.en: CONDENSA allows developers to design strategies for compressing DL models, resulting significant reduction in both the memory footprint and execution time.
summary.zh: 使用可编程策略与贝叶斯优化研究深度学习模型压缩。

note.en: Linux/PyTorch setup, notebooks, and examples; the reviewed original branch points to lite as its successor.
note.zh: 提供 Linux、PyTorch 配置、笔记本及示例；核查的原始分支指向后继 lite 分支。

text.en: Python system for programmable neural-network compression.
text.zh: 用于可编程神经网络压缩的 Python 系统。

text.en: Compression schemes target combinations of DNN architecture, hardware, and optimization objective.
text.zh: 压缩方案针对 DNN 架构、硬件及优化目标的组合。

text.en: Optimization attempts to recover accuracy lost during compression.
text.zh: 优化尝试恢复压缩造成的精度损失。

text.en: Composable operators implement pruning and quantization; an augmented-Lagrangian optimizer handles constraints.
text.zh: 可组合算子实现剪枝与量化；增广拉格朗日优化器处理约束。

text.en: Linux/PyTorch setup, notebooks, and examples; the reviewed original branch points to lite as its successor.
text.zh: 提供 Linux、PyTorch 配置、笔记本及示例；核查的原始分支指向后继 lite 分支。

tools.name: Core ML
tools.description: Core ML optimizes on-device performance by leveraging the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine while minimizing its memory footprint and power consumption. Running a model strictly on the user’s device removes any need for a network connection, which helps keep the user’s data private and your app responsive.

summary.en: Core ML optimizes on-device performance by leveraging the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine while minimizing its memory footprint and power consumption.
summary.zh: 利用 Apple 设备上的 CPU、GPU 和神经网络引擎运行模型。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine itself. Consult the listed version and scope before selecting an extension or backend.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎；选择扩展或后端时需查看版本与适用范围。

note.en: Core ML executes predictions and supported model fine-tuning on Apple devices.
note.zh: Core ML 在 Apple 设备执行预测及支持的模型微调。

text.en: Core ML executes predictions and supported model fine-tuning on Apple devices.
text.zh: Core ML 在 Apple 设备执行预测及支持的模型微调。

text.en: Uses CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine; Core ML Tools is the separate Python conversion/optimization package.
text.zh: 使用 CPU、GPU 及 Neural Engine；Core ML Tools 是独立 Python 转换、优化包。

text.en: Core ML Tools can validate converted models through predictions on macOS.
text.zh: Core ML Tools 可在 macOS 上通过预测验证转换模型。

text.en: On-device execution and model optimization target memory and power requirements.
text.zh: 设备端执行及模型优化面向内存和功耗要求。

text.en: Models integrate into apps with Xcode; Python conversion examples do not make the Apple runtime cross-platform.
text.zh: 模型通过 Xcode 集成到应用；Python 转换示例不意味着 Apple 运行时跨平台。

tools.name: daBNN
tools.description: daBNN is an open-source fast inference framework developed by Zhang et al., which can implement Binary Neural Networks on ARM devices [161]. An upgraded bit-packing scheme and binary direct convolution have been used in this framework to shrink the cost of convolution and speed up inference. This framework is written in C++ and ARM assembly and has Java support for the Android package. This fast framework can be 6 times faster than BMXNet on Bi-Real Net. src from: 10.1145/3469029

summary.en: daBNN is an open-source fast inference framework developed by Zhang et al., which can implement Binary Neural Networks on ARM devices [161].
summary.zh: 面向 Arm 设备的二值神经网络推理框架。

note.en: Executes binary neural-network inference on Arm devices.
note.zh: 在 Arm 设备执行二值神经网络推理。

text.en: Executes binary neural-network inference on Arm devices.
text.zh: 在 Arm 设备执行二值神经网络推理。

text.en: Arm assembly implements binary convolution; ONNX conversion depends on a compatible custom binary operator.
text.zh: Arm 汇编实现二值卷积；ONNX 转换依赖兼容的自定义二值算子。

text.en: Reports ImageNet top-1 accuracy and single-thread latency on Google Pixel 1; these conditions limit comparisons.
text.zh: 报告 ImageNet top-1 准确率及 Google Pixel 1 单线程时延；比较应限定于这些条件。

text.en: Converts supported ONNX models into the deployed binary-network representation.
text.zh: 将支持的 ONNX 模型转换为部署用二值网络表示。

text.en: CMake/C++, Android packages and an application example; non-Android Arm targets require building.
text.zh: 提供 CMake、C++、Android 包及应用示例；非 Android Arm 目标需要构建。

tools.name: DDNN
tools.description: distributed deep neural networks (DDNNs) over distributed computing hierarchies, consisting of the cloud, the edge (fog) and end devices. While being able to accommodate inference of a deep neural network (DNN) in the cloud, a DDNN also allows fast and localized inference using shallow portions of the neural network at the edge and end devices. Due to its distributed nature, DDNNs enhance data privacy and system fault tolerance for DNN applications. When supported by a scalable distributed computing hierarchy, a DDNN can scale up in neural network size and scale out in geographical span.

summary.en: distributed deep neural networks (DDNNs) over distributed computing hierarchies, consisting of the cloud, the edge (fog) and end devices.
summary.zh: 在云、边缘和终端层次之间分布式执行深度神经网络。

text.en: Research code for distributing neural-network sections across cloud, edge, and end devices.
text.zh: 研究代码将神经网络分段分布到云、边缘及终端。

text.en: Uses a computing hierarchy and geographically distributed sensors.
text.zh: 使用分层计算环境及地理分布的传感器。

text.en: The described experiment evaluates recognition accuracy and communication cost; its reduction factor is not a universal guarantee.
text.zh: 所述实验评估识别准确率及通信开销；降低倍数不是通用保证。

text.en: Jointly trains mapped sections and enables local inference using shallow network portions.
text.zh: 联合训练映射的网络分段，并利用浅层网络实现本地推理。

text.en: The reviewed branch requires Python 2.7+ and Chainer 1.17+ and points to a separate PyTorch branch.
text.zh: 核查分支要求 Python 2.7+、Chainer 1.17+，并指向独立 PyTorch 分支。

tools.name: DeepIoT
tools.description: DeepIoT is a framework that shrinks a neural network into smaller dense matrices but keeps the performance of the algorithm almost the same. This framework finds the minimum number of filters and dimensions required by each layer and reduces the redundancy of that layer. src from: 10.1145/3469029

summary.en: DeepIoT is a framework that shrinks a neural network into smaller dense matrices but keeps the performance of the algorithm almost the same.
summary.zh: 通过压缩神经网络结构减少设备端存储与计算需求。

note.en: TensorFlow 1.2 and a runnable DeepIoT_DeepSense_HHAR.py example.
note.zh: 采用 TensorFlow 1.2，提供可运行 DeepIoT_DeepSense_HHAR.py 示例。

text.en: TensorFlow implementation of a compressor-critic method for sensing-system DNN compression.
text.zh: 用于感知系统 DNN 压缩的 compressor-critic 方法 TensorFlow 实现。

text.en: An HHAR dataset is provided in TFRecord format.
text.zh: 提供 TFRecord 格式的 HHAR 数据集。

text.en: The HHAR example calculates training/development classification accuracy and tracks compression ratio during model compression. plot.py receives the training curves; values depend on this dataset, model, and training run.
text.zh: HHAR 示例计算训练集和开发集分类准确率，并在模型压缩过程中跟踪压缩比；通过 plot.py 保存训练曲线，数值取决于该数据集、模型与训练运行。

text.en: Compresses network structures using the research method identified by the repository.
text.zh: 通过仓库所述研究方法压缩网络结构。

text.en: TensorFlow 1.2 and a runnable DeepIoT_DeepSense_HHAR.py example.
text.zh: 采用 TensorFlow 1.2，提供可运行 DeepIoT_DeepSense_HHAR.py 示例。

tools.name: DeepStack
tools.description: DeepStack is an Open-Source AI API engine that serves pre-built models and custom models on multiple edge devices locally or on your private cloud.

summary.en: DeepStack is an Open-Source AI API engine that serves pre-built models and custom models on multiple edge devices locally or on your private cloud.
summary.zh: 在边缘设备或私有云本地提供 AI 模型 API 服务。

note.en: Official documentation provides Docker/native setup, API reference, and Python/C#/Node.js examples.
note.zh: 官方文档提供 Docker、原生配置、API 参考及 Python、C#、Node.js 示例。

note.en: Serves local or private-cloud AI models through APIs.
note.zh: 通过 API 提供本地或私有云 AI 模型服务。

text.en: Serves local or private-cloud AI models through APIs.
text.zh: 通过 API 提供本地或私有云 AI 模型服务。

text.en: Platform-specific deployments cover CPU, NVIDIA GPU/Jetson, and Arm64 environments.
text.zh: 平台特定部署覆盖 CPU、NVIDIA GPU、Jetson 及 Arm64 环境。

text.en: Returns task-specific recognition/detection results; throughput depends on selected speed mode and hardware.
text.zh: 返回任务特定识别、检测结果；吞吐量取决于所选速度模式及硬件。

text.en: Supports prebuilt and custom object-detection models, with API keys and persistent Docker storage options.
text.zh: 支持预建及自定义目标检测模型，并提供 API 密钥及持久 Docker 存储选项。

text.en: Official documentation provides Docker/native setup, API reference, and Python/C#/Node.js examples.
text.zh: 官方文档提供 Docker、原生配置、API 参考及 Python、C#、Node.js 示例。

tools.name: DeepThings
tools.description: A framework for locally distributed and adaptive CNN inference in resource-constrained IoT edge clusters. DeepThings mainly consists of: 1). A Fused Tile Partitioning (FTP) method for dividing convolutional layers into independently distributable tasks. FTP fuses layers and partitions them vertically in a grid fashion, which largely reduces communication and task migration overhead. 2). A distributed work stealing runtime system for IoT clusters to adaptively distribute FTP partitions in dynamic application scenarios.

summary.en: A framework for locally distributed and adaptive CNN inference in resource-constrained IoT edge clusters.
summary.zh: 面向资源受限物联网集群的分布式 CNN 推理框架。

note.en: Portable C implementation, Makefile, configuration header, and cluster/single-device examples; default inference uses NNPACK-accelerated Darknet.

tools.description: FATE (Federated AI Technology Enabler) is an open-source project initiated by Webank's AI Department to provide a secure computing framework to support the federated AI ecosystem. It implements secure computation protocols based on homomorphic encryption and multi-party computation (MPC). It supports federated learning architectures and secure computation of various machine learning algorithms, including logistic regression, tree-based algorithms, deep learning and transfer learning.

It requires your research object is a graph or been modeled as a graph, the reinforcement learning take the graph as environment states and produces actions by using a GNN-based policy network.

tools.name: Ianvs

Ianvs aims to test the performance of distributed synergy AI solutions following recognized standards, in order to facilitate more efficient and effective development. Ianvs also reveals best practices for developers and end users with presentation tools including leaderboards and test reports.

tools.name: KitNET
tools.description: KitNET is an online, unsupervised, and efficient anomaly detector. A Kitsune, in Japanese folklore, is a mythical fox-like creature that has a number of tails, can mimic different forms, and whose strength increases with experience. Similarly, Kit-NET has an ensemble of small neural networks (autoencoders), which are trained to mimic (reconstruct) network traffic patterns, and whose performance incrementally improves overtime.

summary.en: KitNET is an online, unsupervised, and efficient anomaly detector.
summary.zh: 用于在线无监督异常检测的神经网络模型。

text.zh: 增量处理特征向量；最大自编码器规模约束集成成员。

text.en: The process method returns an RMSE anomaly score.
text.zh: process 方法返回 RMSE 异常分数。

Thanks to open-source initiatives, it is now possible to develop personal AI assistants using open-sourced models. However, LLMs tend to be resource-intensive and computationally demanding. To create a scalable service, developers may need to rely on powerful clusters and expensive hardware to run model inference. Additionally, deploying LLMs presents several challenges, such as their ever-evolving model innovation, memory constraints, and the need for potential optimization techniques.

text.zh: REST 及语言、平台 API 提供 OpenAI 兼容接口，并附安装和入门指南。

tools.name: MNN
tools.description: MNN is a highly efficient and lightweight deep learning framework. It supports inference and training of deep learning models, and has industry leading performance for inference and training on-device. At present, MNN has been integrated in more than 20 apps of Alibaba Inc, such as Taobao, Tmall, Youku, Dingtalk, Xianyu and etc., covering more than 70 usage scenarios such as live broadcast, short video capture, search recommendation, product searching by image, interactive marketing, equity distribution, security risk control. In addition, MNN is also used on embedded devices, such as IoT.

summary.en: A lightweight framework for model inference and training on devices.
summary.zh: 用于设备端模型推理与训练的轻量深度学习框架。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine itself. Consult the listed version and scope before selecting an extension or backend.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎；选择扩展或后端时需查看版本与适用范围。

note.en: C++ framework with benchmark scripts, mobile apps, and an optional Workbench for visual training and deployment.
note.zh: C++ 框架，提供基准脚本、移动应用及可选 Workbench 可视化训练和部署工具。

note.en: C++ framework with benchmark scripts, mobile apps, and an optional Workbench for visual training and deployment.
note.zh: C++ 框架，提供基准脚本、移动应用及可选 Workbench 可视化训练和部署工具。

note.en: Runs on-device training and inference, including language and diffusion models.
note.zh: 运行设备端训练与推理，包括语言及扩散模型。

text.en: Runs on-device training and inference, including language and diffusion models.
text.zh: 运行设备端训练与推理，包括语言及扩散模型。

text.en: Targets phones, PCs, and IoT; supported accelerators include CUDA and a separately documented Hexagon backend.
text.zh: 面向手机、计算机及物联网；支持 CUDA 及单独文档说明的 Hexagon 后端。

text.en: Repository provides benchmark scripts and instructions; benchmark comparisons require their model and device settings.
text.zh: 仓库提供基准脚本及说明；基准比较需采用相应模型与设备设置。

text.en: Optimized convolution and backend selection support deployment; MNN-LLM and diffusion are dedicated runtime components.
text.zh: 优化卷积及后端选择支持部署；MNN-LLM 和 diffusion 为专门运行组件。

text.en: C++ framework with benchmark scripts, mobile apps, and an optional Workbench for visual training and deployment.
text.zh: C++ 框架，提供基准脚本、移动应用及可选 Workbench 可视化训练和部署工具。

tools.name: Model Compression Toolkit (MCT)
tools.description: Model Compression Toolkit (MCT) is an open source project for neural network model optimization under efficient, constrained hardware. This project provides researchers, developers, and engineers advanced quantization and compression tools for deploying state-of-the-art neural networks.

summary.en: Model Compression Toolkit (MCT) is an open source project for neural network model optimization under efficient, constrained hardware.
summary.zh: 面向受限硬件的神经网络模型优化与量化工具。

note.en: Optimizes models for edge deployment; target execution requires a compatible runtime.
note.zh: 优化面向边缘部署的模型；目标执行仍需兼容运行时。

note.en: Execution dependency documented by this project; version and selected workflow requirements still apply.
note.zh: 项目明确记录的执行依赖；仍需遵循所选版本与工作流程的要求。

note.en: Python APIs and notebooks; TensorBoard visualizes diagnostics and XQuant reports.
note.zh: Python API 及笔记本；TensorBoard 可视化诊断和 XQuant 报告。

note.en: Python APIs and notebooks; TensorBoard visualizes diagnostics and XQuant reports.
note.zh: Python API 及笔记本；TensorBoard 可视化诊断和 XQuant 报告。

text.en: Compresses pretrained PyTorch or Keras floating-point models.
text.zh: 压缩预训练 PyTorch 或 Keras 浮点模型。

text.en: Target-platform capabilities describe hardware-aware quantization and mixed precision.
text.zh: 目标平台能力描述硬件感知量化与混合精度。

text.en: XQuant reports similarity metrics and histograms between float and quantized models.
text.zh: XQuant 报告浮点与量化模型间的相似度指标及直方图。

text.en: Provides PTQ, gradient-based post-training quantization, QAT, and layer-specific editing rules.
text.zh: 提供训练后量化、基于梯度的训练后量化、量化感知训练及逐层编辑规则。

text.en: Python APIs and notebooks; TensorBoard visualizes diagnostics and XQuant reports.
text.zh: Python API 及笔记本；TensorBoard 可视化诊断和 XQuant 报告。

tools.name: MQBench
tools.description: MQBench is an open-source model quantization toolkit based on PyTorch fx. The envision of MQBench is to provide: 1) SOTA Algorithms. With MQBench, the hardware vendors and researchers can benefit from the latest research progress in academia. 2) Powerful Toolkits. With the toolkit, quantization node can be inserted to the original PyTorch module automatically with respect to the specific hardware. After training, the quantized model can be smoothly converted to the format that can inference on the real device.

summary.en: MQBench is an open-source model quantization toolkit based on PyTorch fx.
summary.zh: 基于 PyTorch FX 的模型量化工具包。

text.en: PyTorch FX toolkit for deployable model quantization.
text.zh: 用于可部署模型量化的 PyTorch FX 工具包。

text.en: Inserts quantization nodes according to the selected hardware backend.
text.zh: 根据选定硬件后端插入量化节点。

text.en: ImageNet classification benchmark tables compare calibration methods, weight/activation bit widths and models. Reproduction uses the stated pretrained models, validation data and YAML configuration.
text.zh: ImageNet 分类基准表比较校准方法、权重／激活位宽和模型；复现需使用指定预训练模型、验证集和 YAML 配置。

text.en: Transforms trained quantized models into formats suitable for target-device inference.
text.zh: 将训练后的量化模型转换为适合目标设备推理的格式。

text.en: Python package installed from source, with documentation; the snapshot supports PyTorch 2.5.1 and links a separate older branch.
text.zh: Python 包从源码安装，并提供文档；快照支持 PyTorch 2.5.1，并链接独立旧分支。

tools.name: ncnn
tools.description: ncnn is a high-performance neural network inference computing framework optimized for mobile platforms. ncnn is deeply considerate about deployment and uses on mobile phones from the beginning of design. ncnn does not have third party dependencies. it is cross-platform, and runs faster than all known open source frameworks on mobile phone cpu. Developers can easily deploy deep learning algorithm models to the mobile platform by using efficient ncnn implementation, create intelligent APPs, and bring the artificial intelligence to your fingertips. ncnn is currently being used in many Tencent applications, such as QQ, Qzone, WeChat, Pitu and so on.

summary.en: A neural-network inference framework designed for mobile platforms.
summary.zh: 面向移动平台的神经网络推理框架。

note.en: This entry provides the named engine itself. Consult the listed version and scope before selecting an extension or backend.
note.zh: 此条目本身提供所列引擎；选择扩展或后端时需查看版本与适用范围。

note.en: C++ and Python API examples, build guides, and platform binaries without third-party runtime dependencies.
note.zh: 提供 C++、Python API 示例、构建指南及平台二进制，无第三方运行时依赖。

note.en: Executes neural-network inference on phones, embedded systems, PCs, and browsers.
note.zh: 在手机、嵌入式设备、计算机及浏览器执行神经网络推理。

text.en: Executes neural-network inference on phones, embedded systems, PCs, and browsers.
text.zh: 在手机、嵌入式设备、计算机及浏览器执行神经网络推理。

text.en: CPU and Vulkan GPU backends; pnnx converts supported PyTorch and ONNX models.
text.zh: 提供 CPU、Vulkan GPU 后端；pnnx 转换支持的 PyTorch 和 ONNX 模型。

text.en: benchncnn benchmarks inference timing with configurable loops, threads, CPU/GPU device and cooling. Randomly generated weights make it a speed test, not an accuracy evaluation.
text.zh: benchncnn 测量推理时间，可配置循环、线程、CPU／GPU 设备及冷却；使用随机生成权重，因此属于速度测试，不能用于精度评价。

text.en: Model loading and extractors run named model inputs and outputs.
text.zh: 通过模型加载及 extractor 运行具名模型输入、输出。

text.en: C++ and Python API examples, build guides, and platform binaries without third-party runtime dependencies.
text.zh: 提供 C++、Python API 示例、构建指南及平台二进制，无第三方运行时依赖。

tools.name: Neurosurgeon
tools.description: A lightweight scheduler to automatically partition DNN computation between mobile devices and datacenters at the granularity of neural network layers.

summary.en: A lightweight scheduler to automatically partition DNN computation between mobile devices and datacenters at the granularity of neural network layers.
summary.zh: 在移动设备和数据中心之间按网络层划分 DNN 计算。

notes.en: UDP support is unresolved in the README and is not marked verified.
notes.zh: README 对 UDP 支持存在未解决的描述差异，因此不标为已核实。

text.en: Single-image offloading testbench using TensorFlow; this repository is an adaptation of Neurosurgeon.
text.zh: 使用 TensorFlow 的单图像卸载测试台；此仓库是 Neurosurgeon 的改编实现。

text.en: CPU and NVIDIA GPU setup is documented; UDP migration remains on the TODO list despite the introduction mentioning UDP.

text.zh: 测量图像分类卸载的综合端到端时延。

text.en: Investigates machine-learning task partitioning.
text.zh: 研究机器学习任务划分。

text.en: Python 3.5-era TensorFlow setup for Windows and Linux; historical CUDA dependencies constrain reproduction.
text.zh: 提供面向 Windows、Linux 的 Python 3.5 时代 TensorFlow 配置；历史 CUDA 依赖限制复现。

tools.name: nn-Meter
tools.description: nn-Meter is a novel and efficient system to accurately predict the inference latency of DNN models on diverse edge devices. The key idea is dividing a whole model inference into kernels, i.e., the execution units of fused operators on a device, and conduct kernel-level prediction.

summary.en: nn-Meter is a novel and efficient system to accurately predict the inference latency of DNN models on diverse edge devices.
summary.zh: 通过算子内核建模预测不同边缘设备上的 DNN 推理时延。

note.en: Predicts latency for edge devices without deploying the queried model on each device.
note.zh: 预测边缘设备时延，无需把每个查询模型部署到相应设备。

notes.en: The official GitHub repository was archived at the review date. Verify dependency compatibility before using this historical version.
notes.zh: 核查时官方 GitHub 仓库已归档；使用历史版本前需检查依赖兼容性。

text.en: Predicts DNN inference latency without deploying each queried model to a device.
text.zh: 预测 DNN 推理时延，无需将每个待查询模型部署到设备。

text.en: Kernel-level predictors are tied to device, processor, and inference-framework versions.
text.zh: 算子级预测器绑定设备、处理器和推理框架版本。

text.en: Predicts latency; reported prediction accuracy uses a ±10% tolerance on the listed evaluation set.
text.zh: 预测时延；所报预测准确率在列出的评估集上采用 ±10% 容差。

text.en: A builder allows constructing predictors for additional devices and hardware-aware architecture search.
text.zh: 构建器支持为额外设备建立预测器及硬件感知架构搜索。

text.en: Python package and APIs for TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX, and IR graphs, with Linux/Windows setup.
text.zh: Python 包和 API 支持 TensorFlow、PyTorch、ONNX 及 IR 图，提供 Linux、Windows 配置。

tools.name: nndeploy
tools.description: nndeploy is an end-to-end deployment framework for models. Centered around multi-end inference and model deployment based on directed acyclic graph, it is committed to providing users with a cross-platform, simple, easy-to-use, and high-performance model deployment experience.

summary.en: nndeploy is an end-to-end deployment framework for models.
summary.zh: 以有向无环图组织跨平台推理和模型部署流程。

tools.name: ns3-ai
tools.description: This module does not provide any AI algorithms or rely on any frameworks but instead is providing a Python module that enables AI interconnect, so the AI framework needs to be separately installed. You only need to clone or download this work, then import the Python modules, you could use this work to exchange data between ns-3 and your AI algorithms.

summary.en: This module does not provide any AI algorithms or rely on any frameworks but instead is providing a Python module that enables AI interconnect, so the AI framework needs to be separately installed.
summary.zh: 连接 ns-3 与独立 AI 框架，在 C++ 和 Python 之间交换数据。

note.en: Examples integrate user network-control algorithms, including Wi-Fi rate control and RL-TCP; the bridge itself supplies no general AI algorithm.
note.zh: 示例集成用户网络控制算法，包括 Wi-Fi 速率控制及 RL-TCP；桥接本身不提供通用 AI 算法。

note.zh: 自定义共享数据及观测将选定仿真测量值暴露给 Python。

tools.name: ns3-gym
tools.description: OpenAI Gym is a toolkit for reinforcement learning (RL) widely used in research. The network simulator ns–3 is the de-facto standard for academic and industry studies in the areas of networking protocols and communication technologies. ns3-gym is a framework that integrates both OpenAI Gym and ns-3 in order to encourage usage of RL in networking research.

summary.en: OpenAI Gym is a toolkit for reinforcement learning (RL) widely used in research.
summary.zh: 连接 ns-3 与 Gym，以支持网络领域的强化学习研究。

note.en: Integrates ns-3 network simulation with an external Gym reinforcement-learning agent.
note.zh: 将 ns-3 网络仿真与外部 Gym 强化学习智能体集成。

note.en: GetObservation, GetReward, and GetExtraInfo expose user-selected variables and measurements.
note.zh: GetObservation、GetReward 和 GetExtraInfo 暴露用户选定变量及测量值。

note.en: Linux-oriented build and Python examples; current instructions specify the compatible ns-3 branch.
note.zh: 提供面向 Linux 的构建及 Python 示例；当前说明指定兼容 ns-3 分支。

note.en: ExecuteActions applies user-defined agent actions to network control; this is not a built-in cloud task scheduler.
note.zh: ExecuteActions 将用户智能体动作应用于网络控制；并非内置云任务调度器。

text.en: Integrates ns-3 network simulation with an external Gym reinforcement-learning agent.

tools.name: Pocket
tools.description: A new approach for serving ML applications in settings like the edge, based on a shared ML runtime backend as a service and lightweight ML application pocket containers. Key to realizing Pocket is use of lightweight IPC, support for cross-client isolation, and a novel resource amplification method which inlines resource reallocation with IPC. The latter ensures just-in-time assignment of the limited edge resources where they're most needed, thereby reducing contention effects and boosting overall performance and efficiency. Pocket: ML Serving from the Edge

summary.en: A new approach for serving ML applications in settings like the edge, based on a shared ML runtime backend as a service and lightweight ML application pocket containers.

Also, it adopts a completely separated front-end/back-end design, which makes it possible to be transplanted and deployed onto CPU, GPU, NPU and other heterogeneous computing units rapidly, conveniently.

tools.description: TensorFlow Lite is an open-source deep learning framework to run TensorFlow models on-device. If you are new to TensorFlow Lite, we recommend that you first explore the pre-trained models and run the example apps below on a real device to see what TensorFlow Lite can do.

summary.en: TensorFlow Lite is an open-source deep learning framework to run TensorFlow models on-device.
summary.zh: 面向移动与嵌入式设备的模型推理工具链。

note.en: LiteRT continues TensorFlow Lite for on-device ML inference; the following current features refer to LiteRT v2.
note.zh: LiteRT 延续 TensorFlow Lite 的设备端机器学习推理；以下当前功能指 LiteRT v2。

text.en: LiteRT continues TensorFlow Lite for on-device ML inference; the following current features refer to LiteRT v2.
text.zh: LiteRT 延续 TensorFlow Lite 的设备端机器学习推理；以下当前功能指 LiteRT v2。

text.en: CPU/GPU/NPU support depends on platform and SDK; browser and language-model workflows have separate components.
text.zh: CPU、GPU、NPU 支持依赖平台及 SDK；浏览器和语言模型流程具有独立组件。

text.en: Current LiteRT provides timed ProfiledEventData after enabling profiling during CompiledModel compilation. This is the current LiteRT API, not a verified API of every historical TensorFlow Lite release.

text.en: CompiledModel automates accelerator selection and asynchronous execution, with explicit I/O buffer handling.
text.zh: CompiledModel 自动选择加速器并异步执行，提供显式 I/O 缓冲处理。

text.en: Runtime and conversion tools plus samples; LiteRT.js and LiteRT-LM should be checked separately rather than inherited by legacy TFLite.

tools.name: TNN
tools.description: TNN: A high-performance, lightweight neural network inference framework open sourced by Tencent Youtu Lab. It also has many outstanding advantages such as cross-platform, high performance, model compression, and code tailoring. The TNN framework further strengthens the support and performance optimization of mobile devices on the basis of the original Rapidnet and ncnn frameworks. At the same time, it refers to the high performance and good scalability characteristics of the industry's mainstream open source frameworks, and expands the support for X86 and NV GPUs. On the mobile phone, TNN has been used by many applications such as mobile QQ, weishi, and Pitu. As a basic acceleration framework for Tencent Cloud AI, TNN has provided acceleration support for the implementation of many businesses. Everyone is welcome to participate in the collaborative construction to promote the further improvement of the TNN inference framework.

summary.en: TNN: A high-performance, lightweight neural network inference framework open sourced by Tencent Youtu Lab.
summary.zh: 面向移动与多平台部署的轻量神经网络推理框架。

text.en: The Android benchmark scripts report per-model execution cost time. Layer benchmarks can list and filter individual layer tests and parameter combinations with GoogleTest options; results depend on model, layer parameters, and device.

text.zh: C++ 框架，链接检测、分割、OCR 等应用示例。

tools.name: Torch-Pruning (TP)
tools.description: TP enables structural pruning for a wide range of deep neural networks, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Segment Anything Model (SAM), Diffusion Models, Vision Transformers, ConvNext, Yolov7, yolov8, Swin Transformers, BERT, FasterRCNN, SSD, ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, RegNet, DeepLab, etc. Different from torch.nn.utils.prune that zeroizes parameters through masking, Torch-Pruning deploys an algorithm called DepGraph to remove parameters physically.

summary.en: TP enables structural pruning for a wide range of deep neural networks, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Segment Anything Model (SAM), Diffusion Models, Vision Transformers, ConvNext, Yolov7, yolov8, Swin Transformers, BERT, FasterRCNN, SSD, ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, RegNet, DeepLab, etc.
summary.zh: 利用依赖关系移除模型结构，支持多类神经网络剪枝。

text.en: DepGraph groups coupled parameters so they can be removed together.

tools.name: uTensor
tools.description: uTensor is an extremely light-weight machine learning inference framework built on Tensorflow and optimized for Arm targets. It consists of a runtime library and an offline tool that handles most of the model translation work. This repo holds the core runtime and some example implementations of operators, memory managers/schedulers, and more, and the size of the core runtime is only ~2KB!

Cloud Computing and Distributed Systems (CLOUDS) Laboratory
tools.description: The Cloud Computing and Distributed Systems (CLOUDS) Laboratory, formerly GRIDS Lab, is a software research and development group within the School of Computing and Information Systems at the University of Melbourne, Australia. The CLOUDS Lab is actively engaged in the design and development of next-generation computing systems and applications that aggregate or lease services of distributed resources depending on their availability, capability, performance, cost , and users' quality-of-service requirements. The lab is working towards realising this vision through its two flagship projects: Gridbus and Cloudbus.
